plugins.description: Remote workspace: connect a host over SSH (password or key), pick a remote workspace directory and operate on it with rw_pick_workspace / rw_list_dir / rw_read_file / rw_exec tools.
plugins.description_zh: 远程工作区：SSH 密码或 key 连接远程主机，选取远程工作区目录，用 rw_pick_workspace / rw_list_dir / rw_read_file / rw_exec 工具在远程直接操作。

plugins.name: dsh-session-manager
plugins.author: dream12347
plugins.description: DSH session manager: delete with trash/restore/purge, restore archived sessions, recent-activity stats, continue/pause, open log folder, unread markers, fork into a new chat, workspace grouping and sorting, context compaction threshold.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 会话管理插件：删除（回收站可恢复或彻底清除）、恢复归档会话、活动统计、继续/暂停、打开日志目录、未读标记、新聊天中继续、工作区分组与排序、上下文压缩阈值设置。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-picker
plugins.author: a735624258
plugins.description: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.
plugins.description_zh: WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

plugins.name: dsh-smooth-stream
plugins.author: Laplace-bit
plugins.description: Silky streaming reveal for the Web UI: text appears at the model's arrival rate, new lines glide in, no flicker; follow stays with the user and `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.
plugins.description_zh: 丝滑流式渲染：字跟着模型到达走、换行滑入、不闪，滚动归用户，尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui-notify
plugins.author: bill9109
plugins.description: Desktop notification reminders.
plugins.description_zh: 桌面通知提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-anchored-standard
plugins.author: Jungod1121
plugins.description: Two-phase agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro: the first request sees only bash+read (Minimal-aligned bootstrap), then the full Standard tool catalog after the first tool call or reply; ships as an installer bundle plus a manual preset directory.
plugins.description_zh: V4 Pro 两阶段 agent 预设：首轮仅 bash+read 完成极简开局，首个工具调用或回复后恢复 Standard 完整工具目录；以安装器 bundle 与手动预设目录双形态发布。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-memory
plugins.author: Aik358
plugins.description: Auto-memory for DSH: three-layer memory (user / project notes / daily logs) with automatic injection, per-turn auto-consolidation, AI greetings, smart search, a calendar view and a settings page, plus inheritance of other AI tools' memories.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 自动记忆插件：三层记忆自动注入与检索、每轮对话自动沉淀、AI 时段问候与三级抽屉、智能检索、日历视图与设置页，支持继承其他 AI 工具的记忆。

plugins.name: dsh-diff-viewer
plugins.author: lehhair
plugins.description: PiUI-style diff viewer replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls.
plugins.description_zh: PiUI 风格 diff 查看器，替换 write/edit 工具调用的默认 DiffBlock。

plugins.name: dsh-popout-sidebar
plugins.author: e2mcc
plugins.description: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.
plugins.description_zh: 可弹出式侧边栏：侧边栏展示产物与文件树，支持多种文件预览形式；并可弹出为独立浏览器标签页（可拖至另一显示器）；兼容其他sidebar插件，可以同时显示。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-monitor
plugins.author: Mombrane
plugins.description: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-timeline
plugins.author: jjxjjjjiik-bot
plugins.description: 1:1 port of DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav): hover-expandable rail, reading-position highlight, click-to-jump.
plugins.description_zh: 1:1 复刻 DeepSeek 官网右侧对话导航栏（ScrollNav）：悬停展开面板、阅读位置高亮、点击跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-context-doctor
plugins.author: Zhenyu98
plugins.description: Context injection audit: token costs of instruction chains / skill catalogs / tool schemas, duplicate and conflict detection.
plugins.description_zh: 上下文注入审计：统计指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突。

plugins.name: dsh-full-remote
plugins.author: JUANWANG-BUAA
plugins.description: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.
plugins.description_zh: 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 且服务端 API 完整：转发时改写 Host/Origin，恢复其他方案必定 403 的 settings.* / credentials.* / host.listDirectory。令牌门、按设备会话、可选首访审批。

plugins.name: dsh-LorebookMD
plugins.description: Import SillyTavern/TavernAI character cards and world books, save them as local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose from your prompts with the world settings as reference.
plugins.description_zh: 导入酒馆（SillyTavern/TavernAI）角色卡与世界书，落地为本地 Markdown 设定文档，激活创作模式后根据用户输入、参考世界书创作小说。

plugins.name: dsh-queue-plus
plugins.author: starslittle
plugins.description: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

plugins.name: dsh-science
plugins.author: biociao
plugins.description: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。

plugins.name: dsh-side-panel
plugins.author: ccq1
plugins.description: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。

plugins.name: dsh-solo-thinking
plugins.author: fredalxin
plugins.description: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.
plugins.description_zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

plugins.name: dsh-stock-market
plugins.author: AnacondaKC
plugins.description: Fixes the bug where your account can't lose money while you code.
plugins.description_zh: 有效解决了写代码的时候账户不能同时亏钱的 BUG。

plugins.name: dsh-web-review
plugins.author: CanglongCl
plugins.description: Isolated web page previews with element annotations that guide source edits.
plugins.description_zh: 隔离网页预览，通过元素批注指导源码修改。

plugins.name: fabric
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
plugins.description_zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

plugins.name: deepseek-manners
plugins.author: Moeblack
plugins.description: Append a thank-you note after every message. Mind your manners.
plugins.description_zh: 给每次消息后注入感谢语，做个有礼貌的人。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-subscription
plugins.author: WSL043
plugins.description: Built-in ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models, selectable subscription web search, backend quota for standard Codex and Spark, and a DSH settings UI; no API key or Codex CLI required.
plugins.description_zh: 内置 ChatGPT OAuth 的 Codex 模型提供方：可切换订阅联网搜索，在设置页显示普通 Codex 与 Spark 独立额度；无需 API Key 或 Codex CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-gomoku
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.
plugins.description_zh: 与 AI 下五子棋，也可让 AI 对局比棋力。

plugins.name: dsh-maid-whale-webUI#maid-whale-webui
plugins.author: yunxiiQwQ
plugins.description: Whale-maid paper theme for the DSH Web UI with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn frames, decorative assets, and a persistent pet.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 鲸鱼女仆纸面主题：亮暗配色、海洋插画、手绘边框、装饰素材与常驻桌宠。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-cyberpunk2077
plugins.author: Tommy00748
plugins.description: Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme: NC yellow and neon cyan identity, CRT scanlines, Kiroshi hover lock-on, combat-state HUD, synthesized typewriter and message SFX, and hidden easter eggs (relic / johnny).
plugins.description_zh: Cyberpunk 2077 / 夜之城主题：NC 黄 × 霓虹青配色、CRT 扫描线、Kiroshi 悬停锁定、战斗状态 HUD、合成打字机与消息音效，以及隐藏彩蛋（relic / johnny）。

plugins.name: trio
plugins.author: huey1in
plugins.description: Browser automation (Playwright) with a live view, an MCP server exposing DSH agents to any MCP client, and GitHub issue/PR/webhook review tools.
plugins.description_zh: 浏览器自动化（Playwright，带实时画面）+ MCP Server（把 DSH agent 暴露给任何 MCP 客户端）+ GitHub issue/PR/webhook 评审工具。

plugins.name: dsh-catppuccin-theme
plugins.author: NoNameLeGo
plugins.description: Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice, and adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Catppuccin 主题插件：Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套主题接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择；另附可开关的玻璃质感皮肤，顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图的磨砂玻璃效果可自由调节。

plugins.name: dsh-design-skills
plugins.author: zhaiyateng
plugins.description: Design-aesthetics skill pack (10 styles: dark SaaS, minimal white, neumorphism, brutalism, glassmorphism, Japanese minimal, bento grid, cyberpunk, vaporwave, art deco) with runnable landing-page demos: tokens, component rules, forbidden lists, and acceptance checklists per style.
plugins.description_zh: 设计美学技能包：10 种风格（深色 SaaS、极简白、新拟态、粗野主义、毛玻璃、日式极简、便当盒、赛博朋克、蒸汽波、装饰艺术），每种含 token、组件规则、禁用清单与验收清单，附可运行落地页 demo。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-pet
plugins.author: xiaoshihou514
plugins.description: DSH pet, on the desktop!
plugins.description_zh: 鲸鱼娘桌宠，桌面端！

plugins.name: dsh-files
plugins.author: taxueseek
plugins.description: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.
plugins.description_zh: 文件上传（彩色附件卡片、会话隔离存储、sha256 去重、TTL 清扫）+ 内容嗅探的 read_document 文档读取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）。

plugins.name: dsh-gomoku
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.
plugins.description_zh: 与 AI 下五子棋，也可让 AI 对局比棋力。

plugins.name: dsh-permission-rules
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Declarative allow/deny/ask permission rules plus Codex-style per-process network policy (with a built-in local HTTP/CONNECT proxy), full audit logging and hot rule reload.
plugins.description_zh: 声明式 allow/deny/ask 权限规则 + Codex 式进程级网络策略（内置本地 HTTP/CONNECT 代理），全量审计 + 规则热重载。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin
plugins.author: loongsuite
plugins.description: Converts session, agent-loop, LLM, and tool lifecycle events into OpenTelemetry GenAI traces and metrics, exported over standard OTLP/HTTP to any compatible backend, with content capture off by default.
plugins.description_zh: 将会话、Agent 循环、LLM 与工具生命周期事件转换为 OpenTelemetry GenAI 调用链与指标，通过标准 OTLP/HTTP 导出到任意兼容后端，正文采集默认关闭。

plugins.name: dsh-session-notification
plugins.author: dingyi222666
plugins.description: Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.
plugins.description_zh: 会话完成等四种状态的通知响应，支持浏览器提示。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-acp
plugins.author: openma-ai
plugins.description: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
plugins.description_zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-zh_pro
plugins.author: magian1127
plugins.description: Chinese UI enhancement for the DSH web client: completes the Chinese locale, keeps the session stats line fully visible on one row, and adds an Enhancements settings section with configurable chat width.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页中文增强：补全中文界面残留英文、统计行单行完整显示，并提供「增强设置」分区（中文补全 / 统计全显示 / 对话宽度）。

plugins.name: dsh-advisor
plugins.author: btspoony
plugins.description: Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
plugins.description_zh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。

plugins.name: dsh-bash-terminal
plugins.author: MAXeaglet
plugins.description: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
plugins.description_zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

plugins.name: dsh-chinese-traditional-wisdom-skill
plugins.author: dhicoc
plugins.description: Complete chinese-traditional-wisdom (玄枢 / XuanShu) skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: bazi, ziwei-doushu, liuyao, meihua, qimen, daliuren, taiyi, wuyun-liuqi, constitution and fengshui calculation, with a local deterministic engine and a visualization dashboard.
plugins.description_zh: 完整中华传统智慧（玄枢 / XuanShu）技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness Cordis 插件：八字、紫微斗数、六爻、梅花易数、奇门遁甲、大六壬、太乙、五运六气、中医体质与风水推算，内置本地确定性引擎与可视化 Dashboard。

plugins.name: dsh-continual-evolve
plugins.author: ZK-Andy
plugins.description: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.
plugins.description_zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。

plugins.name: dsh-md-notes
plugins.author: XieZongChen
plugins.description: A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 MD 笔记管理插件：提供完整的 **MD 笔记管理器** 和 **MD 笔记编辑器**，对话内容可快速记入笔记。笔记可 **同步 Git 仓库** 维护。对话时可将笔记 **加入上下文**。

plugins.name: dsh-pet
plugins.author: FlytoMAYDAY80
plugins.description: Desktop whale pet with live session state.
plugins.description_zh: 桌面小鲸鱼，实时感知会话状态。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-writing-guard
plugins.author: xmutfyh
plugins.description: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.
plugins.description_zh: 论文写作守卫（中英双语）：去掉 AI 式防御性写作，润色时守住科学证据（数字/引用/主张强度/零结果/scope），并按目标期刊校准写作风格（Journal Profile + Journal Fit）。纯本地正则/统计，零网络零 LLM；提供 writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile，论文写入后自动审计。

plugins.name: dsh-quant
plugins.author: pengpengyi92
plugins.description: Quantitative R&D toolkit for DeepSeek Harness — 46 tools across six domains covering market data, indicators, factor evaluation, walk-forward ML validation, risk, options, bonds and fund simulation, with an end-to-end research pipeline.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的量化研究工具箱，46 个工具覆盖行情、指标、因子评价、机器学习验证、风控、期权、债券与基金模拟，并提供端到端研究管线。

plugins.name: dsh-security-audit
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Local security audit: config, plugin origins, sessions, network exposure — read-only redacted risk report.
plugins.description_zh: 本机安全审计：配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，只读脱敏风险报告。

plugins.name: dsh-vision
plugins.author: linenxi-ctrl
plugins.description: External vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: whale-button config panel, image recognition with auto-reply, and agent screenshot/recognize tools.
plugins.description_zh: 外挂识图插件：鲸鱼按钮配置面板、图片识图自动回传、模型自主截图识图工具。

plugins.name: weshop-dsh-plugin
plugins.author: weshopai
plugins.description: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
plugins.description_zh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-action
plugins.author: Lixiaoyiao
plugins.description: GitHub Action running DSH for PR review, CI diagnosis and trusted fixes.
plugins.description_zh: GitHub Action 运行 DSH 做 PR 审查、CI 诊断与受信任修复。

plugins.name: dsh-bash-terminal
plugins.author: MAXeaglet
plugins.description: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
plugins.description_zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

plugins.name: dsh-better-deepseek
plugins.author: EdgeTypE
plugins.description: Bridge plugin for the [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome extension: exposes HTTP handshake and session-filtered SSE event streams over the web server, enabling browser-extension UI integrations with DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome 扩展桥接插件：在 webServer 上提供 HTTP 握手与会话过滤的 SSE 事件流，实现浏览器扩展 UI 与 DeepSeek Harness 的集成。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-auth
plugins.author: suntianc
plugins.description: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
plugins.description_zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

plugins.name: dsh-continual-evolve
plugins.author: ZK-Andy
plugins.description: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.
plugins.description_zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。

plugins.name: dsh-evolve
plugins.author: william-jin-cmu
plugins.description: Self-evolution: the agent hot-mounts/removes persistent plugins on itself mid-session.
plugins.description_zh: 自进化：agent 在会话内给自己热挂载/卸载持久化插件。

plugins.name: dsh-explain
plugins.author: yuezengwu
plugins.description: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.
plugins.description_zh: 本地优先学习模式：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解。

plugins.name: dsh-file-mentions
plugins.author: a903067276-rgb
plugins.description: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击：Codex 风格行内打开、文件管理器定位、回合尾部文件 chip 列表。

plugins.name: dsh-hdc-bridge
plugins.author: 1na-ko
plugins.description: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
plugins.description_zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

plugins.name: dsh-liquid-glass
plugins.author: xingyingyuzhui
plugins.description: Wallpaper plus optional Liquid Glass islands for the DSH Web UI: Ice/Deepwater presets, import, wallpaper opacity, and per-island blur on official light/dark/system.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 液态玻璃皮肤：冰原/深水壁纸、可导入、壁纸透明度，以及叠在官方浅色/深色/跟随系统上的分岛模糊。

plugins.name: dsh-media-skills
plugins.author: MJorgin
plugins.description: Free vision bridge and image generation for text-only models: paste-image reading, GLM-4V-Flash and Gemini engine failover, ModLens-style structured evidence, and a seeded free vision model route.
plugins.description_zh: 面向纯文本模型的免费视觉桥与生图：粘贴读图、GLM-4V-Flash 与 Gemini 引擎故障转移、modlens 同款结构化证据输出，并自动播种免费视觉模型路由。

plugins.name: dsh-meow-memory
plugins.author: Phant0Meow
plugins.description: Project-scoped cross-session memory: six-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic) on node:sqlite, cache-friendly first-message injection, memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update tools, and per-window nightly consolidation ("dream").
plugins.description_zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：node:sqlite 六层存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic），首条用户消息缓存友好注入，memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update 工具，按窗口夜间整理（dream）。

plugins.name: dsh-oomol
plugins.author: oomol-lab
plugins.description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OOMOL-managed apps and services, with progressive Connector Action discovery and execution plus an in-app panel for managing Provider connections.
plugins.description_zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入由 OOMOL 管理的应用与服务，支持渐进式发现并执行 Connector Actions，并提供用于管理 Provider 连接的应用内面板。

plugins.name: dsh-outline
plugins.author: urzeye
plugins.description: Real-time outline panel for the DSH Web session page: user questions plus a Markdown heading tree (H1–H6) that updates live during streaming, with click-to-locate highlighting, expand-depth control, search, and per-session favorites.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 会话页实时大纲面板：「用户问题 + Markdown 标题（1~6 级）」大纲树，流式生成时实时更新，点击节点滚动定位并高亮，支持展开深度调节、搜索与会话级收藏。

plugins.name: dsh-passwords
plugins.author: slywalker2006
plugins.description: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.
plugins.description_zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 变成服务器级多租户平台：远程访问 + 自动 HTTPS、子用户权限与配额、沙盒强制、加密认证与审计日志。

plugins.name: dsh-queue-plus
plugins.author: starslittle
plugins.description: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

plugins.name: dsh-read-url
plugins.description: Read any page as clean main content: charset auto-detect (GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5), noise stripping, compact text/Markdown, offset continuation, optional SPA rendering, batch reads and site crawling.
plugins.description_zh: 读取网页返回干净正文：中文编码自动识别（GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5）、噪音过滤、紧凑文本/Markdown、offset 续读、可选 SPA 渲染、批量读取与整站爬取。

plugins.name: dsh-sentinel
plugins.author: fuhefei
plugins.description: Condition-driven wakeup: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 条件驱动唤醒：file/command/http/process/webhook 持久监视，触发即唤醒 agent。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage
plugins.author: LeemanCheung
plugins.description: Local-first four-bucket Token observability: persistent session/provider/model/day dashboards, trends, budget and anomaly signals, public-rate estimates, safe aggregate exports, and explicit opt-in usage or session-trajectory analysis.
plugins.description_zh: 本地优先的四 bucket Token 可观测性：持久会话/provider/model/日期仪表盘、趋势、预算与异常信号、公开费率估算、安全聚合导出，以及显式触发的用量/会话轨迹分析。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-proxy
plugins.author: Flyvhidbwo
plugins.description: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed to text via any OpenAI-compatible VLM before reaching the text-only DeepSeek — a keyed fast path (default qwen3.7-flash; DashScope/Zhipu/OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) with your own key, or local Ollama auto-detected with zero config.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek 大脑 + 自动识图：GUI 附加的每张图片自动经 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 转译成文字，再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek 作答——有 key 自动走快速通道（默认 qwen3.7-flash，支持百炼/智谱/OpenRouter 等任意 OpenAI 兼容端点），无 key 自动探测本地 Ollama（零配置，图片不出本机）。

plugins.name: dsh-win32
plugins.author: sjh9714
plugins.description: Makes Minimal mode work on Windows by supplying the missing win32 process inspector, so the persistent shell actually starts. Adds a busybox-based preset whose persistent shell survives the workspace-write restricted token (MSYS shells die there), ConPTY console-list foreground resolution, GBK/UTF-16 file reads, and an install-trap doctor.
plugins.description_zh: 补上官方缺失的 win32 进程探测，让 Minimal 模式在 Windows 上真正可用，持久 shell 才能起来。附 busybox 变体预设，其持久 shell 能在 workspace-write 受限令牌下存活（MSYS 系 shell 在那里会崩），另有基于 ConPTY 控制台进程列表的前台命令解析、GBK/UTF-16 文件读取，以及安装排障工具。

plugins.name: dsh-wsl-workspace
plugins.author: 6Mikao9
plugins.description: Add a WSL workspace from the web GUI without needing to install dsh or related tools again inside WSL. Bash commands and file read/write operations run within the local WSL distribution on the host machine, while Windows files remain accessible.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web GUI 添加 WSL 工作区，无需在 WSL 之中再次安装 dsh 以及相关工具，bash 命令与文件读写运行在本机 WSL 发行版内，Windows 文件仍可访问。

plugins.name: godot-bridge
plugins.author: Smalldy
plugins.description: DSH↔Godot engine runtime bridge: launch and drive a running Godot 4.x game through its in-game TCP interaction server — 16 tools (runtime control via ~130 game commands, scene/UI inspection, GDScript eval, input simulation, screenshots, headless static ops, project editing, export, script validation, engine-path setup), replaces godot-mcp.
plugins.description_zh: DSH↔Godot 引擎运行时控制桥：通过游戏内置 TCP 交互服务器启动并操控运行中的 Godot 4.x——16 个工具（约 130 条运行时命令、场景/UI 检查、GDScript eval、输入模拟、截图、headless 静态操作、项目编辑、导出、脚本编译检查、引擎路径设置），替代 godot-mcp。

plugins.name: plugin-template
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Plugin template repo (based on the official turtle-ui repo).
plugins.description_zh: 插件模板仓库（基于 turtle-ui 官方仓库）。

plugins.name: Co-Engram#dsh-plugin
plugins.author: Co-Engram
plugins.description: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.
plugins.description_zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

plugins.name: context-vista
plugins.author: GooodWei
plugins.description: A right-side floating panel and /context command for DeepSeek Harness — a live donut chart of context token usage, allocation, and estimated cost.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右侧悬浮栏以及 /context 命令，用环形图实时展示当前上下文 token 用量与分配及消费估算。

plugins.name: dsh-ai4scholar
plugins.author: literaf
plugins.description: AI4Scholar academic search: 38 tools over Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, and DOI resolution (search, citation graph, authors, recommendations, PDF full text in slices, auto-cite, scientific figures), a unified cross-platform search with de-duplication, an API-key card in Settings, and per-call credit accounting with an `/ai4scholar` balance card.
plugins.description_zh: AI4Scholar 学术检索：覆盖 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv、bioRxiv/medRxiv 与 DOI 解析的 38 个工具（搜索、引用图谱、作者、推荐、PDF 全文分片、自动引用、科研绘图），跨平台去重统一搜索，设置页 API Key 卡片，按次积分统计与 `/ai4scholar` 余额卡。

plugins.name: dsh-any-background
plugins.author: Tkingxiao
plugins.description: A theme appearance plugin that lets you fully customize the Web UI with custom theme colors, background wallpapers, and fine-grained transparency and blur controls for each section of the homepage, plus import/export support for easy theme sharing.
plugins.description_zh: 一个主题外观插件，让你完全自定义 Web 端的主题色、背景壁纸，以及主页分部位精细的透明度与模糊度控制，还可导出导入主题设置进行分享。

plugins.name: dsh-better-edit
plugins.author: Rianico
plugins.description: Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.
plugins.description_zh: 基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

plugins.name: dsh-cloud-sync
plugins.author: dickpy
plugins.description: Synchronizes DSH profiles and local plugin source archives through WebDAV and S3-compatible storage, with encrypted snapshots, conflict-aware recovery, and explicit self-updates.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 WebDAV 和兼容 S3 的存储同步 DSH profile 与本地插件源码归档，支持加密快照、冲突感知恢复和显式自更新。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-oauth
plugins.author: WNJXYK
plugins.description: Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls, and browser or device-code OAuth sign-in.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。

plugins.name: dsh-cyber-particle
plugins.author: AKS1st
plugins.description: Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供粒子网络动态背景：全屏覆盖、点击穿透、零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-file-upload
plugins.author: HongMing-Huang
plugins.description: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.
plugins.description_zh: Claude 风格拖拽/回形针文件上传：内容嗅探、文档转 Markdown（微软 MarkItDown，内置 JS 兜底）、文本直插输入框、read_document 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-galgame
plugins.author: Lanxing6480
plugins.description: A visual-novel presentation layer for the DSH Web chat view: portrait diffs, streaming thought bubble, typewriter dialogue, and GalGame-style question/approval panels; switch back to the normal chat anytime.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 聊天界面 GalGame 演出层：立绘差分、流式思考气泡、打字机对话框与 GalGame 式提问/审批选项框，可随时切回普通聊天。

plugins.name: dsh-harmony
plugins.author: CH4ACKO3
plugins.description: Lets one DSH plugin modify another plugin's code at runtime, with Patch ordering, conflict checks, and hot reload.
plugins.description_zh: 让一个 DSH 插件在运行时修改另一个插件的代码，并提供 Patch 排序、冲突检查和热重载。

plugins.name: dsh-harmony
plugins.author: CH4ACKO3
plugins.description: Modifies DSH plugin code at runtime, with ordered patches, inspection, and hot reload.
plugins.description_zh: 在运行时修改 DSH 插件代码，并提供 Patch 排序、检查和热重载。

plugins.name: dsh-kimino-theme
plugins.author: niiang
plugins.description: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme: cinematic wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, movie logo swap and unified scrollbars for the DSH Web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: 《你的名字。》主题：电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、电影 Logo 替换与统一滚动条。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-fallbacks
plugins.author: btspoony
plugins.description: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
plugins.description_zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-panel
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: connection status, registered tools, errors, and reconnect counts through the /mcp command and a Settings tab, with sanitized display and enable/disable patch suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: 官方 MCP 客户端（dsh-mcp-client）的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令与设置页 MCP 页签展示连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数，脱敏展示并提供启停 patch 建议。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-integration
plugins.author: MutaLucem
plugins.description: Discovers installed DSH plugins with tags, overlap and compatibility detection, one-click enable/disable, failure diagnosis, and update checking.
plugins.description_zh: 动态发现已装插件并打标分类，检测功能重叠与兼容冲突，一键启停切换、失效诊断与更新检测。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.author: liqichen
plugins.description: GUI in the DSH settings panel: toggle/delete MCP servers, browse and trash skills, and list built-in plugin packages — hot-applied without restart.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 设置面板内嵌的图形化管理器：开关/删除 MCP 服务、浏览并回收 Skills、查看内置插件包，改动热生效无需重启。

plugins.name: dsh-Remote#plugin
plugins.author: Blank-not-black
plugins.description: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.
plugins.description_zh: 移动远程控制套件：原生侧边栏入口 + 管理抽屉的 bundle 插件，自带 Bearer 令牌网关自愈（局域网/Tailscale）；Android App 覆盖会话/审批/提问/goal；/fs/* 文件端点（Range 断点续传、2GB 上传）；多服务器测速自动切换；聊天记录离线缓存。

plugins.name: dsh-sidechain
plugins.author: Buyi-wsgzg
plugins.description: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
plugins.description_zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

plugins.name: dsh-status-rotator
plugins.author: 01Virex
plugins.description: Replaces the "Deep diving..." turn-status label with rotating meme-worthy phrases, with typewriter and gradient effects.
plugins.description_zh: 把回合状态那句 "Deep diving..." 替换成更有梗的自定义文案，按阶段轮换，支持打字机与流动渐变。

plugins.name: dsh-sticky-note
plugins.author: Meredith2328
plugins.description: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.
plugins.description_zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

plugins.name: dsh-task-status
plugins.author: vlln
plugins.description: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.
plugins.description_zh: 后台任务状态条：对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-opencode
plugins.author: poiuyjie
plugins.description: Adds a configurable vision model to text-only main models: a vision_read_image tool, a composer-bar vision-model selector, and automatic image-to-text conversion for text-only routes.
plugins.description_zh: 给纯文本主模型加可配置识图模型：vision_read_image 工具、输入框识图模型选择器，以及纯文本路由的图片自动转文字。

plugins.name: Catppuccin-dsh-theme
plugins.author: zhijun-dai
plugins.description: Catppuccin theme plugin: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha skins for the DSH Web theme runtime.
plugins.description_zh: Catppuccin 主题插件：为 DSH Web 主题运行时提供 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套皮肤。

plugins.name: dsh-acp-for-bitfun
plugins.author: bobleer
plugins.description: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.
plugins.description_zh: BitFun 与 DSH 的 ACP 交互对接。

plugins.name: dsh-answer-pet
plugins.author: Nanki-nn
plugins.description: Extensible animated response pet with blue-whale, orange-cat, and silver-shaded-cat themes, per-session progress, model and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.
plugins.description_zh: 可扩展回答状态宠物，内置蓝鲸、橘猫和银渐层猫主题；按会话实时展示回答进度、模型动作与工具调用轨迹、token、输出速率与耗时，并支持多会话状态卡片展开和收起。

plugins.name: dsh-bookmarks
plugins.author: penguin-oo
plugins.description: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
plugins.description_zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

plugins.name: dsh-chatgpt-bridge
plugins.author: jiezeng2004-design
plugins.description: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and goals while preserving DSH's native approval, sandbox, and workspace security model.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT Web 创建、查看、继续和监督 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话与 Goal，同时保留 DSH 原生的审批、沙箱与工作区安全模型。

plugins.name: dsh-fail-logger
plugins.author: Areium
plugins.description: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
plugins.description_zh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

plugins.name: dsh-global-rules
plugins.author: badai147
plugins.description: Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后实时生效。

plugins.name: dsh-hud
plugins.author: a903067276-rgb
plugins.description: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.
plugins.description_zh: HUD 状态面板：Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能列表、模型与 token 用量，悬浮侧栏一览无余。

plugins.name: dsh-passwords
plugins.author: slywalker2006
plugins.description: Login gateway for the DSH web UI: password door with first-run setup, bcrypt + at-rest encryption (AES-256-GCM/HMAC), brute-force lockout, audit log, TLS 1.2+ with 80→443 redirect, CSRF, anti-framing.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 登录网关：首次配置、bcrypt + 静态加密（AES-256-GCM/HMAC）、防爆破、审计日志、TLS 1.2+ 与 80→443 跳转、CSRF 与防嵌框。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-smooth-stream
plugins.author: SpookySandwich
plugins.description: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

plugins.name: dsh-pluginmanager
plugins.author: buhuikongpan
plugins.description: Layered plugin manager for DSH web: native plugins grouped read-only by system/WebUI/tools, user extensions with enable/disable, register, uninstall and editable descriptions.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 分层插件管理器：原生插件按系统/WebUI/工具三层只读展示，用户扩展支持停用/启用、补登记、卸载与可编辑描述。

plugins.name: dsh-side-chat
plugins.author: heartmove
plugins.description: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
plugins.description_zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-manager-ytxue
plugins.author: YTxue
plugins.description: Skill pool manager in the Settings sidebar: enable/disable, folder batch import with rename-conflict prompts, state-driven one-click DSH-spec check & auto-fix, system/project scope labels.
plugins.description_zh: 设置侧边栏的 Skill 管理器：池与启用目录启停、文件夹批量导入（重名询问）、状态驱动一键规范检查与自动修复、系统级/项目级来源标识。

plugins.name: dsh-spotlight
plugins.author: 0xsline
plugins.description: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。

plugins.name: dsh-visual-plugin
plugins.author: jyh20030112
plugins.description: Gives text-only models vision: forwards user images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and shows the descriptions in a Web UI right panel.
plugins.description_zh: 给纯文本模型装上眼睛：把用户图片转发给任意 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型生成描述，并在 Web UI 右侧面板展示结果。

plugins.name: dsh-web-billing
plugins.author: bpc-oss
plugins.description: RMB/USD token billing with official-policy pricing and a per-message cost ledger.
plugins.description_zh: 人民币/美元 token 计费，官方政策计价与逐条消息费用账本。

plugins.name: task-passport
plugins.author: dongsheng123132
plugins.description: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
plugins.description_zh: 通过机器可读检查点与乐观锁，在 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间交接持久任务状态。

plugins.name: write-chinese-long-screenplay
plugins.author: mudden2380078550-creator
plugins.description: Chinese long-form screenwriting skill: two input blocks (background + character bible) feeding a causal-value engine, anti-AI-flavor review, and a continuity ledger; works on Codex / Claude Code / dsh / zcode.
plugins.description_zh: 中文长剧本写作 skill：双输入板块（背景 + 人物卡）+ 因果—价值内核，保证长篇幅的连续性与人物声音，兼容 Codex / Claude Code / dsh / zcode。

plugins.name: dsh-apex-standard
plugins.author: rinDBeans
plugins.description: Unified anchored agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash on the official API and opencode-go: Minimal-exact two-tool first-request bootstrap, model-aware Pro/Flash paths, and epoch-aware catalog management for long-session stability.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash 统一锚定 agent 预设（官方 API 与 opencode-go）：首请求 Minimal 精确两工具锚定、按模型分流 Pro/Flash 路径、epoch 感知目录管理保证长对话稳定。

plugins.name: dsh-bottom-info-bar#plugin
plugins.author: songoao25
plugins.description: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

plugins.name: dsh-checkpoint-rewind
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-obsidian-memory
plugins.author: detongz
plugins.description: Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.
plugins.description_zh: 基于本地 Obsidian/Codex 知识库的持久 AI 记忆：5 个 obsidian_memory_* 读写搜索工具，外加侧边栏知识库浏览器。

plugins.name: dsh-deepread
plugins.author: xiehuan123
plugins.description: DeepRead: deep-reading assistant with five modes (quick / deep / knowledge map with four confidence levels / Feynman reading / whole book), batch comparison, budget preflight, and transparent background-job progress, from WeChat article links / local .pdf (built-in pure-JS extractor) / pasted text, with optional MD / FreeMind / styled HTML export.
plugins.description_zh: DeepRead 精读助手：五种精读模式（quick / deep / map 知识地图（四档置信度）/ feynman 费曼读书法 / book 全书）、批量对比、预算预检与后台任务进度透明、微信公众号链接 / .pdf 文件（内置纯 JS 提取器）/ 粘贴文本，可选导出 MD / FreeMind 思维导图（XMind 可导入）/ 编辑风网页报告。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop
plugins.author: foolgry
plugins.description: Download-and-run Electron desktop build that tracks upstream releases automatically.
plugins.description_zh: 开箱即用的 Electron 桌面版，自动跟随上游发版。

plugins.name: dsh-drop-file-to-path
plugins.author: GLFzr
plugins.description: Codex-style drag-drop: drag any file into the DSH web GUI, it lands in ~/.dsh-dropbox, and the path is inserted into the composer as a whole blue chip.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 式拖拽：把任意文件拖入 DSH Web 界面，文件存入 ~/.dsh-dropbox，路径以整块蓝色 chip 插入输入框。

plugins.name: dsh-fail-logger
plugins.author: Areium
plugins.description: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
plugins.description_zh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu
plugins.author: PGZXB
plugins.description: Feishu (Lark) UI for DeepSeek Harness — a panel-driven control console: every slash command is a button on the ⚙️ control-panel card, in-card approvals and questions, live streaming cards, and one-QR app setup.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书 UI：面板驱动控制台——每个斜杠命令都是 ⚙️ 控制面板卡片上的按钮，卡内审批与提问，流式卡片，扫码一次完成配置。

plugins.name: dsh-font
plugins.author: tianyhjg-lab
plugins.description: Font switcher for the DSH Web GUI: 99 UI fonts and 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing stacks, instant apply and localStorage persistence.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 字体切换器：99 个界面字体与 31 个代码字体，中西文自动搭配，即选即生效，localStorage 持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-ikun-pet
plugins.author: eric-song-dev
plugins.description: An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion.
plugins.description_zh: ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

plugins.name: dsh-joi-channel-theme
plugins.author: tpmoonchefryan
plugins.description: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.
plugins.description_zh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

plugins.name: dsh-lan-access
plugins.author: Leon0555
plugins.description: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
plugins.description_zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-panel
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: connection status, registered tools, errors, and reconnect counts through the /mcp command and a Settings tab, with sanitized display and enable/disable patch suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: 官方 MCP 客户端（dsh-mcp-client）的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令与设置页 MCP 页签展示连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数，脱敏展示并提供启停 patch 建议。

plugins.name: dsh-mermaid
plugins.author: AKS1st
plugins.description: Render Mermaid code fences in DSH Web chat messages as lazy-loaded SVG diagrams with strict sanitization and light/dark theme follow.
plugins.description_zh: 把 DSH Web 会话消息中的 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为惰性加载的 SVG 图表，严格消毒并跟随明暗主题。

plugins.name: dsh-oauth-mcp-client
plugins.author: springbrand-lab
plugins.description: OAuth 2.1 MCP client for Streamable HTTP servers: add a connection in Settings, sign in through the browser (PKCE with dynamic client registration), and have its tools registered in DSH, with tokens kept in the credential service and the connection written to the profile.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 Streamable HTTP 服务的 OAuth 2.1 MCP 客户端：在设置页添加连接，通过浏览器登录（PKCE + 动态客户端注册），其工具随即注册进 DSH；令牌存于凭据服务，连接写入 profile。

plugins.name: dsh-ocgo-lite
plugins.author: OK-wx
plugins.description: OpenCode Go usage bar in the composer dock: rolling/weekly/monthly quota rings, DSH-session token & cost stats priced with live official rates, per-model and current-session scope breakdowns with live per-session updates, one-click API key copy.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方常驻 OpenCode Go 用量条：5 小时/每周/每月配额圆环，DSH 会话 token 与花费统计（官方实时定价），支持按模型与按「本次会话」范围联动明细（本次会话实时更新），一键复制 API Key。

plugins.name: dsh-peer-link
plugins.author: czm15053
plugins.description: Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).
plugins.description_zh: 让 dsh 和 Claude Code 会话直接互发消息，附带可点击的会话列表卡片（搜索/刷新/弹窗发送）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-d399
plugins.author: HuanLinOTO
plugins.description: Pops up a mini-game menu (wordle, match-3, extensible) while the model generates.
plugins.description_zh: 模型生成时弹出小游戏菜单（wordle/消消乐，可扩展）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-market
plugins.author: springbrand-lab
plugins.description: Plugin marketplace in Settings that targets any local profile, not just the running one: install, update and remove across web, headless and other profiles, with install-script warnings, an installed view that also covers non-catalog profile dependencies, and an automatic DSH restart when the current profile changes.
plugins.description_zh: 设置页里的插件市场，可操作本机任意 profile 而不只是当前运行的那个：在 web、headless 及其他 profile 上安装、更新、卸载，带安装脚本风险提示，已装视图同时覆盖目录之外的 profile 依赖，改动当前 profile 时自动重启 DSH。

plugins.name: dsh-session-health
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Frame-level scan diagnostics for session files (torn/corrupt/empty detection).
plugins.description_zh: 会话文件帧级扫描诊断（torn/损坏/空会话检测）。

plugins.name: dsh-skills-manager
plugins.author: MichengAI
plugins.description: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置里管理本地 DSH 技能，并只读查看公共 Agent 技能。

plugins.name: dsh-smooth-stream
plugins.author: SpookySandwich
plugins.description: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

plugins.name: dsh-update-checker
plugins.author: Airmetro
plugins.description: Update management for the whole stack: compares DeepSeek Harness and every installed third-party plugin against npm and GitHub releases (semver-aware), shows a locale-aware banner (zh/en) with per-plugin update status, and provides one-click updates with automatic backup/rollback, temp-dir installs that never touch other packages, and a watchdog-guarded restart. A settings page adds per-plugin version lamps, live update progress, and banner/notification toggles. Zero-config on any machine.
plugins.description_zh: 全栈更新管理：对 DeepSeek Harness 主程序与每个已装第三方插件做 npm/GitHub Release 双源 semver 比对，GUI 横幅随系统语言（中/英）逐项提示可更新插件；一键更新主程序或任意插件，自动备份可回滚、插件经临时目录安装不碰其它包、更新后看门狗自动重启服务。「检查更新」设置页提供逐插件版本状态灯、实时更新进度与横幅/通知开关。跨机器零配置。

plugins.name: Gemini-Eyes
plugins.author: ConsoleSun
plugins.description: MCP bridge to gemini.google.com: vision analysis of images and videos, Imagen image and Veo video generation, and conversation management using the logged-in browser session with no API key.
plugins.description_zh: 接入 gemini.google.com 的 MCP 桥：图片/视频视觉识别、Imagen 生图、Veo 生视频与历史对话管理，复用浏览器登录态，无需 API Key。

plugins.name: skills
plugins.author: creght-dev
plugins.description: Skills for building websites on the Creght platform: CLI pull/push sync, page and component conventions, CMS, forms, auth, SEO, publishing and version rollback.
plugins.description_zh: Creght 平台建站技能包：CLI 拉取/推送同步、页面与组件规范、CMS、表单、Auth、SEO、发布与版本回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-plugin
plugins.author: stevenx65
plugins.description: DeepSeek balance and token usage in the web sidebar, with a today/all-time toggle and provider filtering.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 网页侧边栏的 DeepSeek 余额与 token 用量监控：今日/累计切换，并按 provider 过滤其他厂商。

plugins.name: dsh-browser
plugins.author: wqty123
plugins.description: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.
plugins.description_zh: 共享真实浏览器：用户可观看并随时接管的原生 Electron 窗口，agent 通过 CDP 驱动，内置 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填表/截图/下载/登录态）；任务级会话隔离、登录态持久化、人机验证识别，纯 `dsh web` 无需桌面外壳即可自托管。

plugins.name: dsh-builtin-toggles
plugins.author: Starfie1d1272
plugins.description: Evidence-backed inspector for DSH Web built-in capabilities: runtime/config provenance, compatibility and drift diagnostics, plus fail-closed controls for nine reviewed UI leaves.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 内置 capability 的 evidence-backed 检查器：展示运行/配置溯源、兼容性与漂移诊断，并仅为 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaf 提供 fail-closed 控制。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-imagine
plugins.author: corrinehu
plugins.description: Automatically generates and displays images in the DSH chat via API channels or local CLIs (supports mmx / codex / agy).
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 聊天窗口自动调用生图工具（API 渠道，或本机 CLI：已支持 mmx / codex / agy）并展示图片。

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-claude
plugins.author: PAKIKNOWLEDGE
plugins.description: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
plugins.description_zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-port
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Batch-port official Codex plugins into DSH skills (measured: 186 plugins / 583 skills, 577 ported, 0 failures).
plugins.description_zh: Codex 官方插件一键移植为 DSH 技能（实测 186 插件/583 技能，移植 577 个 0 失败）。

plugins.name: dsh-computer-use
plugins.author: 988hj7tczd-oss
plugins.description: Cross-platform Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: virtual-mouse human-like operation (screen_observe + computer_click + type + key + scroll + drag, 11 tools), AX-tree zero-vision-cost mode with free GLM-4V-Flash vision fallback, safety guards (snapshot TTL / app whitelist / dangerous-action approval / password-box protection).
plugins.description_zh: 跨平台 Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作（screen_observe / computer_click / type / key / scroll / drag 共 11 个工具），AX 语义树零视觉成本 + GLM-4V-Flash 免费视觉兜底，安全护栏（快照 TTL / 应用白名单 / 危险操作审批 / 密码框保护）。

plugins.name: DSH-EvoResearch#evoresearch-plugin
plugins.author: Karbo123
plugins.description: Research agent suite: long-horizon goal control with auditable evidence chains, cron scheduling, multi-agent expert teams, self-evolving research memory (FTS5 + RRF recall), project workspaces, and a custom workspace UI.
plugins.description_zh: 科研 agent 套件：长程目标控制（可审计证据链）、定时任务、多智能体专家团队、自进化科研记忆（FTS5 + RRF 召回）、科研项目工作区与自定义工作台界面。

plugins.name: dsh-extension-hub
plugins.author: Relistencode
plugins.description: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an Add-ons block to install, disable, uninstall and update companion features together.
plugins.description_zh: 设置页一体化扩展中心：管理技能/MCP/插件，内置插件市场（精选目录+GitHub 搜索、npm 一键安装），并提供附加功能区统一安装/停用/卸载、一起更新附属功能。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu
plugins.author: xmanrui
plugins.description: Connect a Feishu bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
plugins.description_zh: 通过扫码把飞书机器人接入DeepSeek Harness。

plugins.name: dsh-git-identity
plugins.author: LoserFox
plugins.description: Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all `git config` settings.
plugins.description_zh: git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份，环境变量注入压过一切 `git config` 设置。

plugins.name: dsh-ha-orchestrator
plugins.author: Saktawdi
plugins.description: Model high-availability failover (quarantine, circuit breaking, probe recovery) and subagent orchestration (fanout/pipeline/supervisor) with bilingual settings UI.
plugins.description_zh: 模型高可用故障回退（隔离/熔断/探测恢复）与子智能体编排（fanout/pipeline/supervisor），附带双语设置界面。

plugins.name: dsh-im-bridge
plugins.author: BiBoyang
plugins.description: Two-way WeChat (iLink) bridge: turn-end and approval-request push, in-chat approve/reject and message injection, persistent dedup and convergent long-reply chunking; channel layer extensible to other IMs.
plugins.description_zh: 微信（iLink）双向桥：turn 完成/批准请求推送、聊天内批准与消息注入、持久去重与长回复收敛分段；通道层为多 IM 预留。

plugins.name: dsh-imagegen
plugins.author: dickpy
plugins.description: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge-base
plugins.author: htcqp802
plugins.description: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 通用知识库插件：导入 md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf、目录化管理、FTS5 全文检索（BM25）、Web 管理界面。

plugins.name: dsh-lark-bridge
plugins.author: imetn
plugins.description: Bidirectional Lark/Feishu controller for DeepSeek Harness with project and session routing, interactive cards, approvals, attachments, and task controls.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向控制器，支持 Project 与 Session 路由、交互卡片、审批、附件和任务控制。

plugins.name: dsh-lark-meeting-notifier
plugins.author: yeruizhi
plugins.description: Feishu meeting reminder: a dsh-plugin which has only side effect: reminding you, mid-flow with AI, that you "have to go meet carbon-based lifeforms".
plugins.description_zh: 飞书会议提醒：一个只有副作用的 dsh-plugin，在你跟 AI 聊得神魂颠倒时提醒你「不得不去跟碳基生命开会了」。

plugins.name: dsh-live2d-pets
plugins.author: cyanfish-x
plugins.description: Live2D desk pet overlay for the DSH web GUI: mirrors agent state (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval) with motions and speech bubbles, per-part touch reactions, drag-to-dock, switchable personas, and custom models via URL or local path.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠悬浮层：镜像 agent 思考/空闲/出错/完成/待审批状态，配动画与气泡，支持分部位触摸反应、拖动停靠、切换人设，以及通过 URL 或本地路径加载自定义模型。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-manager
plugins.author: hyqhyq3
plugins.description: MCP server manager with OAuth or static-token auth and a Settings page.
plugins.description_zh: MCP 服务器管理器：OAuth 或静态 token 认证 + 设置页。

plugins.name: dsh-message-rail
plugins.author: wx-yss
plugins.description: Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格左侧消息导航轨道：每条用户消息一个刻度，悬停预览、点击跳转，全历史一次索引。

plugins.name: dsh-movein
plugins.author: sjh9714
plugins.description: Migrate and import a whole Claude Code or Codex setup into DSH. Skills, slash commands, MCP servers, hooks, subagents and permission rules, with a dry-run moving estimate, a migration diff report and a post-move doctor; installs as a plugin exposing a movein_from_claude_code tool so the agent can do the move for you.
plugins.description_zh: 一键迁移导入整套 Claude Code 或 Codex 配置到 DSH：技能、斜杠命令、MCP、hooks、子代理、权限规则，默认先出搬家清单预演，输出迁移差异报告，搬完可用 doctor 体检；作为插件提供 movein_from_claude_code 工具，直接让 agent 帮你搬。

plugins.name: dsh-movein-permissions
plugins.author: sjh9714
plugins.description: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool), works standalone without migrating.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

plugins.name: dsh-myrules
plugins.author: Relistencode
plugins.description: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

plugins.name: dsh-openviking
plugins.author: Rxiain
plugins.description: Semantic retrieval, resource management, auto-recall (user + agent dual spaces) and session memory for DeepSeek Harness: memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob over viking:// URIs, memadd/memremove resource management, memqueue observer status, memcommit session capture, and memlearn skill playbook minting.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 语义检索、资源管理、自动召回（user + agent 双空间）与会话记忆插件：基于 viking:// URI 的 memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob 检索工具、memadd/memremove 资源管理、memqueue 队列状态、memcommit 会话捕获，以及 memlearn 技能手册沉淀。

plugins.name: dsh-overleaf
plugins.author: fly233338
plugins.description: Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DSH，支持浏览、分析和通过 Git 写回 LaTeX 文件。

plugins.name: dsh-plannotator
plugins.author: titanwings
plugins.description: Plan review with anchored annotations and structured feedback back to the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 计划批注：选中计划原文逐条批注，结构化反馈送回 Agent。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-tts
plugins.description: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
plugins.description_zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-appearance-gallery
plugins.author: wsxwj123
plugins.description: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default.
plugins.description_zh: 15 个精选主题家族 + 9 个完整 dsh-web-ui 皮肤复刻合并为单一插件、设置页单一入口，支持 CSS-only 自定义主题 JSON、受控自定义皮肤包导入（可直接选文件夹）、试穿、应用、删除与恢复默认。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-composer-tools
plugins.author: wsxwj123
plugins.description: Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe) and related input conveniences.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框工具集：方向键调取历史消息（限首/末行触发，兼容输入法与命令菜单）等输入增强。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-pet-bridge
plugins.author: wsxwj123
plugins.description: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time.
plugins.description_zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-plugin-scheduled-tasks
plugins.author: Ceelog
plugins.description: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
plugins.description_zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-plugin-setting-mcp
plugins.author: Ceelog
plugins.description: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-session-manager
plugins.author: wsxwj123
plugins.description: Delete sessions with a 5-second undo and a recycle bin, plus an archive view to browse and unarchive, for the DSH Web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: 会话删除（5 秒可撤销 + 回收站）与归档视图（查看、取消归档）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-turn-scrubber
plugins.author: wsxwj123
plugins.description: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。

plugins.name: dsh-requirements-alignment
plugins.author: jiezeng2004-design
plugins.description: Runtime requirement drift guard that keeps long-running DSH agents aligned with the user's approved goal, constraints, and decisions.
plugins.description_zh: 运行时需求漂移防护，在长任务执行过程中保持 DSH Agent 与用户确认的目标、约束和决策一致。

plugins.name: dsh-telegram-channel
plugins.author: hi-wenw
plugins.description: Telegram mobile remote that attaches the phone to a live DeepSeek Harness Web session: workspace-then-session picker (/sessions), /last for the previous Q/A, /model switch, and native Rich Message replies.
plugins.description_zh: Telegram 手机遥控器：附着本机正在跑的 Web 会话，支持 /sessions 工作区→会话选择、/last 查看上次问答、/model 切换模型，以及原生 Rich Message 回复。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-writing
plugins.author: x2802490130-prog
plugins.description: A web-novel writing engine for DeepSeek Harness: parallel drafting, outlining and brainstorming with a separate DeepSeek key, lore and foreshadowing management, semantic vector retrieval, a corpus library, usage ledger, mechanical proofreading, and a local serialization plan.
plugins.description_zh: 写文引擎：用独立 DeepSeek key 分流并发生成草稿/细纲/点子，设定与伏笔管理、语义向量检索、书库（饲料区）、用量总账、机械校对与本地连载计划。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-appearance
plugins.author: TQSY114514
plugins.description: Appearance customization for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, wallpaper and video backgrounds, translucency and glassmorphism.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观自定义:主题调色、壁纸与视频背景、半透明与毛玻璃。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-chart
plugins.author: Max-Samson
plugins.description: Token, cost, and balance dashboard under the composer: live indicator plus zero-dependency SVG charts for per-turn usage, estimated cost, and DeepSeek account balance.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方的用量/成本/余额仪表盘：实时指标指示器 + 零依赖 SVG 用量图表，按轮次统计用量、估算成本并实时查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。

plugins.name: dsh-ux
plugins.author: jiangnanquan
plugins.description: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.
plugins.description_zh: Solarized 浅色主题、紧凑布局、思考/工具链折叠胶囊，以及余额、本轮成本与用量看板的 DSH Web 界面增强插件。

plugins.name: dsh-vision
plugins.author: 54xkeee
plugins.description: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
plugins.description_zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图插件：默认走豆包 Web（零成本、免 API key，经 Windows CDP 桥接驱动已登录 Chrome），另有反重力额度（flash/pro）与 Gemini 降级通道；档位自动升级、视觉证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

plugins.name: dsh-web-archive
plugins.author: renat3u
plugins.description: Collapse noisy messages (Think, Bash, etc.) in conversations.
plugins.description_zh: 折叠对话中的 Think、Bash 等「无用消息」。

plugins.name: dsh-webui-auth
plugins.author: Yuuz12
plugins.description: WebUI authentication enforced at the HTTP/transport layer: four-layer login gate (resources, plugin bundles, /api, WebSocket), server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies.
plugins.description_zh: WebUI 身份认证：HTTP/传输层强制登录（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 四层防护），服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie。

plugins.name: hermes-dsh-collab
plugins.author: Cavan-Ou
plugins.description: Hook DeepSeek Harness into a Hermes pipeline: dispatch-spec template, model-tier routing, orchestrator-run quality gates, git single-writer rule, as a SKILL.md pack (bundle installable).
plugins.description_zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进 Hermes 管线：派单 spec 模板、模型档位路由、质量门、git 唯一写者约定，SKILL.md 技能包（bundle 可安装）。

plugins.name: SumSec-Skills
plugins.author: SummerSec
plugins.description: Multi-platform Agent Skills monorepo that mounts as a DeepSeek Harness profile bundle, exposing Chinese writing, Git, plugin-dev, taste, and semantic-linter skills.
plugins.description_zh: 多平台 Agent Skills 集合，作为 DeepSeek Harness profile bundle 挂载，提供中文写作、Git、插件开发、Taste 与语义边界检测等 Skill。

plugins.name: DeepSeek-Harness-Pet
plugins.author: minybear
plugins.description: Codex-style desktop pet: a floating animated sprite in the corner that mirrors the agent's running state (working, waiting, failed, done).
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格桌面宠物：右下角悬浮动画精灵，随 agent 运行状态实时变化（工作、等待、报错、完成）。

plugins.name: ds-api-usage
plugins.author: Sev7een
plugins.description: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置页展示 DeepSeek API 余额与最近 24 小时用量，包括估算消费、Token、请求次数和按小时时间线。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-team-room
plugins.author: ishuowang
plugins.description: Coordinate independent DSH Sessions and provider-backed members without merging their histories, using persistent native Rooms with identity-bound leading `@` mentions, direct delivery, broadcasts, and leader-scoped controls.
plugins.description_zh: 在不合并对话历史的前提下，将多个独立 DSH Session 与 provider-backed 成员组成持久原生 Room，支持绑定精确成员身份的行首 `@` 提及、定向投递、广播和 Leader 权限控制。

plugins.name: dsh-annotate
plugins.author: BrambleXu
plugins.description: Select browser elements directly during Vibe Coding and send structured visual feedback to the DeepSeek Harness Agent.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 Vibe Coding 的浏览器元素标注插件：直接选取页面元素，并将结构化视觉反馈发送给 DeepSeek Harness Agent。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-llm
plugins.author: Letter2025
plugins.description: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
plugins.description_zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

plugins.name: dsh-archived-sessions
plugins.author: MuWinds
plugins.description: Archived-session management: browse archived sessions, unarchive them, or clear them out.
plugins.description_zh: 归档会话管理：浏览已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与清空。

plugins.name: dsh-atomgit
plugins.author: xiongjiamu
plugins.description: AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: six built-in AtomGit skills (plan issues, implement issues, review PRs, merge PRs, publish CLI releases, mirror to GitHub) plus ag CLI integration and platform-hosted MCP tools for repos, branches, issues, PRs, and search.
plugins.description_zh: AtomGit 插件包：内置六个 AtomGit 技能（Issue 规划、Issue 实现、PR 审查、PR 合并、CLI 版本发布、GitHub 镜像），并集成 ag CLI 与平台托管的 MCP 工具（仓库/分支/Issue/PR/搜索）。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-approve
plugins.author: Jiao-XXX
plugins.description: Adds an `auto` permission preset between workspace-write and danger-full-access: a classifier grants routine sandbox escalations once, while dangerous or uncertain requests still go to a human.
plugins.description_zh: 在 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间增加 `auto` 权限档：分类器一次性放行例行沙箱升级，危险或不确定的操作仍转人工审批。

plugins.name: dsh-balance
plugins.author: LemCAE
plugins.description: DeepSeek account balance and current-session spend estimate in a top-bar chip and settings card, with pause-aware auto-refresh, an editable official price table, a `deepseek_balance` model tool, and a bilingual UI.
plugins.description_zh: 顶栏徽章与设置卡片展示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话预估花费：暂停感知的自动刷新、可编辑官方价格表、`deepseek_balance` 模型工具与中英文界面。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-tide
plugins.author: huanyuLv
plugins.description: DeepSeek account balance and session cost under the composer, with a live peak/off-peak pricing badge (Beijing time), a countdown to the next pricing switch, hover price tables, and usage advice.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话花费，余额前带峰/谷价格徽章（北京时间）与距切换倒计时，悬停看两档单价明细与使用建议。

plugins.name: dsh-blue-whale
plugins.author: starslittle
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
plugins.description_zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

plugins.name: dsh-blue-whale
plugins.author: starslittle
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
plugins.description_zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

plugins.name: dsh-browser
plugins.author: anweat
plugins.description: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.
plugins.description_zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

plugins.name: dsh-change-review
plugins.author: cirelir
plugins.description: Session change-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session and renders line-level diffs with customizable colors, with session isolation, subagent aggregation, and SSE live updates.
plugins.description_zh: 会话修改审查插件：追踪会话内 write/edit 工具调用并展示 diff 对比；会话隔离、子代理聚合、SSE 实时推送、角标与颜色自定义。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-timeline
plugins.author: jjxjjjjiik-bot
plugins.description: 1:1 port of DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav): hover-expandable rail, reading-position highlight, click-to-jump.
plugins.description_zh: 1:1 复刻 DeepSeek 官网右侧对话导航栏（ScrollNav）：悬停展开面板、阅读位置高亮、点击跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-chatnode-wechat
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via the iLink gateway: text both ways, session switching, progress digests, and numbered approval prompts.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 iLink 网关在微信里与 DSH agent 聊天、监控与审批：双向文本、会话切换、进度摘要与编号审批提示。

plugins.name: dsh-claude-move
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).
plugins.description_zh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

plugins.name: dsh-composer-history
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
plugins.description_zh: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 再加智能输入层——跨会话片段库（/save、/load）、带变量的提示词模板、复用洞察与压缩摘要高亮。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-vision
plugins.author: siegfly
plugins.description: A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.
plugins.description_zh: 视觉语言网关：注册支持图片输入的 DeepSeek provider 路由，图片先由可配置 VL 模型（默认 Qwen-VL）描述成文字再发送。

plugins.name: dsh-explorer#dsh-explorer
plugins.author: No-PRM
plugins.description: Git-first file-tree sidebar for the DSH web GUI: VS Code-style indent guides, M/A/U/D/R git decorations, HEAD-vs-worktree diff preview, media preview, and drag-to-reference (files/folders/selected code with line numbers) — pure plugin.
plugins.description_zh: Git 优先的文件树侧栏：VS Code 风格层级线、M/A/U/D/R git 状态装饰、HEAD 与工作区对照预览、媒体预览、拖拽引用（文件/文件夹/选中代码带行号）—— 纯插件。

plugins.name: dsh-file-claim
plugins.author: Nwflower
plugins.description: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
plugins.description_zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

plugins.name: dsh-file-upload
plugins.author: a903067276-rgb
plugins.description: One upload button plus drag-and-drop files into the conversation as local paths: save to the project's uploads/, path text into the input box, works with any vision tool.
plugins.description_zh: 统一上传按钮 + 拖拽文件直进对话：文件保存到项目 uploads/，路径文本自动进输入框，可配合任意视觉工具看图。

plugins.name: dsh-github-login
plugins.author: Noob-stupid
plugins.description: Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.
plugins.description_zh: 零终端的 GitHub 可视化登录插件：窗口内完成设备码授权，令牌同步进 gh CLI，附宿主端状态与唤起接口。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-mcp-server
plugins.author: chushixixin
plugins.description: MCP server that lets any MCP client drive the Harness agent.
plugins.description_zh: MCP server 让任意 MCP 客户端驱动 Harness agent。

plugins.name: dsh-im
plugins.author: xmanrui
plugins.description: Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness by scanning QR codes (supports Feishu, Weixin, DingTalk, and more).
plugins.description_zh: 通过扫码把IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉等）。

plugins.name: dsh-inspect
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop toolset.
plugins.description_zh: 发现问题→修复交付→质量复查的对抗式闭环工具集。

plugins.name: dsh-Kingdom
plugins.author: lusblead
plugins.description: Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review task loop where Worker claims never auto-complete (Claim ≠ Fact), with a local GUI operations console.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

plugins.name: dsh-mc-agent
plugins.author: hellosky983
plugins.description: AI-assisted Minecraft for DeepSeek Harness: drive an autonomous Mineflayer agent (survival, mining, chat, live map) with vision/control tools, plus a built-in launcher (Microsoft sign-in, version download, game launch).
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 辅助 Minecraft：驱动自主的 Mineflayer 代理（生存、挖矿、聊天、实时地图）与视觉/控制工具，另内置启动器（微软登录、版本下载、游戏启动）。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-manager
plugins.author: Js2Hou
plugins.description: Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页 MCP 可视化管理插件：在「设置 → MCP」中查看/新增/删除/启停 MCP 服务器，实时显示连接状态与工具数。

plugins.name: dsh-mmx-bridge
plugins.author: welsione
plugins.description: MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).
plugins.description_zh: MiniMax 多模态桥接：一个 `mmx_bridge` 工具覆盖图片理解/生成、视频、语音合成、音乐、翻唱、联网搜索与用量查询；可选接管 `web_search`/`read_image`；对话流直接内嵌播放器与图片预览（npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`）。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-gui-agent
plugins.author: kunjinkao-os
plugins.description: Android GUI Agent with ADB screenshots, compact UI hierarchy grounding, verified iterative actions, approvals, and a Mobile Web view.
plugins.description_zh: Android GUI Agent：ADB 截图、压缩 UI hierarchy 定位、逐步动作验证、审批和 Mobile Web 视图。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.description: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes editing, and search/filter over the installed catalog.
plugins.description_zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-msg-nav
plugins.author: SherUnlocked-4869
plugins.description: Conversation node navigation rail for the DSH Web UI: one dash per user message on the right edge, reading-position tracking, hover preview card, click-to-jump with highlight line, sliding window, and auto-hide.

plugins.name: dsh-webchatlike

plugins.name: dsh-whale-animation

plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 回合状态旁的 60 帧随主题适配的单色鲸鱼深潜动画：传播式水面、无缝闭环、资源内嵌、减少动态效果 PNG 回退，且随生命周期完整清理。
