plugins.name: dsh-mcp-lens
plugins.author: labmimors
plugins.description: Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway that searches large remote catalogs through `mcp_search`, then invokes exact schemas through `mcp_call` with lazy connections and bounded caches.
plugins.description_zh: 渐进披露 MCP 网关：用 `mcp_search` 检索大型远程工具目录，再由 `mcp_call` 按精确 schema 调用，并采用惰性连接与有界缓存。

plugins.name: dsh-meme
plugins.author: yyh-001
plugins.description: Chat meme stickers: text-only send, mood auto-send, QQ/WeChat-style picker, auto-learn, custom packs.
plugins.description_zh: 聊天表情包：纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、像 QQ/微信 一样发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包。

plugins.name: dsh-message-preview
plugins.author: asukasec
plugins.description: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧用户消息导航条，根据消息数量与可用高度自适应排布导航块，并支持悬停预览、键盘操作与点击跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-gate
plugins.author: Bernardxu123
plugins.description: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).
plugins.description_zh: 局域网手机访问网关：独立子进程反向代理 + 首次访问审批 + 设备令牌绑定 + 限流 + 手机端紧凑排版注入（输入区权限/模型小胶囊、randomUUID polyfill）。

plugins.name: dsh-multi-folder
plugins.author: AngelosZou
plugins.description: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories, configurable from the session header and the new-session page.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 项目提供副工作目录：agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，同时对已配置的副目录获得同等读写/执行权限，可在会话头部与新会话页配置。

plugins.name: dsh-navigation-bar
plugins.author: kelearns
plugins.description: Piano-key in-conversation navigation for the Web UI: one key per user message with hover ladder, message-preview tooltip, and active-message highlight; click to smooth-scroll.
plugins.description_zh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-net-proxy
plugins.author: mafeis
plugins.description: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
plugins.description_zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-windows
plugins.author: SeverusZh
plugins.description: Windows notifications, zero dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: Windows 通知，零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-oh-my-theme
plugins.author: zhxqc
plugins.description: Web theme and file workspace plugin with global typography controls, @file mentions, a project file tree, Markdown preview, and a resizable side panel.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 主题与文件工作台：全局字体设置、@ 文件引用、项目文件树、Markdown 预览和可拖拽侧边面板。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-quota
plugins.author: GLFzr
plugins.description: OpenCode Go quota ring: click-to-cycle progress ring (5h/weekly/monthly) left of the model selector, colored by urgency, with reset countdowns on hover.
plugins.description_zh: 模型选择器左侧的 OpenCode Go 额度圆环：点击循环切换 5 小时/每周/每月用量窗口，按紧急程度着色（绿/蓝/橙/红），悬停显示百分比与重置倒计时。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
plugins.author: v587d
plugins.description: OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly windows with reset countdowns) in the composer dock, with a built-in credential editor.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框上方 dock 显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（5h 滚动/每周/每月窗口与重置倒计时），内置凭据编辑器。

plugins.name: dsh-opencodego-usage
plugins.author: BeiZi6
plugins.description: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials.
plugins.description_zh: OpenCodeGo 剩余额度监视器：输入框右下角呼吸指示灯（按剩余额度绿/黄/红），液态玻璃面板显示滚动/周/月用量窗口与重置时间，每 30 秒自动刷新，API Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据。

plugins.name: dsh-pets
plugins.author: hellosz
plugins.description: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.
plugins.description_zh: Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-anydoc
plugins.author: beancookie
plugins.description: Registers @firecrawl/anydoc as an `anydoc` tool for the Agent, converting Word/PPT/Excel/PDF/EPUB and other document formats into GitHub-Flavored Markdown.
plugins.description_zh: 将 @firecrawl/anydoc 作为 anydoc 工具注册给 Agent，把 Word/PPT/Excel/PDF/EPUB 等多种文档格式转换为 GitHub-Flavored Markdown。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-guide
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: A plugin-development knowledge base packaged as on-demand agent skills: official constraints, task workflows, API references, and community gotchas.
plugins.description_zh: 插件开发知识库打包为按需加载的 agent 技能：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-net-access
plugins.author: Gumiho12345
plugins.description: Net Access permission mode: keeps workspace-write protection while making curl.exe HTTPS work inside the sandbox (Windows).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 net-access 权限模式：文件写保护不变，沙箱内 curl.exe 可用 HTTPS（Windows）。

plugins.name: dsh-scrape-webpage
plugins.author: 131CDA1
plugins.description: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top keywords; can download content images to the session workspace for vision analysis and dispatch them to registered analyzers via the scrape.imageAnalyzer service.
plugins.description_zh: 抓取任意 http/https 网页，提取标题、描述、正文、标题结构与链接，输出字符/词数、阅读时长、语言等统计与高频关键词；支持下载内容图片到会话工作区供视觉分析，并通过 scrape.imageAnalyzer 服务分发给已注册的识图分析器。

plugins.name: dsh-self-improved
plugins.author: madage
plugins.description: Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin for DSH: L0 capture → L1 memory extraction → L2 scene grouping → L3 user persona, auto recall injection, skill synthesis, fully local (SQLite FTS5 + jieba, optional vector recall).
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆与自进化插件：L0 对话捕获 → L1 记忆提取 → L2 场景归纳 → L3 用户画像，自动召回注入 + 技能合成，纯本地（SQLite FTS5 + jieba，可选向量召回）。

plugins.name: dsh-session-link
plugins.author: PwnKY
plugins.description: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
plugins.description_zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

plugins.name: dsh-skin-manager
plugins.author: xiaoyangcheng84-svg
plugins.description: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

plugins.name: dsh-skin-universe#dsh-web-ui-all
plugins.author: springbrand-lab
plugins.description: Web GUI bundle for DSH: a task board with cron scheduling, a Git branch graph, a file and change side panel, an SSH terminal with SFTP and port forwarding, QR-paired mobile remote control, a desktop companion, live token statistics, and five installable themes.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 全家桶：带定时调度的任务看板、Git 分支图、文件与变更侧栏、支持 SFTP 与端口转发的 SSH 终端、扫码配对的手机远程控制、桌面宠物、实时 token 统计，以及五套可安装主题。

plugins.name: dsh-speak
plugins.author: Alan2Z
plugins.description: Voice-announce the final reply on Windows (SAPI5 natural voices) and macOS (system voice); skips reasoning and tool calls, one-line npm install.
plugins.description_zh: 语音播报 agent 最终回复：Windows SAPI5 自然语音 / macOS 系统语音，自动跳过思考与工具调用，npm 一行安装。

plugins.name: dsh-status-bar
plugins.author: Starlight-bananice
plugins.description: A configurable 17-segment session status bar for the dsh composer dock with live TPS, per-model cost estimation, and a usage & cost dialog.
plugins.description_zh: 输入栏下可配置的 17 段会话状态栏，提供实时 TPS、按模型分别计价的费用估算，以及用量与费用弹窗。

plugins.name: dsh-task-dag
plugins.author: LeemanCheung
plugins.description: Projection-driven live DAG for a Session's subagents and durable workflows: status and navigation, deterministic deep-chain layout, fit/pan canvas controls, and current-session node rearrangement.
plugins.description_zh: 由投影驱动的会话子代理与持久工作流实时 DAG：状态与节点导航、深层链路确定性布局、适应/平移画布，以及当前会话内节点拖动重排。

plugins.name: dsh-taskboard
plugins.author: cloader
plugins.description: Task board for DSH: create tasks with project and model assignment, run them manually or on cron schedules; new sessions in a project automatically pick up its todo tasks and move them to in-review when done.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 的任务看板：创建任务时可指定项目与模型，支持手动执行及定时执行；项目内新建会话会自动拉取该项目的待办任务，完成后移至待验收。

plugins.name: dsh-tavily
plugins.author: SZMY-haruhi
plugins.description: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索：设置开关、默认无 Key，以及连通测试。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-firefly
plugins.author: Liu-ZA-81
plugins.description: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.
plugins.description_zh: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage
plugins.author: LaoYueHanNi
plugins.description: Per-request model token usage tracked to per-day JSONL files, with a stats page in Web settings: daily trend chart, per-model breakdown, and date/model filters.
plugins.description_zh: 按请求持久化模型 token 用量，Web 设置「Token 用量」统计页：按日趋势图、按模型明细表、日期/模型筛选。

plugins.name: dsh-trail#bundle
plugins.author: ayahunter
plugins.description: Replaces the Web GUI trajectory tab with a new-user-friendly round-by-round storyline, plain-language tool labels, category filters and fuzzy search.
plugins.description_zh: 把 Web GUI 的轨迹页签替换为新手友好的回合故事线：工具名通俗中文化，支持类别筛选与模糊搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-billing
plugins.description: Usage and cost statistics with peak/off-peak pricing after the 2026-08-17 rate change, a floating summary panel, per-session breakdowns, and a day/week/month/year/all usage heatmap.
plugins.description_zh: 用量与消费统计：8/17 调价前后峰谷计费，主界面汇总面板、按会话明细与日/周/月/年/累计用量热力图。

plugins.name: dsh-verification-receipt
plugins.description: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
plugins.description_zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

plugins.name: dsh-virtual-product-team
plugins.author: songoao25
plugins.description: Virtual product team agent preset: user-led conversation walks you through the full 12-step pipeline from idea to shipped, promoted and operated product, with staged gates and per-stage skills.
plugins.description_zh: 虚拟产品团队模式：用户主导式对话，由虚拟产品团队带你走完 12 环节完整流水线——从想法到发布、宣传、运营的产品全流程，阶段关卡制，内置 8 个阶段技能。

plugins.name: dsh-web-attention-badge
plugins.author: Luaphes
plugins.description: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
plugins.description_zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

plugins.name: dsh-web-mobile-fix
plugins.author: AcidGr
plugins.description: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 移动端布局修复：窄屏下设置面板全屏化、插件导航单行排满、侧边栏全屏、弹层居中、会话日志按钮图标化。

plugins.name: dsh-window#kit
plugins.author: ZichengGurrr
plugins.description: All-in-one bundle for DSH: the native Windows desktop window (WebView2), DeepEye vision (GLM-4V-Flash), and voice input (mic button) in a single install.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 三件套全家桶：Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）+ DeepEye 视觉（GLM-4V-Flash）+ 语音输入（麦克风按钮），一条命令装齐。

plugins.name: dsh-window#plugin
plugins.author: ZichengGurrr
plugins.description: Native Windows desktop window (WebView2) for DSH: one-command install, auto-fetches the app zip from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）：一键安装，自动从 GitHub Releases 下载应用 zip、创建桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-search
plugins.author: tsonglew
plugins.description: VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.
plugins.description_zh: VS Code 式工作区关键词搜索 Tab（better-sidebar 扩展）：同时匹配文件名与文件内容，结果按文件分组带行号，点击在侧栏编辑器打开。

plugins.name: gongwen-skill
plugins.author: linhut
plugins.description: Chinese government document processing toolkit: GB/T 9704 format check, auto-fix, content revision (red annotation + strikethrough), template generation, Markdown-to-docx, and document header/footer/page-number injection for 24 official document types.
plugins.description_zh: 中文公文全流程处理工具：GB/T 9704 格式检查、自动修复、内容修订（红色标注+删除线）、模板生成、Markdown 转公文、版头/版记/页码注入，覆盖通知/请示/报告/函/会议纪要等 24 类公文。

plugins.name: graphlint#integrations/dsh
plugins.author: AngelosZou
plugins.description: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

plugins.name: harness-ui-enhancer
plugins.author: Physicolor
plugins.description: Web UI polish layer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens; live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale and UI font stack.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 强化层：规范化官方未完善、设计语言矛盾的界面，协调已装插件间的样式冲突并统一视觉语言（全部遵循官方设计令牌）；支持实时自定义对话宽度、markdown 字号、工作区缩放与 UI 字体。

plugins.name: ikun-theme-skin
plugins.author: AKS1st
plugins.description: IKUN fandom skin for the DSH Web UI: star-blue and black-gold palettes in the system theme list, full-screen photo wallpaper rotation, a music box, and a send-button voice line.
plugins.description_zh: ikun 主题皮肤：星蓝昼/夜与背带裤黑金三套配色接入系统主题列表，全屏照片壁纸轮播、音乐盒与发送音效。

plugins.name: NoLetMe
plugins.author: Yuer6327
plugins.description: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
plugins.description_zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

plugins.name: nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness
plugins.author: nowledge-co
plugins.description: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.
plugins.description_zh: 给所有 AI 工具和 Agent 共用的一层记忆：注入 Context Bundle、提示时检索、MCP 工具与回合结束 DSH 线程捕获。

plugins.name: qdd
plugins.author: BillyChen123
plugins.description: Question-Driven Discovery research workflow for DeepSeek Harness with a QDD Agent Preset, durable Human and Auto runs, and an auditable research panel.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Question-Driven Discovery 科研工作流，提供 QDD Agent Preset、持久化 Human 和 Auto 运行，以及可审计的研究面板。

plugins.name: qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit
plugins.description: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.
plugins.description_zh: 把工具结果与会话事件的 receipt 写入本地哈希链 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数、结果正文或原始会话 ID。

plugins.name: TMCRA-Agent-Memory
plugins.author: reshuibuduo
plugins.description: Technical-preview local graph memory for DSH and Codex: recalls owner-global and current-project evidence before each turn, writes USER and ASSISTANT records separately, and preserves project, session, actor, and source provenance for a visual atlas and cited knowledge pages.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 与 Codex 的技术预览版本机图记忆：每轮前从用户全局与当前项目作用域召回证据，分别保存 USER 与 ASSISTANT 记录，并保留项目、会话、角色和来源信息，用于可视化图谱与带证据引用的知识页。

plugins.name: tuning-engines-cli#tuningengines-dsh-plugin
plugins.author: cerebrixos-org
plugins.description: Exports metadata-only DSH turn, model, tool, approval, retry, and error events to Tuning Engines for governed traces, policy evaluation, cost analysis, and Work Session review, with a disk-backed retry queue.
plugins.description_zh: 将不含原始内容的 DSH 回合、模型、工具、审批、重试和错误事件导出到 Tuning Engines，用于受治理的追踪、策略评估、成本分析和 Work Session 审阅，并提供磁盘持久化重试队列。

plugins.name: upstream-radar
plugins.author: MicroMilo
plugins.description: Always-on dependency security for DSH plugins: tracks exact installed paths, OSV vulnerabilities, npm releases, and breaking-change signals, then routes project evidence to a DSH Agent.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 插件的常驻依赖安全监控：追踪实际安装路径、OSV 漏洞、npm 发布和破坏性更新信号，再把项目证据交给 DSH Agent。

plugins.name: codex-to-dsh-pet#dsh-codex-pet
plugins.author: Signalight
plugins.description: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页 GUI 实时桌宠：可把任何 Codex 桌宠图集（webp/png/gif，v1/v2 自动识别）转换为 DSH 中可拖拽的悬浮桌宠。支持拖拽/挥手/跳跃，v2 桌宠的眼睛实时追踪活动鼠标，随 agent 状态切换姿势；进度气泡反映工作状态；「设置 → 桌宠」图形界面可导入、切换与调整桌宠；内置一只原创示例桌宠（娜斯佳），用户桌宠存放在 ~/.dsh/pets。

plugins.name: deepseek-vision#plugins/dsh-plugin-deepseek-vision
plugins.author: GOU-GEE
plugins.description: Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
plugins.description_zh: 面向纯文本 DeepSeek 的视觉 MCP + DSH 插件：analyze_image / analyze_clipboard / compare_images / vision_status 四个工具、可视化配置页、默认免费 GLM-4.6V-Flash、结果缓存与限流容错，Key 不入日志。

plugins.name: dsh-101
plugins.author: bill9109
plugins.description: Document reading mode for DSH.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 文档阅读模式。

plugins.name: dsh-article-publish
plugins.author: yangyongzhen
plugins.description: Publish articles to CSDN / Juejin / CNBlog directly from the session, no external server.
plugins.description_zh: 会话内直接发布文章到 CSDN / 掘金 / 博客园，无外部服务。

plugins.name: dsh-auth-gateway
plugins.author: xbzbing
plugins.description: Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.
plugins.description_zh: 为 dsh web 提供密码与 TOTP 双因素认证网关：登录前拦截全部 HTTP/WebSocket 请求，含按来源锁定、全局限流与一次性备份代码。

plugins.name: dsh-auto
plugins.author: simon300000
plugins.description: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the Web UI, using a fresh restricted Reviewer Agent to allow or deny each approval request.
plugins.description_zh: 为 WebUI 增加 Auto Approve 权限档位，由全新且受限的审查 Agent 逐次允许或拒绝审批请求。

plugins.name: dsh-auxiliary
plugins.author: dsh-plugins
plugins.description: Dedicated model routes, tools, and system guidance for vision, compaction, reviews, subagents, titles, and image generation.
plugins.description_zh: 为视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题与图片生成提供独立的模型路由、工具与系统提示。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-float
plugins.author: x2802490130-prog
plugins.description: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

plugins.name: dsh-boot-guard
plugins.author: SaiSenBox
plugins.description: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.
plugins.description_zh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

plugins.name: dsh-calculator
plugins.author: bobcat848
plugins.description: DeepSeek API spend (current session and all sessions) and account balance in the aside panel, with official pricing and peak/off-peak support.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧面板展示 DeepSeek API 费用（当前会话 + 全部会话累计）与账户余额，内置官方计价与峰谷计价支持。

plugins.name: dsh-claude-cli
plugins.author: katsos
plugins.description: LLM provider that runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI as the model backend, so requests go through an existing Claude subscription instead of a metered API key; native tool calls are bridged over MCP.
plugins.description_zh: LLM 供应商：把本机已安装的 Claude Code CLI 作为模型后端，请求走已订阅的 Claude 账号，无需按量计费的 API key；原生工具调用经 MCP 桥接。

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-custom
plugins.author: yoli-mi
plugins.description: Web theming (wallpaper, glass, accent, presets), keyboard shortcuts, usage stats, a plugin marketplace, a floating history strip, and user-message Markdown rendering.
plugins.description_zh: Web 外观主题定制（壁纸、毛玻璃、强调色、预设）、键盘快捷键、用量统计、插件市场、浮动历史条与用户消息 Markdown 渲染。

plugins.name: dsh-cloak-browser
plugins.author: maxiaovivi
plugins.description: CloakBrowser-powered native browser tools with per-agent isolated sessions, bounded snapshots, ref-based interaction, screenshots, and safe routing.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 CloakBrowser 的原生浏览器工具：按 Agent 隔离会话，提供有界快照、ref 交互、截图与安全路由。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-shim
plugins.author: OpenTritium
plugins.description: Simulates a Codex environment for selected model routes to improve GPT-family model tool-call success.
plugins.description_zh: 为选定的模型路由模拟 Codex 环境，以提升 GPT 系列模型的工具调用成功率。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-tools
plugins.author: SPYQWER1
plugins.description: Codex-backed `web_search`, `image_gen`, and `image_vision` tools for DeepSeek Harness, reusing ChatGPT OAuth login state.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 Codex 的 `web_search`、`image_gen` 与 `image_vision` 工具，复用 ChatGPT OAuth 登录态为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索、生图与识图能力。

plugins.name: dsh-composer-expand
plugins.description: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 输入框展开/收起：composer 工具行新增 ⬆/⬇ 按钮，一键把输入框扩大到 70vh 高度，方便写长 prompt。

plugins.name: dsh-config-manager
plugins.author: xiajiajun516
plugins.description: One-click backup, export, import and migration of a whole DSH config: settings, plugins, MCP, skills and workspaces. Secrets are excluded by default and, if you opt in, are AES-256-GCM encrypted rather than written in the clear; imports preview first and auto-backup with rollback, profiles hold multiple setups, and remote sync pushes portable config through a private Git repo with secrets excluded.
plugins.description_zh: 一键备份、导出、导入与迁移整套 DSH 配置：设置、插件、MCP、技能与工作区。密钥默认不导出；若选择包含，则以 AES-256-GCM 加密而非明文写出。导入先预览、自动备份并可回滚，profile 可保存多套配置，远程同步经私有 Git 仓库推送可移植配置且不含密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-continual-harness
plugins.author: jasen215
plugins.description: Continual self-refinement loop: persistent memory, periodic review-and-refine, cross-session shared knowledge, and automatic rollback through a model-callable harness_refine tool.
plugins.description_zh: 持续自我优化闭环：持久记忆、周期评审与自动优化、跨会话共享知识、失败自动回滚，由模型可调用的 harness_refine 工具驱动。

plugins.name: dsh-cowork#dsh
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Bounded, cell-addressed `doc_read`/`doc_write` for xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb, plus an MCP server and CLI.
plugins.description_zh: doc_read/doc_write：以有界、单元格寻址的方式读写 xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb，另附 MCP 服务器与 CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-deeplink
plugins.author: qyw233
plugins.description: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.
plugins.description_zh: `?session=` / `?workspace=` 深链直达指定项目对话。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-billing
plugins.author: Jolly-J
plugins.description: DeepSeek account balance and per-session cost card in the sidebar foot.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏底部 DeepSeek 账户余额显示与会话费用估算卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-desk-pet
plugins.author: anneheartrecord
plugins.description: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-windowos
plugins.author: RAFOLIE
plugins.description: Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.
plugins.description_zh: Windows 托盘桌面壳：自动从 GitHub Releases 安装并升级 exe、创建应用与网页端两个桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

plugins.name: dsh-ding
plugins.author: CAOGGL
plugins.description: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).
plugins.description_zh: 对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

plugins.name: dsh-doublecheck
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Engineering-discipline guard: grill the requirements before the first edit, enforce red/green test evidence gates, and audit the delivery with a forked adversary (grill-requirements skill + tool-policy gates).
plugins.description_zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审（grill-requirements 技能 + 工具策略门）。

plugins.name: dsh-doublecheck
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Engineering-discipline guard: requirements grill before the first edit, red/green test-evidence gates, forked adversary review, and a delivery report with a per-dimension verification workflow.
plugins.description_zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审，并汇总交付报告与逐维度核对。

plugins.name: dsh-douyin
plugins.author: AnacondaKC
plugins.description: Short-video sidebar: native player, series navigation, precise history replay.
plugins.description_zh: 侧栏短视频：原生播放器、系列导航、精确历史回放。

plugins.name: dsh-eli-mode#packages/eli-mode
plugins.author: CeilCelia
plugins.description: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
plugins.description_zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

plugins.name: dsh-explorer
plugins.author: No-PRM
plugins.description: Git-first file-tree sidebar for the DSH web GUI: VS Code-style indent guides, M/A/U/D/R git decorations, HEAD-vs-worktree diff preview, media preview, and drag-to-reference (files/folders/selected code with line numbers) — pure plugin.
plugins.description_zh: Git 优先的文件树侧栏：VS Code 风格层级线、M/A/U/D/R git 状态装饰、HEAD 与工作区对照预览、媒体预览、拖拽引用（文件/文件夹/选中代码带行号）—— 纯插件。

plugins.name: dsh-expression
plugins.author: yyh-001
plugins.description: Meme search, the fun way: describe the vibe, and the agent finds and sends a real meme that actually fits.
plugins.description_zh: 陪 AI 斗图的搞笑插件：说个感觉，AI 帮你搜到、发出那张恰到好处的真实表情包。

plugins.name: dsh-ffmpeg
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Seven video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif) on the official subprocess service: shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 视频处理七工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/GIF），官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-file-mount
plugins.author: acefun29
plugins.description: Incremental file mounting with read dedupe: mounted line ranges are never re-sent to the model.
plugins.description_zh: 文件增量挂载与重复读取去重：已挂载行范围不重复进上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-finance
plugins.author: zhang787jun
plugins.description: Financial research workflow and portfolio risk tools with source discipline for current market facts.
plugins.description_zh: 金融研究工作流与组合风控工具，对当前市场事实强制来源与时间戳边界。

plugins.name: dsh-frostfin
plugins.author: pzc2004
plugins.description: Use Kimi Code as the DSH agent loop over ACP, with approvals, slash commands, and local/remote (ssh+tmux) session attach.
plugins.description_zh: 把 DSH 的 agent loop 换成 Kimi Code（ACP 直连）：审批、斜杠命令、本地与远程（ssh+tmux）会话接入。

plugins.name: dsh-guardian
plugins.author: cdxiaodong
plugins.description: Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 安全护栏：拦截并审计所有工具调用，命中敏感操作就要求人工确认。

plugins.name: dsh-guide-dog
plugins.author: AtropinolTT
plugins.description: MiniMax-powered multimodal plugin: real-time voice call mode (streaming conversation, floating dock UI), voice mode and mic voice input, plus image/video/music/speech generation and vision inspection tools.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 MiniMax 的多模态插件：实时语音通话模式（流式对话、悬浮胶囊 UI）、语音模式与麦克风语音输入，并提供图像/视频/音乐/语音生成与视觉检查工具。

plugins.name: dsh-island
plugins.author: cdxiaodong
plugins.description: Bridge DSH agent sessions, tool calls, and approvals to the CodeIsland macOS notch panel over a Unix socket, with in-panel allow/deny.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 Unix socket 把 DSH agent 的会话、工具调用与审批实时桥接到 CodeIsland macOS 刘海面板，可直接在面板上批准/拒绝。

plugins.name: dsh-lark-bridge
plugins.author: JMOKSZ
plugins.description: Feishu (Lark) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: one-command install, streaming progress cards with a tool panel, ask/approval button cards, attachments, and proactive feishu_send pushes.
plugins.description_zh: 飞书入口插件：一条命令安装，流式进度卡片带工具面板、提问/审批按钮卡片、附件处理与 feishu_send 主动推送。

plugins.name: dsh-learn-everything
plugins.author: cendaifeng
plugins.description: Feynman learning-mode loop rendered as rich HTML lesson cards.
plugins.description_zh: 费曼学习法教学闭环，渲染为富 HTML 教学卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-learning-mode#plugin
plugins.author: CHplus0
plugins.description: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).
plugins.description_zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-vision-bridge
plugins.author: Einskyle
plugins.description: Native LLM-provider vision bridge: images pasted in the chat are described by a vision model (Qwen3-VL via pi-ai/llama.cpp) and the text description is fed to text-only DeepSeek for the reply — image admission, routing and compaction all run through harness-native mechanisms, with an LRU description cache and 503 retry.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek 视觉桥接：注册原生 LLM provider，聊天内粘贴的图片自动由视觉模型（pi-ai/llama.cpp 上的 Qwen3-VL）转成文字描述后交给纯文本 DeepSeek 作答——图片准入、路由与会话压缩全部走 harness 原生机制，带 LRU 描述缓存与 503 重试。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-bridge
plugins.author: Edge-Echo
plugins.description: Curated MCP server bundle: one install brings demo, memory, filesystem, GitHub, Playwright and remote HTTP MCP servers, plus a connectivity verifier tool and CI checks.
plugins.description_zh: 精选 MCP 服务器全家桶：一键接入演示、记忆、文件系统、GitHub、Playwright、远程 HTTP 等服务器，自带连通性验证工具与 CI 检查。

plugins.name: dsh-media-preview
plugins.author: tsonglew
plugins.description: Audio/video FileViewer for dsh-better-sidebar: native inline playback for mp4/webm/mkv/mov and mp3/flac/wav, served by a Range-capable streaming media route.
plugins.description_zh: better-sidebar 音视频预览器：原生播放器内联播放 mp4/webm/mkv/mov 等视频与 mp3/flac/wav 等音频，自带支持 HTTP Range 拖动的流式媒体路由。

plugins.name: dsh-media-skills
plugins.author: akqwpeter-prog
plugins.description: Free vision bridge and image generation for text-only models: paste-image reading, GLM-4V-Flash and Gemini engine failover, ModLens-style structured evidence, and a seeded free vision model route.
plugins.description_zh: 面向纯文本模型的免费视觉桥与生图：粘贴读图、GLM-4V-Flash 与 Gemini 引擎故障转移、modlens 同款结构化证据输出，并自动播种免费视觉模型路由。

plugins.name: dsh-messager
plugins.author: ly6170
plugins.description: Monitors session state in the DSH web app and sends desktop, browser, and third-party notifications for interactions, completions, and errors.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 端监控会话状态，为需要交互、任务完成、任务出错发送桌面 / 浏览器 / 第三方通知。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile
plugins.author: cindyguyuehu123
plugins.description: Use DSH from iPhone/iPad: an explicit-opt-in LAN reverse proxy (Host/Origin rewrite through the loopback trust fence, WebSocket upgrades included), iOS PWA chrome (home-screen icon, standalone meta, viewport-fit), and touch/mobile CSS (safe areas, keyboard lifting, composer row fit).
plugins.description_zh: 让 DSH 在 iPhone/iPad 上可用：显式开启的局域网反向代理（改写 Host/Origin 通过回环信任栅栏，含 WebSocket 升级）、iOS PWA 外壳（主屏幕图标、standalone meta、viewport-fit）、触屏/移动端 CSS（安全区、键盘避让、输入框按钮行适配）。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-hanui
plugins.author: Z-6354
plugins.description: Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端适配：窄屏下把桌面三栏布局改造成触屏友好的手机布局（覆盖式抽屉、可拖拽悬浮按钮、全屏弹窗、上滑加载历史），1024px 断点内生效，桌面端零影响。 — 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-on-complete
plugins.author: pitetow
plugins.description: Desktop notifications for run completion, model questions, and approval requests with per-platform system sounds, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 系统桌面通知：运行结束、模型提问与审批请求即时提醒，三平台提示音，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-observation-journal
plugins.author: Cavan-Ou
plugins.description: Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 零侵入运行事实遥测：每个会话自动把任务/模型档位/工具/失败/时长/状态写入人机共读观测卡并附统计区（纯观察者——零工具、零 LLM、零注入）。

plugins.name: dsh-obsidian
plugins.author: mingzeng21
plugins.description: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through `obsidian_*` tools.
plugins.description_zh: 把 dsh 连接到本地 Obsidian vault：通过 `obsidian_*` 工具搜索、读取、写入、移动与回收笔记。

plugins.name: dsh-office-tools
plugins.author: kw78
plugins.description: Workspace-safe Office tools for agents: create/read Word, create/read/update Excel, and create/read PowerPoint decks with PNG/JPG/GIF image placement.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 agent 的工作区安全 Office 工具集：创建/读取 Word、创建/读取/更新 Excel、创建/读取 PowerPoint，并支持 PNG/JPG/GIF 图片排版。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-usage
plugins.author: vinyumao
plugins.description: OpenCode Go plan usage display for the DSH web GUI: a persistent badge under the composer shows rolling/weekly/monthly usage percents with reset countdowns; click to expand a card; agents can query the balance via the `opencode_go_usage` tool.
plugins.description_zh: OpenCode Go 套餐用量显示：输入框下方常驻徽章显示滚动 / 每周 / 每月用量百分比与重置倒计时，点击展开进度卡片；Agent 可经 `opencode_go_usage` 工具随时查询余额。

plugins.name: dsh-pdf
plugins.author: sunshine-lang
plugins.description: PDF toolbox: extract text, metadata and page ranges via pdfjs-dist.
plugins.description_zh: PDF 工具箱：基于 pdfjs-dist 提取文本、元数据与页码范围。

plugins.name: dsh-permgate
plugins.author: MrWeiCodes
plugins.description: Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with global & per-project allow/deny exceptions, quick-tool defaults, custom rules, a bilingual approval modal with inline diff details, custom rejection reasons and a sandbox-upgrade flow.
plugins.description_zh: 细粒度权限网关：按分类（工作区外目录/命令/读写文件/子代理/重复操作）逐项审查工具调用，全局/项目双级白黑名单、快捷工具默认值、自定义规则，中英文审批弹窗（内联 diff 详情、自定义拒绝意见）与底层沙箱升级流程。

plugins.name: dsh-pilot
plugins.author: guo6x
plugins.description: Zero-dependency browser control: drive a real headless Edge/Chrome over CDP with 8 `pilot_*` tools (navigate/click/type/keys/eval/screenshot) plus a live draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI - text-first snapshots for text-only models, no Playwright, no API key.
plugins.description_zh: 零依赖浏览器操控：agent 通过 CDP 驾驶真实 headless Edge/Chrome（导航/点击/输入/按键/JS/截图，8 个 `pilot_*` 工具），Web GUI 内可拖拽驾驶舱面板实时围观——文本优先快照适配纯文本模型，无需 Playwright、无需 API key。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin
plugins.author: PicGo
plugins.description: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader plugin), via a `picgo_upload` tool and a `/picgo` command.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-call-me
plugins.author: radres
plugins.description: Rings your phone over CallKit: `call_me` and `text_me` tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 CallKit 打电话到你的手机：`call_me` 与 `text_me` 工具，并可在回合结束或等待审批时来电，语音回答转写后送回会话。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-codex
plugins.author: wss534857356
plugins.description: Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.
plugins.description_zh: 使用本地 Codex 登录的 Codex App Server 模型提供方，支持会话复用、Harness 工具桥接、原生动作轨迹和生成图片持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-knowledge-graph
plugins.author: Luke-Yong
plugins.description: A read_graph tool backed by a codebase knowledge graph (CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL relations).
plugins.description_zh: 基于代码库知识图谱的 read_graph 工具（CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL 关系）。

plugins.name: DSH-Plugin-Market
plugins.author: nanshan1995
plugins.description: Alternative plugin market for DSH: curated catalog plus live GitHub browsing, zh/en cross-language search, a fail-closed pre-install static security audit with an install-hook block, and per-plugin README viewing with garbled-encoding repair.
plugins.description_zh: 另一款 DSH 插件市场：精选目录 + GitHub 实时浏览、中英互通搜索、安装前 fail-closed 静态安全审计（拦截安装钩子），每个插件可直接查看 README 且乱码自动修复。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-notify
plugins.author: huguangyu666
plugins.description: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-subhub
plugins.author: kinoward
plugins.description: Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.
plugins.description_zh: 用第三方订阅账户在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用订阅覆盖的模型：文字对话、图片理解、图片生成与图片编辑，可用模型与推理等级随账户自动同步；当前支持 OpenAI / ChatGPT 订阅，更多订阅服务规划中。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-tavily
plugins.description: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-terminal
plugins.author: siberiah2o
plugins.description: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
plugins.description_zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-toggle
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Settings -> Plugins switchboard: every loaded plugin card shows its package description and runtime phase, with fuzzy search and start/stop toggles that never rewrite config files.
plugins.description_zh: 设置→插件开关面板：每个已加载插件的卡片显示简述与运行阶段，支持模糊搜索与运行时启动/关闭（不改写配置文件）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-vetting
plugins.author: truelove-dreamer
plugins.description: Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.
plugins.description_zh: 为了您的电脑安全，装插件前先体检：静态扫描恶意模式（外传/凭据/混淆/持久化）与高权限误用，覆盖传递依赖与官方包哈希基线（防供应链篡改），可选插件工具调用闸。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#pet-bridge
plugins.author: wsxwj123
plugins.description: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time.
plugins.description_zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#skin-gallery
plugins.author: wsxwj123
plugins.description: Nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas with custom skin-pack import, preview, apply, delete, restore-default, and readability fixes for bubbles and code blocks.
plugins.description_zh: 9 个完整 dsh-web-ui 皮肤复刻，支持自定义皮肤包导入、试穿、应用、删除、恢复默认，并修正气泡与代码块可读性。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#theme-gallery
plugins.author: wsxwj123
plugins.description: Fifteen curated theme families plus custom CSS-only themes with import, preview, apply, delete, and restore-default flows that follow the native Light, Dark, and Follow system modes.
plugins.description_zh: 15 个精选主题家族 + CSS-only 自定义主题，支持导入、试穿、应用、删除和恢复默认，跟随 DSH 原生浅色/深色/跟随系统模式。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#turn-scrubber
plugins.author: wsxwj123
plugins.description: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。

plugins.name: dsh-reasoning-slider
plugins.author: qjcnmd
plugins.description: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

plugins.name: dsh-Remote
plugins.author: Blank-not-black
plugins.description: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.
plugins.description_zh: 移动远程控制套件：原生侧边栏入口 + 管理抽屉的 bundle 插件，自带 Bearer 令牌网关自愈（局域网/Tailscale）；Android App 覆盖会话/审批/提问/goal；/fs/* 文件端点（Range 断点续传、2GB 上传）；多服务器测速自动切换；聊天记录离线缓存。

plugins.name: dsh-remote
plugins.author: xgone
plugins.description: Remote access & authentication for DeepSeek Harness web UI: account/password login gate, MFA (TOTP), signed session cookies, role-based access, in-browser directory picker, account management settings, fully localized in English and Chinese.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端远程访问与认证：账号/密码登录门、MFA（TOTP 两步验证）、签名会话 Cookie、基于角色的访问控制、浏览器内目录选择器、账号管理设置页，界面支持中英双语。

plugins.name: dsh-remotion
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Official Remotion skill ported to DSH: programmatic video with React (animation/audio/captions/3D/charts/fonts, 38 rule files).
plugins.description_zh: Remotion 官方移植技能：React 编程式视频（动画/音频/字幕/3D/图表/字体，38 规则文件），安装即用。

plugins.name: dsh-restart
plugins.author: anweat
plugins.description: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。

plugins.name: dsh-rewind
plugins.author: SiriLee
plugins.description: In-place conversation rewind in the same session window without forking (Claude Code /rewind semantics): a per-message ↶ button cuts the model context back to any user message, with an optional Claude-Code-style file restore from disk-persisted before-backups.
plugins.description_zh: 同一会话窗口内的 in-place 对话回退（不 fork，Claude Code /rewind 语义）：每条消息的 ↶ 按钮把模型上下文回退到任意用户消息，可选用磁盘持久化的 before-backups 还原工作区文件。

plugins.name: dsh-rss
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: RSS/Atom subscription management and parsing (rss_list/add/remove/fetch/check), persisted to settings.
plugins.description_zh: RSS/Atom 订阅管理 + 抓取解析（rss_list/add/remove/fetch/check），订阅持久化到 settings。

plugins.name: dsh-session-audit
plugins.author: bwndlct
plugins.description: Session execution analytics: steps, tool calls, failures, repeated actions, token usage and verification signals, rendered as text/Markdown/JSON reports.
plugins.description_zh: 会话执行分析：步骤、工具调用、失败、重复动作、token 用量与验证信号，输出 text/Markdown/JSON 报告。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cleaner
plugins.author: fountunt
plugins.description: Delete sessions from a running web runtime without a restart.
plugins.description_zh: 无需重启即可删除运行中 Web 运行时里的会话。

plugins.name: dsh-session-export
plugins.author: yangyongzhen
plugins.description: Export sessions to Markdown/JSON for review, replay, and per-session cost summaries.
plugins.description_zh: 会话导出为 Markdown/JSON，便于复盘、重放与单会话成本汇总。

plugins.name: dsh-session-timeline
plugins.author: XiLuovo
plugins.description: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
plugins.description_zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-manager
plugins.author: tuogusa
plugins.description: Browse, search, delete, undo-delete, and update user skills from the Web settings panel; checks GitHub/Gitee Releases for newer skill versions.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web 设置面板中浏览、搜索、删除/撤回并更新用户技能，支持从 GitHub/Gitee Release 检查技能更新。

plugins.name: dsh-skin-switcher
plugins.author: zhtx2024
plugins.description: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
plugins.description_zh: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

plugins.name: dsh-slack
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Two-way Slack messaging (notify/channels/inbox/reply) over Socket Mode, no public callback needed.
plugins.description_zh: Slack 双向通信（notify/channels/inbox/reply，Socket Mode 免公网回调）。

plugins.name: dsh-ssh-ops
plugins.author: caoyiwei850
plugins.description: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.
plugins.description_zh: DSH SSH 运维终端：在主对话中直接指挥已连接的服务器（ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect），右侧保留可交互的 xterm.js 终端。

plugins.name: dsh-store
plugins.author: huguangyu666
plugins.description: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove` one-click install, sidebar + settings entry.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

plugins.name: dsh-task-planner
plugins.author: ztl34245881-commits
plugins.description: Task planning with experience muscle-memory: condition-reflex recall of past solutions, LLM capability matching, and auto-persisted lessons.
plugins.description_zh: 带经验肌肉记忆的任务规划：条件反射检索历史方案 + LLM 能力匹配 + 经验自动沉淀。

plugins.name: dsh-testgen
plugins.author: bujue600-arch
plugins.description: Automated unit-test generation: a /testgen command and generate_tests tool that scaffold, run, and fix tests until they pass (LLM + offline template generators; vitest/jest/mocha/node:test).
plugins.description_zh: 自动化单元测试生成：/testgen 命令与 generate_tests 工具，生成、运行并修复测试直至通过（LLM 与离线模板双生成器；支持 vitest/jest/mocha/node:test）。

plugins.name: dsh-tier-router
plugins.author: BruceLanLan
plugins.description: Two-tier model routing: a strong tier plans, advises and reviews while a cheap tier implements, with plan-mode-aware auto routing, a high-impact escalation guard, failure auto-escalation, and subagent tiering.
plugins.description_zh: 双档模型路由：强档负责规划/咨询/评审、弱档负责实现；含计划模式自动路由、高危操作守卫、失败自动升级与子代理分层。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-csv
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Parse/query/aggregate/convert CSV (RFC 4180) with a zero-dependency state-machine parser.
plugins.description_zh: CSV 解析/查询/统计/转换（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-diff
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Structured comparison and unified diffs for text/JSON/CSV/Markdown.
plugins.description_zh: 文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-git
plugins.author: lxj808624
plugins.description: Structured Git tools (status/diff/log/branch/stage/commit) with a destructive-command guard.
plugins.description_zh: 结构化 Git 工具（status/diff/log/branch/stage/commit）+ 破坏性命令安全护栏。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-markdown
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: HTML↔Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, and TOC generation.
plugins.description_zh: HTML↔Markdown 转换、GFM 表格规范化、目录生成。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-search
plugins.author: Letter2025
plugins.description: Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.
plugins.description_zh: Hermes 风格工具搜索与瘦身：渐进式披露，语义搜索/查看/调用长尾工具，核心工具保持直通。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-time
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Strict ISO 8601 parsing, IANA timezone conversion, and UTC calendar arithmetic.
plugins.description_zh: 严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算。

plugins.name: dsh-trajectory-governance
plugins.author: dfycaly98931680
plugins.description: Agent trajectory governance and anomaly diagnosis: rebuilds flat session logs into multi-branch trajectory trees, detects loop deadlock, invalid retry, and goal drift, alerts with cost attribution, one-click interrupt and breakpoint fork via official APIs, independent GUI tab.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 轨迹治理与异常诊断：把平铺会话日志重建为多分支轨迹树，识别循环死锁/无效重试/目标漂移，带成本归因的告警与一键中断/断点分支（官方 API），独立 GUI Tab。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-font
plugins.author: warmwine
plugins.description: Font engine for the Web GUI: system font enumeration, global and per-component font-size tuning with a Spy++-style picker, settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 网页界面字体引擎：系统字体枚举、准星点选的全局与逐组件字号微调、设置页。老花眼友好，自定义字体和页面部件字体和字体大小，支持SPY模式扫UI和其他插件。

plugins.name: dsh-voice
plugins.description: Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.
plugins.description_zh: 语音输入插件：对着麦克风说话，识别后的文字作为普通聊天消息发送（本地模型或浏览器语音识别）。

plugins.name: dsh-weather
plugins.author: sunshine-lang
plugins.description: Weather tool via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).
plugins.description_zh: 天气工具：Open-Meteo 数据（免费，无需 API key）。

plugins.name: dsh-web-remote
plugins.author: godchen520
plugins.description: Access DSH from your phone or anywhere: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel public link + LAN HTTP/HTTPS direct access (auto self-signed cert), token auth, gzip compression, floating phone-icon panel with QR codes, and a NapCat QQ bot channel to fetch the link.
plugins.description_zh: 手机/外网远程访问 DSH：Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 公网链接 + 局域网 HTTP/HTTPS 直连（自动生成自签名证书）、token 鉴权、gzip 压缩、常驻手机图标面板（一键复制/二维码），并内置 NapCat QQ 机器人取链接通道。

plugins.name: dsh-web-restart
plugins.description: One-click restart button for the DSH Web UI: a sidebar footer button that restarts the dsh web process with a single click and persists across the restart it triggers.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 界面一键重启按钮：侧边栏底部按钮，单击即重启 dsh web 进程，且重启后按钮常驻。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-aionui-panel
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Right-panel system for the dsh web GUI: a pixel-faithful AionUi Explorer + Preview (file tree, diff view, preview).
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 右侧面板系统：像素级还原 AionUi 的资源树 + 预览（文件树、差异视图、预览）。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-git-graph
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Git branch selector and Git graph in the conversation header of the dsh web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 会话头部栏的 Git 分支选择器与提交图。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-liangshen
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 的梁神 agent 预设：两阶段锚定标准预设。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-live-stats
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Live token estimates and generation throughput for the dsh web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 实时 token 估算与生成吞吐。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-pet
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Multi-pet companion for the dsh web GUI: a registry-driven floating pet that reacts to model activity.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 多桌宠伴侣：注册表驱动的悬浮宠物，随模型活动实时反应。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-remote-web-ui
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Mobile remote control for the dsh web GUI: scan-to-pair QR entry with one-time pairing tokens.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 移动端远程控制：扫码配对 QR 入口、一次性配对 token。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-skins
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Skin family aggregator: one install gives the skin center plus all skin assets (qq98, ths, xp, blue-fantasy, dragon-heir, minecraft, miku, trading).
plugins.description_zh: 皮肤全家桶聚合插件：一键安装皮肤中心 + 全部皮肤资产（qq98/ths/xp/blue-fantasy/dragon-heir/minecraft/miku/trading 等）。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-ssh
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store and persisted sessions.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 远程 SSH 操作：主机配置存储、持久化会话。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-task-board
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry plus a multi-column kanban view with local persistence.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 任务看板：侧边栏入口 + 多列看板视图，本地持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-tool-describe-image
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Gives a text-only model image understanding via a vision-language model, exposed as a `describe_image` tool.
plugins.description_zh: describe_image 模型工具：让纯文本模型通过视觉语言模型获得图像理解能力。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-web-ui-all
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: DSH Web UI family aggregator: one-click install of all feature plugins (task-board, git-graph, pet, remote-web-ui, live-stats, web-ui-settings).
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 全家桶聚合插件：一键安装全部功能插件（task-board/git-graph/pet/remote-web-ui/live-stats/web-ui-settings）。

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-web-ui-settings
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Web UI plugin group card in the dsh settings page: enable switches and config for the dsh-web-ui family.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 设置页的 Web UI 插件组卡片：dsh-web-ui 全家插件的开关与配置。

plugins.name: dsh-weixin
plugins.author: xiaoshihou514
plugins.description: Connects dsh to Weixin, with arbitrary file sending support.
plugins.description_zh: 通过微信远程控制 DeepSeek Harness，支持任意文件传输。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-meter
plugins.author: Shiye-10Pages
plugins.description: Usage tiers and shareable stats cards: 🐟→🐳 ranks by monthly token burn with a locally-computed estimated percentile, precise pricing for 46 models across 6 vendors (including size-tiered Chinese pricing), backfill of pre-install sessions, and old-vs-new comparison across the 2026-08-17 rate change. Local-only, no telemetry.
plugins.description_zh: 用量段位与战绩卡片：按本月 token 消耗评 🐟→🐳 五档段位，分位本地估算（零上报）；6 家厂商 46 个模型精准计价，支持国内厂商按输入长度分档；自动回填安装前的历史会话；8·17 调价前后同一份用量的新旧价对比。数据全在本机，无遥测。

plugins.name: dsh-workshop
plugins.author: loguhan
plugins.description: Steam Workshop-style plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, and one-click install community plugins with mirror acceleration, progress UI, security checks, and Chinese descriptions.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 的 Steam 创意工坊式插件商店：浏览、搜索并一键安装社区插件，支持镜像加速、进度 UI、安全检测与中文描述。

plugins.name: dsh-xueqiu
plugins.author: kangjinghang
plugins.description: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.
plugins.description_zh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

plugins.name: dsh-zotero
plugins.author: Hongcheng-LI
plugins.description: Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key): search items/collections, read metadata and abstracts, list attachments, read full text (parses PDFs on the fly when Zotero cache misses), download PDFs, and manage notes.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API Key）操作文献库：检索条目/分类、读元数据与摘要、列附件、读全文（缓存未命中时现场解析 PDF）、下载 PDF、管理笔记。

plugins.name: dsh4vscode
plugins.author: DoggyHU
plugins.description: VS Code chat windows backed by the DSH agent with model auto-routing.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 DSH agent 的 VS Code 聊天窗口，模型自动路由。

plugins.name: oss-prompt-optimizer
plugins.author: seven282
plugins.description: Optimize a raw instruction into a professional prompt through the harness llm service — four-section (Role / Task / Context / Format) or a headerless plain-text style. Context-aware by default: the recent conversation is injected as background and may enrich the ## Context section. Long outputs resume from the truncation point with auto-expanded budgets; validated results are cached (identical requests cost zero model calls); a unified call budget bounds worst-case cost. Composer ✨ one-click optimize, undo, cancel and a token-cost hint; prompt_optimize tool (optimize + iterate), auto-optimize hook, auto-detected zh/en role document.
plugins.description_zh: 将原始指令经 harness llm 服务优化为专业提示词——四段（Role / Task / Context / Format）或无标题纯文本风格；上下文感知默认开启（注入此前对话作背景，四段模式可充实 ## Context 段）；长输出断点续传+自动扩容、结果缓存（同请求零模型调用）、统一调用预算控制最坏成本；输入框 ✨ 一键优化/撤销/取消与 token 消耗提示、prompt_optimize 工具（优化+迭代）、自动优化钩子与中英自动检测的角色文档。

plugins.name: Plugin Doctor
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Pre-publish health checks, preflight, profile shadow detection, env diagnostics.
plugins.description_zh: Pre-publish health checks, preflight, profile shadow detection, env diagnostics.

plugins.name: Qwen-MM-Plugins
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Qwen multi-modal plugin support.
plugins.description_zh: Qwen 多模态插件支持。

plugins.name: sage-mem
plugins.author: gezi-wen
plugins.description: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
plugins.description_zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

plugins.name: sgme
plugins.author: freehul
plugins.description: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
plugins.description_zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

plugins.name: widget-dock
plugins.author: MorGogh
plugins.description: Draggable grid-aligned workbench of 28 mini-cards in the margins of the conversation (API balance, token usage, cost, context pressure, todos, goal, usage heatmap, GitHub repo, image relay), with S/M/L/XL size tiers.
plugins.description_zh: 对话两侧空白区的可拖动卡片工作台，28 个小组件（余额、Token 用量、成本、上下文压力、待办、目标、用量热力图、GitHub 仓库、图片中转等），支持 S/M/L/XL 四档尺寸。

plugins.name: chicheng-gate
plugins.description: LAN / remote-access control, frpc NAT tunneling, a panel password gate, and mobile UI adaptation for the DSH Web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 插件：局域网/远程访问控制、frpc 内网穿透、面板密码门禁与手机端 UI 适配。

plugins.name: chicheng-stats
plugins.description: Configurable DSH usage statistics: a sidebar text/card widget plus a detail dialog with per-provider and per-model breakdowns, cache-hit rates, token trends, and latency details (TTFT and duration).
plugins.description_zh: 高度可配置的 DSH 用量统计插件：侧边栏文字/卡片组件加统计弹窗，提供按提供方与按模型的请求/Token 统计、缓存命中率、趋势图与首字节/总耗时明细。

plugins.name: DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop#desktop-launcher-plugin
plugins.author: Ch0uHuaZ1
plugins.description: Adds a Desktop card to the settings page that detects the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app and launches it with one click.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置页加入「桌面端」卡片，检测 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用并一键唤起。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#evidence-first
plugins.author: jinguanghai
plugins.description: Evidence-first guard: warns the agent when it claims success without a matching tool-execution record in recent context.
plugins.description_zh: 证据铁律守卫：模型声称成功但上下文中没有对应工具执行记录时，自动注入警告。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#forge-gates
plugins.author: jinguanghai
plugins.description: Real-compute verification gates: math simplification, logic proofs, regex validation, E-prover FOL, state-machine checks, and code repair, backed by Go-compiled binaries with prebuilt Windows executables.
plugins.description_zh: 真实计算验证门：数学化简、逻辑证明、正则校验、E-prover 一阶逻辑、状态机检查与代码修复，由 Go 编译的二进制支撑（附 Windows 预编译产物）。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#forge-memory
plugins.author: jinguanghai
plugins.description: BM25 keyword-based memory recall.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 BM25 关键词检索的记忆召回。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#forge-tcm
plugins.author: jinguanghai
plugins.description: Traditional Chinese Medicine toolkit: eight-axes diagnosis and herb-pair lookup.
plugins.description_zh: 中医工具集：八纲辨证与药对查询。

plugins.name: dsh-adhd-copilot
plugins.author: zimai233
plugins.description: ADHD behavioral coaching skill: task breakdown, overwhelm management, launch rituals, and failure recovery.
plugins.description_zh: ADHD 行为辅导技能：任务拆解、事项过载管理、启动仪式与失败重启。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-relay
plugins.author: Noelune
plugins.description: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients, wire protocol v1.0.
plugins.description_zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

plugins.name: dsh-all-warmup
plugins.author: brunhildzhou
plugins.description: Global frictionless warm-up layer: every session's first request (subagent depths and post-compaction included) is narrowed to the minimal tool pair with one injected warmup reply; the full original mode returns from round two.
plugins.description_zh: 全局无感热身层：每个会话（含子代理与压缩后）首轮自动收窄到极简工具对并注入一次热身回复，第二轮起恢复完整模式。

plugins.name: dsh-archive-manager
plugins.author: jasonrale
plugins.description: Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 的归档会话管理器：重新打开已归档会话并继续对话、取消归档恢复原位、彻底删除会话，支持分组浏览、消息搜索与原生视图同步。

plugins.name: dsh-archive-manager
plugins.author: MichengAI
plugins.description: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置里增加已归档会话页，可按工作区搜索、恢复和删除已归档会话。

plugins.name: dsh-archived-chats
plugins.author: Ultronen
plugins.description: Archived Chats settings page for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, unarchive, and delete archived sessions grouped by workspace — deletion takes effect immediately, no restart needed, even for sessions still resident in the background.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 已归档聊天管理页：浏览、搜索、取消归档与删除已归档会话，按工作区分组；删除即生效、无需重启，后台驻留的会话也能当场彻底删除。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-chess
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Auto chess: human vs AI, or AI vs AI.
plugins.description_zh: 自走棋：人机对战或双 AI 对弈。

plugins.name: dsh-backup
plugins.author: xiaoyuyu6420
plugins.description: One-command backup & restore of DSH user data: /backup, verify, restore, restart-surviving scheduled auto-backup, sha256 checksums and rotation (macOS/Linux/Windows).
plugins.description_zh: 一键备份与恢复 DSH 用户数据：/backup 备份、完整性校验、恢复，定时自动备份（重启续跑），sha256 校验与自动轮换（macOS/Linux/Windows）。

plugins.name: dsh-bash-rtk

plugins.description_zh: 将符合条件的 shell 命令路由给 rtk，压缩工具输出并节省 token。

plugins.name: dsh-bilibili

plugins.description_zh: B站视频分析工具：提取元数据、字幕文稿（必剪/本地 ASR 兜底）、评论与弹幕，抓取清晰关键帧并可选本地视觉描述。

plugins.name: dsh-browser-control
plugins.author: kyo615
plugins.description: Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 Playwright MCP 的 AI 浏览器控制：驱动真实可见的 Chrome（导航/点击/输入/快照，约 80 个 browser_* 工具），并在 GUI 内嵌实时截图面板，每次操作后自动刷新。

plugins.name: dsh-cache-precision

plugins.description_zh: 把内置缓存命中率原位显示为 3 位小数，并加宽底部统计行避免内容被截断。

plugins.name: dsh-calendar
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: CalDAV calendar tools (list/create/update/delete/search) for Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/custom endpoints, with RRULE expansion.
plugins.description_zh: CalDAV 日历插件：查/建/改/删/搜日程，Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/自定义端点，RRULE 重复事件展开。

plugins.name: dsh-cc-ecosystem

Six installable packages: loader, skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp.

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-writing
plugins.author: x2802490130-prog
plugins.description: Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.
plugins.description_zh: Web 客户端「写作」面板：项目分卷与统计、书库与全文检索、设定演化版本链 diff、线索 SVG 图谱，仅在写作预设会话显示。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-subscription
plugins.author: WSL043
plugins.description: Built-in ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models, selectable subscription web search, backend quota for standard Codex and Spark, and a DSH settings UI; no API key or Codex CLI required.
plugins.description_zh: 内置 ChatGPT OAuth 的 Codex 模型提供方：可切换订阅联网搜索，在设置页显示普通 Codex 与 Spark 独立额度；无需 API Key 或 Codex CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-sync
plugins.author: Walvez
plugins.description: One-stop bidirectional sync between OpenAI Codex and DeepSeek Harness: first-class skills from ~/.codex/skills, codex session import with workspace attach, live MCP auto-mirror of codex's mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.
plugins.description_zh: OpenAI Codex 与 DeepSeek Harness 一站式双向同步：一等公民技能、codex 会话导入与工作区挂载、codex mcp_servers 实时 MCP 自动镜像、Codex 侧反向 MCP 一键安装器。

plugins.name: dsh-companion
plugins.author: beijingwahw
plugins.description: Four-module session companion: smart conversation export (Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG long-image with privacy redaction and batch ZIP), context handoff summaries with template save/import, API cost optimization (live official pricing, peak/off-peak scheduling, daily/monthly budgets, model routing), and global conversation search with in-chat find (Ctrl+F, CSS Custom Highlight API).

plugins.name: dsh-cost-balance

plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方的 iOS 风格统计条：一键展开查看会话花费、DeepSeek 账户余额、缓存命中率与 Token 用量。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-tracker
plugins.author: yflmq001
plugins.description: Per-model token cost tracking with configurable cache-hit/miss, output and peak-window pricing, a live session cost bar, and unconfigured-model flags.
plugins.description_zh: 按模型追踪 token 成本：可配置缓存命中/未命中、输出与高峰时段单价，实时会话花费条，并标记未配置价格的模型。

plugins.name: dsh-cowork
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Bounded, cell-addressed `doc_read`/`doc_write` for xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb, plus an MCP server and CLI.
plugins.description_zh: doc_read/doc_write：以有界、单元格寻址的方式读写 xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb，另附 MCP 服务器与 CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-custom-brand
plugins.author: baisama-cloud
plugins.description: Customizable brand area for the Web UI: replace the whale logo and DeepSeek wordmark with local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text (double-click to change, right-click to reset).
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 品牌区自定义：鲸鱼 logo 与 DeepSeek 文字可换成本地图片，HARNESS 徽章文字可双击编辑（双击修改，右键恢复）。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-quota-bar
plugins.author: jiangli07
plugins.description: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
plugins.description_zh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

plugins.name: dsh-devquest

plugins.description: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.
plugins.description_zh: 把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、27+ 成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动、纯函数计分——你的工作就是游戏。

plugins.name: dsh-dingtalk
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: DingTalk group-robot notifications (webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
plugins.description_zh: 钉钉群机器人通知（webhook + 加签，零运行时依赖）。

plugins.name: dsh-docker

plugins.description_zh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-download-progress

plugins.description_zh: 下载进度面板：URL 下载器、agent shell/SSH 传输追踪与工作区黑箱文件增长监控，汇聚到可拖拽浮窗实时显示字节、速度、百分比与预计剩余时间。

plugins.name: dsh-effort-slider

plugins.description_zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

plugins.name: dsh-exa-mcp

plugins.description_zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

plugins.name: dsh-file-drop

plugins.description_zh: 拖拽/点击上传任意非图片文件（PDF/Word/Excel/ZIP/文本）到输入框：桌面壳下直取 Finder 原始路径；无壳时上传到工作区并插入路径。

plugins.name: dsh-github
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
plugins.description_zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

plugins.name: dsh-github-skills
plugins.author: Starfie1d1272
plugins.description: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
plugins.description_zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

plugins.name: dsh-heatmap

plugins.name: dsh-honcho-sync

plugins.name: dsh-hyperframes
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Five official HyperFrames by HeyGen skills: HTML video / CLI / registry / website-to-video / GSAP reference.
plugins.description_zh: HyperFrames by HeyGen 官方移植技能五件套：HTML 写视频 / CLI / 注册表 / 网址转视频 / GSAP 参考。

plugins.name: dsh-ibka-balance
plugins.author: ibka512
plugins.description: Permanent composer-dock balance card: real-time DeepSeek API account balance with 5-minute auto-refresh, a manual refresh button, and low-balance color warnings.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方常驻余额卡片：实时显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，每 5 分钟自动刷新，支持手动刷新，余额过低自动变色提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-im-hub
plugins.author: ThreeBody6666
plugins.description: Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: 多平台 IM 网关：飞书（Lark）WebSocket 长连接（无需公网）、企业微信 AES 加密回调、Telegram 长轮询；每会话独立 agent、白名单访问、Web GUI 可视化设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-incognito
plugins.author: HuiHuitie-zhu
plugins.description: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
plugins.description_zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

plugins.name: dsh-inline-images
plugins.description: Render local image paths from assistant replies inline in the message body (9 formats, click-to-zoom lightbox, adjustable size).
plugins.description_zh: 对话内联图片：LLM 回复中输出的本地图片路径在消息正文直接渲染为图片（9 种格式、点击放大灯箱、可调尺寸）。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-inspector
plugins.author: cdxiaodong
plugins.description: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.
plugins.description_zh: 统一 LLM 请求/响应检查器：调 reasoning effort、外部思考(think)导出、流量与包分析。

plugins.name: dsh-log-memory
plugins.author: says693
plugins.description: Popup guardian for session logs: opens with the Web UI on a configurable reminder interval (10 min-3 h), with one-click incremental backup of every session.jsonl(.zstd) under ~/.dsh/sessions in raw or readable chat-log format.
plugins.description_zh: 会话日志守护弹窗：打开 Web 即提醒（间隔 10 分钟至 3 小时可调），一键增量备份 ~/.dsh/sessions 全部 session.jsonl(.zstd)，可选原始压缩或可读聊天记录两种格式，弹窗内可选备份文件夹。

plugins.name: dsh-memento
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection; every write passes the approval gate and stays reconstructable from the session log.
plugins.description_zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：`ctx.memory` 服务 + 零依赖 SQLite 存储 + `memory` 工具与冻结快照注入；写入必过审批门，模型可见内容可自会话日志重建。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-gate
plugins.author: GIT121995
plugins.description: Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.
plugins.description_zh: 有界本地记忆 + CBDC 权威门控：SQLite + FTS5 claims，作用域召回并给出可解释的采用/核验/忽略决策与完整审计轨迹，/memory 命令，每次注入 ≤3 条/1200 字符，不增加额外模型调用。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-meow
plugins.author: Phant0Meow
plugins.description: Project-scoped cross-session memory: PROJECT.md snapshot injected into the first user message, a memory_remember tool, and auto-reflection after ReAct tasks; each project keeps its own memory file.
plugins.description_zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：PROJECT.md 快照注入首条用户消息（缓存友好）+ memory_remember 工具 + ReAct 任务结束自动反思；各项目独立记忆文件，互不互通。

plugins.name: dsh-mic-input
plugins.author: QT-Chen
plugins.description: Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框麦克风语音输入：浏览器 Web Speech API 实时转写，自动去重/续听、智能标点，支持语言与自动发送设置。

plugins.name: dsh-model-failover
plugins.author: Letter2025
plugins.description: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
plugins.description_zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

plugins.name: dsh-mpkg-wallpaper
plugins.author: XHR666
plugins.description: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.
plugins.description_zh: 在浏览器里直接加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 作为 DSH 网页背景：内嵌视频、多时段切换、统一磨砂虚化、本地壁纸库与轮换。

plugins.name: dsh-MusicPlayer
plugins.author: xiekai886
plugins.description: A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search — chat and listen at the same time.
plugins.description_zh: 可折叠/展开、自由拖动的悬浮音乐播放器，接入网易云音乐，支持歌单导入和按歌名或歌手搜索单曲导入，边对话边听歌。

plugins.name: dsh-native-launcher
plugins.author: ingleav626-art
plugins.description: Windows desktop launcher for the DSH Web UI: desktop shortcut, silent start, system tray with open/full-exit (stop service, close app window, quit tray), PWA app window with focus-instead-of-relaunch, install prompt, and task-completion notifications.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 桌面化启动器：桌面快捷方式、静默启动、系统托盘（打开 / 彻底退出＝停服务＋关应用窗口＋退托盘）、PWA 应用窗口（已运行则聚焦不重复弹窗）、安装引导、任务完成通知。

plugins.name: dsh-negative-ledger
plugins.author: akslcw
plugins.description: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
plugins.description_zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

plugins.name: dsh-neu-theme
plugins.author: Lhy723
plugins.description: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

plugins.name: DSH-Office
plugins.author: didclawapp-ai
plugins.description: Create, read, and edit PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, and PDF via the local zagens-office CLI as office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read tools.
plugins.description_zh: 通过本机 zagens-office CLI 读写编辑 PPTX / DOCX / XLSX / PDF，注册为 office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read。

plugins.name: dsh-ops-kit
plugins.author: LeslieWylie
plugins.description: Evidence-first operating kit: six read-only tools (capability catalog, staged workflow plans, packaged skill reader, bounded local memory search, repository release audit, release checklist) and five packaged skills - plans and audits, never remote writes.
plugins.description_zh: 证据优先的操作套件：六个只读工具（能力清单、分阶段编排计划、随包技能阅读、有上限的本地记忆检索、仓库发布审计、发布清单）加五个随包技能；只规划与审计，不做远程写入。

plugins.name: dsh-output-styles
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session persistence, systemPrompt injection, six built-in styles, a web picker, and a renderer registry with per-session/per-tool rules and /export.
plugins.description_zh: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

plugins.name: dsh-perlica-ding
plugins.author: 117BS
plugins.description: Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.
plugins.description_zh: 明日方舟终末地佩丽卡主题分级提示音：计划出方案 / 任务完成 / 需要你回应 / 出错四档独立音效，普通问答保持安静；系统级播放（窗口在后台也响），跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），支持自定义 TTS 语音。

plugins.name: dsh-pet
plugins.author: zealot00
plugins.description: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：精灵图动画、agent 状态联动、拖拽、闹钟（每天/一次）与番茄钟，皮肤下拉选择 + 预览。

plugins.name: dsh-plan-switch
plugins.author: a903067276-rgb
plugins.description: One-click enter/exit Plan mode for the DSH web input bar, a quick-click shortcut for /plan.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框一键进/出 Plan 模式（/plan 的快捷点击），常驻小按钮。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.author: white-sand-grand
plugins.description: Community search, similarity analysis, and install/dedupe/build-it-yourself decisions for the dsh-plugin ecosystem.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件生态的社区搜索、相似度分析与安装/去重/自建决策工具。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-guide
plugins.author: PerryLink
