plugins.description: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-llm-balance
plugins.author: FengHuoLinShan
plugins.description: Draggable floating card showing the balance/quota of your most recently used providers (DeepSeek/Moonshot/Kimi For Coding): auto-discovery, color-coded tiers, live refresh.
plugins.description_zh: 可拖动的 API 余额/配额悬浮卡片：自动显示最近使用的 provider 余额/配额（DeepSeek/Moonshot/Kimi For Coding），按余额分档变色、实时刷新。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.author: nonentity303
plugins.description: Plugin manager with a rescue center: grouped enable/disable by necessity, multi update sources (npm / dshfind market / GitHub), browser-first downloads with an auto-install folder, P2P fallback, pre-boot self-check and broken-bundle quarantine.
plugins.description_zh: 插件管理器与救砖中心：按必要程度分组启停、多更新源（npm / 插件超市 / GitHub）、浏览器下载优先与目录自动安装、P2P 兜底、启动前自检与坏包隔离。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-multimodal
plugins.author: shinjiyu
plugins.description: Advertise image paste on text-only DeepSeek routes, describe attachments with a vision sidecar, and leave native vision models untouched.
plugins.description_zh: 在纯文本 DeepSeek 线路上开放贴图准入，用视觉 sidecar 把附件转成文字，原生视觉模型不改写。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-open-app
plugins.author: 2nd1st
plugins.description: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
plugins.description_zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-qr-connect
plugins.author: mervyn-teo
plugins.description: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
plugins.description_zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-subagent-director
plugins.author: SeverusZh
plugins.description: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
plugins.description_zh: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-suite#dsh-plugin-center
plugins.author: crTnT
plugins.description: Plugin center: discover, install, and manage DSH plugins from Settings.
plugins.description_zh: 插件中心：在设置页发现、安装与管理 DSH 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-suite#dsh-plugin-updater
plugins.author: crTnT
plugins.description: Update manager for installed plugins: check for updates, back up, and roll back.
plugins.description_zh: 已装插件更新管理：检查更新、备份与回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-template
plugins.author: kun2-5code
plugins.description: A starter template for dsh plugins covering config, tools, events, services, hooks, browser UI slots, and slash commands.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 插件开发模板，覆盖配置、工具、事件、服务、钩子、浏览器 UI 插槽与斜杠命令。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-uisfx
plugins.author: XanthanL
plugins.description: Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 uisfx 的语义化 UI 音效：任务开始/成功/失败、不同按钮情景 cue，设置页即时试听，12 种音色包，Host 持久化，并提供 `ctx.uisfx` 服务给其他插件。

plugins.name: dsh-polyglot
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的模型切换器：指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，内置精选免费/低价 DeepSeek 服务商预设，免费额度限流时自动回退。

plugins.name: dsh-pomodoro
plugins.author: causebefore
plugins.description: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-stash
plugins.author: Wine-Red
plugins.description: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
plugins.description_zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-studio
plugins.author: Moeblack
plugins.description: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.
plugins.description_zh: 带实时预览的用户/内置 system prompt 分节编辑器。

plugins.name: dsh-qq2007-skin
plugins.author: LeemanCheung
plugins.description: QQ 2007-inspired DSH Web skin: 72 native theme tokens, scoped three-pane chrome, original offline art and pixel buddy, an optional synthesized send chime, responsive/accessibility fallbacks, and reversible Settings switches.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的 QQ 2007 风格皮肤：72 个原生主题 token、作用域三栏窗框、原创离线素材与像素伙伴、可选合成发送提示音、响应式/无障碍回退和可恢复设置开关。

plugins.name: dsh-qrcode
plugins.author: hellosky983
plugins.description: Offline QR code (SVG/PNG/ASCII) and barcode (Code128/EAN-13) generator for DeepSeek Harness, no network and no shell.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 离线二维码（SVG/PNG/ASCII）与条码（Code128/EAN-13）生成器，无网络、无 shell。

plugins.name: dsh-quota-panel
plugins.author: wenzetan
plugins.description: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows balance or rolling 5-hour and weekly usage, with per-provider visibility, alert thresholds and proxy support.
plugins.description_zh: 右下角额度胶囊：自动发现所有已配置 Key 的供应商（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、GLM、one-api/new-api、各类 Coding 套餐），显示余额或 5 小时/周滚动用量，支持按供应商设置可见性、告警阈值与代理。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-link
plugins.author: BotonJ
plugins.description: Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.
plugins.description_zh: 官方 Web UI 的安全远程接入：带认证的局域网/隧道网关，QR + HMAC 一次性配对、按设备吊销，mDNS 发现，附 fork_session 会话分叉工具。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-tunnel
plugins.author: Linjiangxian0203
plugins.description: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.
plugins.description_zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

plugins.name: dsh-role-router
plugins.author: SnowAmberX
plugins.description: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.
plugins.description_zh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

plugins.name: dsh-s1
plugins.author: superagents-lab
plugins.description: Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.
plugins.description_zh: Search1API（s1）原生联网检索工具：网页搜索、新闻、页面抓取、站点地图与趋势榜，以 `s1_*` 一等工具形式提供，并附带 s1 技能。

plugins.name: dsh-session-export
plugins.author: bwndlct
plugins.description: Export the current session to portable, schema-versioned Markdown and JSON files via the `session_export` tool and slash commands, with cross-platform-safe filenames.
plugins.description_zh: 把当前会话导出为可移植、带 schema 版本的 Markdown 与 JSON 文件，提供 `session_export` 工具与斜杠命令两种入口，文件名跨平台安全。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-7d-code-reviewer
plugins.author: 7dgroup-ai
plugins.description: Template-driven code review skill: five-step review flow, critical/medium/minor severity grading, four-dimension scoring (quality, security, performance, maintainability), dual text and HTML report output, and an on-demand reference knowledge base.
plugins.description_zh: 模板驱动的代码审查技能：五步审查流程、严重/中等/轻微三级分级、四维评分（质量、安全、性能、可维护性），同时输出文本与 HTML 报告，内置按需加载的参考知识库。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-hub
plugins.author: cheshireez
plugins.description: In-GUI skill hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, toggle, inspect, diagnose and scaffold local skills from the official ctx.skills registry, plus a skill market with tracked source sync and one-click update-all.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 技能中枢：基于官方 ctx.skills 注册表浏览、搜索、启停、查看、诊断并新建本地技能，附技能市场：来源快照跟踪、一键全量更新。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-pack
plugins.author: jeremy9682
plugins.description: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution, full-throttle) as an installable skill pack.
plugins.description_zh: 11 个可分享的工作流 skills（handoff、triage、to-spec、to-tickets、wayfinder、teach、wait-what、dsh-mode-routing、ask-matt、overnight-execution、full-throttle），打包为可安装 bundle。

plugins.name: dsh-skillradar
plugins.author: hellosky983
plugins.description: Scans the skills visible to the current session and ranks them by relevance to the recent conversation.
plugins.description_zh: 扫描当前会话可见的技能，按与最近对话的相关性排序推荐。

plugins.name: dsh-specflow
plugins.author: lonelymoon87
plugins.description: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
plugins.description_zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-sticky-disclosure
plugins.author: Han-1413141
plugins.description: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
plugins.description_zh: 一键收起会话中所有展开的区块（Think、工具卡等），常驻计数按钮 + 自定义快捷键。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-cwd
plugins.author: lynx-gt
plugins.description: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents, shipped with the two in-process provider patches it requires.
plugins.description_zh: 在 dsh-subagent-tools 基础上增加子代理按调用 cwd，附带所需的两个 in-process provider 补丁。

plugins.name: dsh-sysmon
plugins.author: AKS1st
plugins.description: System status floating widget: live CPU/memory/disk usage in the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI with threshold colour warnings.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 右下角系统状态悬浮窗：实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘占用率，带阈值变色告警。

plugins.name: dsh-task-relay
plugins.author: LeslieWylie
plugins.description: Cross-session task queue with handoff notes: sessions and subagents push, claim, complete and cancel tasks on a shared file-backed queue, and leave a handoff summary for whoever picks up next.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话任务队列与交接摘要：会话与子 agent 在共享的文件队列上投递、认领、完成、取消任务，并留下交接摘要供后续会话查看。

plugins.name: dsh-tavily#packages/dsh-tool-tavily-search
plugins.author: moguiyu
plugins.description: Tavily search with multiple API keys, key rotation and failover, a usage gauge, and a settings card.
plugins.description_zh: Tavily 多密钥搜索：支持密钥轮换/故障转移、用量仪表盘与设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-telegram-duty
plugins.author: luzhengyangtx
plugins.description: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.
plugins.description_zh: Telegram 值班网关：手机消息任务闭环（专属值班会话）、值守模式全局审批转发（内联同意/拒绝按钮）、telegram_ask 选项提问、值守/本地切换与网页横幅、中英双语消息、空闲零 token。

plugins.name: dsh-telemetry-redactor
plugins.description: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
plugins.description_zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-plugin
plugins.author: BeiZi6
plugins.description: Theme studio for the DSH Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable light/dark palettes (accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast), hot-swapped instantly and persisted in localStorage.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工作室：5 套内置预设 + 完全可自定义的浅/深配色（强调色、背景、前景、UI 与代码字体、半透明侧栏、对比度），即时热切换并持久化到 localStorage。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-encoding
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: base64/url/hex encoding, common hashes, and UUID generation.
plugins.description_zh: base64/url/hex 编解码、常用哈希、UUID 生成。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-json
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: JSON queries with a JMESPath subset.
plugins.description_zh: JMESPath 子集 JSON 查询。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-regex
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Test/extract/safe-replace/statically explain regexes without executing code.
plugins.description_zh: 正则测试/提取/安全替换/静态解释（不执行代码）。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-schema
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: JSON Schema validation: validate/paths/explain/normalize.
plugins.description_zh: JSON Schema 验证：validate/paths/explain/normalize。

plugins.name: dsh-toolfold
plugins.author: Minecraftbe
plugins.description: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

plugins.name: dsh-unread-dot
plugins.author: Bing-Bryan
plugins.description: macOS Dock badge and bubble chime: shows an unread badge on the Dock (dot while running, count when done) and plays a chime while the app is hidden; clears on return, built on the Badging API.
plugins.description_zh: macOS Dock 角标与提示音：最小化/切走时 Dock 显示未读角标（运行中=红点、跑完=数字）并播放水泡提示音，回到应用自动清除，基于 Badging API。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-dashboard-plus
plugins.author: 1HelloMan1
plugins.description: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT, cache rate, call logs, cost estimates, filters, and CSV export.
plugins.description_zh: 显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费估算，合并外部视觉调用 JSONL 记录，并提供含模型统计、TTFT、缓存率、调用日志、费用估算、筛选与 CSV 导出的会话看板。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-bridge
plugins.author: GXX182
plugins.description: Bridges session images to configurable vision providers and returns text-only analysis to eligible DeepSeek Harness model routes.
plugins.description_zh: 将会话图片转交可配置视觉服务，并向符合条件的 DeepSeek Harness 模型路由返回纯文本分析。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-bridge
plugins.author: ximengxiaolan
plugins.description: Composer-attached images are transcribed to text by an OpenAI-compatible vision model before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框贴图自动识别：由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转成文字描述后，再交给纯文本 DeepSeek 模型处理。

plugins.name: dsh-web-default-session
plugins.author: wjy9902
plugins.description: The generic New Session action opens a default-directory workspace instead of requiring a folder pick, and the workspace picker lists that workspace as a no-folder choice.
plugins.description_zh: 点「新会话」默认打开绑定宿主启动目录的「默认目录」工作区（无需选文件夹），工作区选择菜单中也可选该项。

plugins.name: dsh-webbridge
plugins.author: bill9109
plugins.description: DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 结合 Kimi WebBridge。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-galgame
plugins.author: JAdpp
plugins.description: Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 多角色 Galgame 对话界面：角色与回复模型可独立切换，分角色保存好感度、记忆、对话历史与 CG 图鉴，并根据 Harness 跨会话任务事件做出角色回应。

plugins.name: dsh-win-gitbash
plugins.author: buhuikongpan
plugins.description: Git Bash shell tool for Windows: runs commands through the bash bundled with Git for Windows, with timeout, sandbox, output truncation, and background jobs, replacing the slow pwsh tool and the WSL-only bash tool.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 Windows 的 Git Bash 工具：通过 Git for Windows 自带的 bash 执行命令，支持超时、沙箱、输出截断与后台任务，替代卡顿的 pwsh 工具与仅限 WSL 的 bash 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-explorer
plugins.author: Jiyr0119
plugins.description: Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to insert its reference into the composer, with search, inline preview, live settings, and zh/en i18n; single-purpose, zero-config, one-command install.
plugins.description_zh: 独立单功能的工作区文件树面板：会话头部图标打开当前工作区目录树的动画弹窗；点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框；自带搜索、行内预览、实时设置与中英双语；零配置，一条命令即装即用。

plugins.name: dsh-writing-remote
plugins.author: x2802490130-prog
plugins.description: Host-side Typert remote for dsh-tool-writing: serves project volumes, chapter status, corpus library, full-text search, evolution entries, and thread-graph data to the client writing panel.
plugins.description_zh: 写文引擎的 host 侧数据通道：把项目分卷、章节状态、书库、全文检索、演化条目与线索图谱以 Typert remote 暴露给客户端写作面板。

plugins.name: dsh-yolo-mode
plugins.author: SeverusZh
plugins.description: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
plugins.description_zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

plugins.name: folio#plugins/folio-events
plugins.author: nyantused-cpun
plugins.description: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.
plugins.description_zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

plugins.name: folio#plugins/folio-tools
plugins.author: nyantused-cpun
plugins.description: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the full session protocol.
plugins.description_zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

plugins.name: free-vision-skill
plugins.author: niyongsheng
plugins.description: Fully-local image understanding & OCR via macOS Vision Framework: `ocr_image` (text, table layout + coordinates) and `view_image` (scene, faces, QR) — paste multiple images into the web input box or pass path/URL/base64; images never leave your Mac.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 macOS Vision Framework 的全本地识图插件：`ocr_image`（文字提取，表格结构+坐标）与 `view_image`（场景/人脸/二维码）；web 输入框可直接粘贴多张图片，图片永不离开你的 Mac。

plugins.name: InfiniteDSH
plugins.author: vdnight89
plugins.description: Literary DSH plugin: one session is one book. Cover-card /new opens one of 19 realms, a prose-only 诸天万界DSH preset keeps the model writing fiction, keyword worldbook entries ground each turn, and /export-story typesets the session into a Markdown novel.
plugins.description_zh: 诸天万界DSH：一个会话就是一本书。封面开书，十九界任选，文学预设只写正文，规则书按关键词注入，/export-story 把整场会话誊成 Markdown 小说。

plugins.name: Kabutack
plugins.author: SunQingyuan0
plugins.description: Role-based manager for DSH plugins/Skills/MCP: bundle capabilities into “roles” and hot-switch them from the Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 基于角色的 DSH 插件 / Skill / MCP 管理器：把能力组合定义为“角色”，在 Web 设置页一键动态装载与切换。

plugins.name: knowlp-rag
plugins.author: wly8691-jpg
plugins.description: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight feedback loop — via MCP.
plugins.description_zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环，以 MCP 接入。

plugins.name: paperlab
plugins.author: maple-pwn
plugins.description: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
plugins.description_zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

plugins.name: plugin-switch
plugins.author: cynch18
plugins.description: Toggle switches for the plugin inventory: enable/disable any plugin live from Settings → Plugins → Plugin list without restarting, with groups/filters, bulk toggle, undo, and backup.
plugins.description_zh: 插件清单页滑块开关：在设置 → 插件 → 插件清单实时启用/停用任意插件，无需重启；支持分组/筛选、批量开关、撤销与自动备份。

plugins.name: prompt-for-me
plugins.author: ChuanTianML
plugins.description: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

plugins.name: sandbox-micro
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Support for the microsandbox backend.
plugins.description_zh: microsandbox 沙箱支持。

plugins.name: sandbox-nono
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Support for the nono sandbox backend.
plugins.description_zh: nono 沙盒支持。

plugins.name: shopline-ai-toolkit-dsh
plugins.author: lunw
plugins.description: SHOPLINE AI Toolkit: bridges the official SHOPLINE Developer MCP server and ships seven SHOPLINE agent skills (Admin REST, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, Sline) — the SHOPLINE counterpart of the Shopify AI Toolkit.
plugins.description_zh: SHOPLINE AI 工具包：接入 SHOPLINE 官方开发者 MCP 服务器，内置七个 SHOPLINE 平台技能（Admin REST、GraphQL、OAuth、Webhook、Sline），是 Shopify AI Toolkit 的 SHOPLINE 对应版。

plugins.name: Solarized-dsh-theme
plugins.author: zhijun-dai
plugins.description: Solarized and Selenized theme plugin: four faithful palettes registered with the DSH Web theme runtime.
plugins.description_zh: Solarized 与 Selenized 主题插件：向 DSH Web 主题运行时注册四套忠实色板。

plugins.name: unified-agent-memory
plugins.author: Noelune
plugins.description: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).
plugins.description_zh: 多 Agent 共享一个 Obsidian vault：零依赖 Python core（检索/晋升/裁决/遗忘）+ vault 模板 + dsh 插件（memory_search/show/submit/status）。

plugins.name: Vibe-Mathematics
plugins.author: ChongCyrus
plugins.description: Multi-agent math problem-solving & verification framework: brainstorm → solver iteration → multi-verifier debate → Verified knowledge base, with checkpoint resume and manual/auto intervention (also ships as an agent preset).
plugins.description_zh: 多代理数学问题求解与验证框架：头脑风暴 → 求解迭代 → 多验证器辩论 → 可信知识库沉淀，支持断点续跑与人工/自动干预（同时提供 agent preset 与可安装 bundle）。

plugins.author: chen731215-dev
plugins.description: Native tavern management panel for DeepSeek Harness: multiple character cards, multiple worldbooks, switchable presets.
plugins.description_zh: 酒馆管理原生面板：多角色卡、多世界书、可切换预设，深浅色跟随，点侧边栏自动关闭。

plugins.name: anan-thermal-monitor
plugins.author: AmeKrance
plugins.description: Purple-white desktop pet that docks to the screen edge and shows real-time CPU, RAM, GPU and NVMe temperatures with hardware info.
plugins.description_zh: 紫白桌宠悬浮球，贴边停靠实时显示 CPU/内存/GPU/NVMe 温度与硬件信息。

plugins.name: arcana
plugins.author: GooodWei
plugins.description: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮命令甲板：把所有斜杠命令列成可执行按钮，悬停看介绍，按使用次数排序。

plugins.name: awesome-dsh-skills
plugins.author: hackerFish
plugins.description: 12 tested engineering skills (git commit, code review, test-first, plugin dev, debugging, changelog, PR review, task breakdown, and more): every SKILL.md passes a format validator aligned with the official skill rules plus an isolated load smoke test.
plugins.description_zh: 12 个实测工程技能（git 提交、代码审查、测试优先、插件开发、排障、CHANGELOG、PR 审查、任务拆解等）：每个 SKILL.md 都通过对照官方规则的格式校验与隔离环境加载冒烟。

plugins.name: capital-generation#dsh-plugin
plugins.author: v587d
plugins.description: China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds/indices) over THS free official REST (primary) + AKShare (fallback) + Wind (exclusive domains), with observable degradation, context-budget compression (result-side -72.2% measured), and an offline 10-year market-data lake; BYOK.
plugins.description_zh: 中国 A 股金融数据 MCP server：11 个 fin_data__* 工具（行情/K线/财务/日历/特色数据/公告/EDB/对账/基金/指数），同花顺免费官方 REST 主干 + AKShare 兜底 + Wind 独家域，降级全程可观测；上下文压缩（实测结果侧 -72.2%）；离线 10 年数据湖；BYOK 零平台密钥。

plugins.name: chicheng-cron
plugins.description: Cron scheduler with a sidebar UI: run shell, Python or Node scripts, skills, or agent tasks on a schedule, with push notifications and session archiving.
plugins.description_zh: 定时任务调度器：侧栏管理界面，按 cron 表达式或间隔执行脚本、技能与 Agent 任务，支持完成后推送通知与会话归档。

plugins.name: chicheng-push
plugins.description: Multi-channel push for DeepSeek Harness: Server酱, PushPlus, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Feishu, ntfy, custom webhooks and more, configurable from the settings panel and callable by other plugins via the pushNotifier service.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 多渠道消息推送插件：支持 Server酱、PushPlus、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram、飞书、ntfy、自定义 Webhook 等，可在设置面板配置多个渠道，并通过 pushNotifier 服务供其他插件调用。

plugins.name: coding-coach
plugins.author: xiehuan123
plugins.description: Coding Coach: a 35-skill bundle plus a full agent preset for non-developers (8-stage product→launch pipeline with engineering/product/UI skills), installable via npm (`dsh plugin add coding-coach`) and as a Claude Code plugin.
plugins.description_zh: Coding Coach 编程教练：面向非开发人员的 35 技能 bundle + 完整 Agent 预设（八段编排流水线 + 工程/产品/界面技能），npm 可装 `dsh plugin add coding-coach`，同时提供 Claude Code 插件。

plugins.name: DeepSeek-Harness-biaoqingbao
plugins.author: moononnn
plugins.description: Sticker/emoji expression for assistants: emotion-driven auto-matching, library management, AI image tagging, dialects, style mimicry, and chat-based tag refinement.
plugins.description_zh: 表情包表达插件：让助手用表情包表达情绪，按情绪自动配图，含图库管理、AI 识图打标、方言口音、学我说话，还能点「和助手聊聊」直接调教标签。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-evolver
plugins.author: shinjiyu
plugins.description: Complement to official Creator mode: stage, validate, live-mount via ctx.plugin, score, and solidify or roll back in-memory tool-plugin trials.
plugins.description_zh: 补充官方创造模式：把内存里试过的小工具插件校验、经 ctx.plugin 热挂、打分后固化到盘上或回滚。

plugins.name: dph-fleet
plugins.author: polaris-smart
plugins.description: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.
plugins.description_zh: 去中心化多设备舰队：mDNS 同网发现、密钥配对、SSH 跨网直连指挥。

plugins.name: dsh-achievements
plugins.author: luumod
plugins.description: Achievement and gamification plugin: unlock badges for turns, tool calls, sessions, daily streaks and coding behavior (edits/reads/tests), with a badge wall, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements SDK.
plugins.description_zh: 成就与游戏化插件：按回合、工具调用、会话、连续天数与编码行为（编辑/读取/测试）解锁徽章，带徽章墙、解锁 toast 与 ctx.achievements SDK。

plugins.name: dsh-acp-enhanced
plugins.author: grunmin
plugins.description: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive, per-session MCP servers, and Zed file/terminal forwarding.
plugins.description_zh: 增强版 ACP 服务器：块级与推理流式、用量遥测、模型/推理强度切换、权限预设、会话恢复/归档、每会话 MCP servers、Zed 文件/终端转发。

plugins.name: dsh-adb
plugins.author: SamXiaBing
plugins.description: ADB device & bench operations for DSH: device discovery, structured logcat (background streaming), apk install, file pull/push, and dumpsys performance snapshots.
plugins.description_zh: ADB 设备·台架运维工具集：设备发现、结构化 logcat（后台采集）、apk 安装、文件 pull/push、性能快照。

plugins.name: dsh-agency-agents
plugins.author: MichengAI
plugins.description: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.
plugins.description_zh: 增加可召唤的领域专家名单，专家以子代理运行，主会话保留任务和最终答复。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-budget
plugins.author: vibeinging
plugins.description: Agent-tree token budget management.
plugins.description_zh: agent 树 token 预算管理。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-preset-recommender
plugins.author: LeemanCheung
plugins.description: Bounded, privacy-safe local scanner for Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and CodeBuddy metadata: atomically aggregates keyed evidence and deterministically advises built-in DSH presets and optional capabilities—without content retention, network access, or preset mutation.
plugins.description_zh: 有界、隐私安全的本地扫描器：汇总 Codex、Claude Code、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 元数据，原子保存密钥化聚合证据，并确定性推荐 DSH 内置 preset 与可选能力；不保留正文、不联网、不修改 preset。

plugins.name: dsh-aigc-radar
plugins.author: Kaixxrua
plugins.description: Search AIGC Radar's curated GitHub AI project library (500-star admission, bilingual zh/en tags, star-growth snapshots) over its MCP endpoint with native result cards; an agent/pre-step listener proactively suggests a reuse check before the agent writes code.
plugins.description_zh: 检索 AIGC Radar 精选 GitHub AI 项目库（500 Stars 准入、中英双语标签、星标增长快照），经其 MCP 端点调用并以原生结果卡片展示；agent/pre-step 监听器在 agent 动手写代码前主动建议复用检查。

plugins.name: dsh-anchored-monitor
plugins.author: Aik358
plugins.description: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.
plugins.description_zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

plugins.name: dsh-api-gateway
plugins.author: litestartup-com
plugins.description: REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.
plugins.description_zh: 为第三方客户端提供 REST + SSE 网关：API 密钥鉴权、token 流式回包、会话工作区分组，并可接管 GUI 会话继续对话。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-gate
plugins.author: moon09300731
plugins.description: Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe).
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。

plugins.name: dsh-arknights#pramanix-eyjafjalla
plugins.author: DocJlm
plugins.description: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

plugins.name: dsh-ask-guard
plugins.author: Q1hangL
plugins.description: Cooperative timeout guard for ask_user_question: lost or unanswered questions resolve as a structured ASK_TIMEOUT instead of hanging the turn forever.
plugins.description_zh: 为 ask_user_question 提供协作式超时守卫：提问卡片丢失或用户未答复时以结构化 ASK_TIMEOUT 结束调用，避免回合无限挂起。

plugins.name: dsh-auth-gate
plugins.author: TecFancy
plugins.description: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页端登录门插件：账号口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速，附用户管理 CLI（0.4.1 起声明 dsh.bundle manifest，`dsh plugin add` 一键挂载）。

plugins.name: dsh-automation
plugins.author: MichengAI
plugins.description: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

plugins.name: dsh-bell-notify
plugins.author: Laplace-bit
plugins.description: Lifecycle bells and a status dot: per-event chimes synthesized live with Web Audio (zero audio files), plus a breathing indicator for agent state.
plugins.description_zh: 生命周期铃声与状态点：为每个环节合成专属提示音（Web Audio，零音频文件），右下角呼吸状态点显示工作状态。

plugins.name: dsh-bili-widget
plugins.author: pyf2818
plugins.description: Floating Bilibili video mini-player for DSH — always-on-top window with discover/search/follow-UP channels, auto-playlist, mini & focus modes, persisted watch history and window minimize-to-ball.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 里的 B站悬浮看片小窗：置顶窗口，含推荐/热门/排行/精选/关注/AI 频道与搜索，自动连播、迷你专注模式、历史持久化与最小化悬浮球。

plugins.name: dsh-bill
plugins.author: Jannchie
plugins.description: Cost tracking priced from an online catalogue (models.dev + OpenRouter, 8000+ models, each call priced at its own instant): a per-turn cost line, a Cost tab attributing spend to tool output / model output / system prompt / commands, budget, monthly forecast, ~166 live-rate currencies, and a bill_stats agent tool.
plugins.description_zh: 按在线价格目录计价的费用统计（models.dev + OpenRouter，8000+ 模型，每次调用按自身时刻定价）：每轮成本行、把花费归因到工具输出 / 模型输出 / 系统提示词 / 终端命令的「费用」标签页、预算、月度预测、约 166 种实时汇率货币，以及 bill_stats agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-biomemory
plugins.author: KLRSL
plugins.description: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: plain-Markdown data layer, memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection, graded approval gating, structured audits, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall, /memory command, and cross-session retrieval.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的生物仿生记忆系统：纯 Markdown 数据层、memory 工具、冻结快照注入、分级审批门、结构化审计、记忆代谢（dream）、记忆钉、语义检索、/memory 命令与跨会话召回。

plugins.name: dsh-browser-fs
plugins.author: whitefirer
plugins.description: Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.
plugins.description_zh: 让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。

plugins.name: dsh-captain
plugins.author: KanoNoUta
plugins.description: GPT plans dependency DAGs, DeepSeek workers execute tasks with adaptive parallelism, and an optional GPT reviewer audits incremental Git diffs and drives repair rounds.
plugins.description_zh: GPT 规划依赖 DAG，DeepSeek Worker 自适应并行执行任务，可选 GPT Reviewer 审核增量 Git Diff 并驱动返工轮次。

plugins.name: dsh-chameleon#bundle
plugins.author: lsz-asd
plugins.description: Self-editing desktop workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a full dsh web replica with an edit mode in which the agent modifies the workbench (patch layers, plugins, UI) with hot reload.
plugins.description_zh: 可自修改的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面工作台：完整 dsh web 副本 + 编辑模式，agent 在对话中实时修改工作台（补丁层、插件、UI）并热更新生效。

plugins.name: dsh-chatgpt-subscription
plugins.author: songoao25
plugins.description: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.
plugins.description_zh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定你的 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内直接使用 ChatGPT 模型对话，消耗 Plus/Pro 订阅额度。

plugins.name: dsh-code-check
plugins.author: a179-sanae
plugins.description: Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop.
plugins.description_zh: 自动类型检查诊断：模型编辑/创建 TS 文件后后台防抖运行 `tsc --noEmit`，经 `code_check` 工具按文件分组汇报错误（行列号 + 严重级别 + TS 错误码），形成「改 → 查 → 修」闭环。

plugins.name: dsh-code-reference
plugins.author: victorzhong0110
plugins.description: Surveys local code and GitHub/npm for reusable implementations before development, evaluates reuse versus rewrite, and checks architecture coupling.
plugins.description_zh: 在开发前检索本地代码与 GitHub/npm 的可复用实现，评估复用与重写成本，并检查架构耦合。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-connect-plus
plugins.author: stoneface10
plugins.description: Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 添加基于 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 的 Codex 模型及 gpt-image-2 文生图和编辑能力，无需 OpenAI Platform API Key。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-meter
plugins.author: ChrisZhangWG
plugins.description: Adds a Settings Usage dashboard for DeepSeek API balance, official token and cost analysis, trends, context warnings, and live API activity.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置中添加 DeepSeek API 用量仪表板，显示余额、官方 Token 与费用分析、趋势、上下文警告及实时 API 活动。

plugins.name: DSH-CODEX-SUBSCRIPTION-POOL
plugins.author: Eve-146T
plugins.description: Use your ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions in DSH, with image generation and web search support.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 中使用你的 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，并支持图像生成和 Web 搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-timeline
plugins.author: Wine-Red
plugins.description: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.
plugins.description_zh: 左侧用户轮次导航轨道：随阅读位置高亮，悬停预览单轮指标与模型回答摘要，支持键盘和点击跳转及本地会话搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-coding-subscription-oauth
plugins.author: lninghaha
plugins.description: Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.
plugins.description_zh: 编码订阅 OAuth，支持 SuperGrok / Grok Build、ChatGPT Plus Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code，并提供可选 loopback OpenAI/Anthropic 网关：本地登录无需粘贴 token，支持 AUTH 刷新重试、grok-4.6 xhigh，并可与 API-key 路由共存。

plugins.name: dsh-crosstalk
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-pet
plugins.author: txlznbzsdj-collab
plugins.description: Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states.
plugins.description_zh: 浮动在 DSH Web 页面上的 DeepSeek 蓝色小鲸鱼桌宠：可拖拽，说话气泡与心情姿势随互动切换，模型可调用 pet_say 工具让它开口，对话开始/结束时自动进入思考与庆祝状态。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-usage-dashboard
plugins.author: izz-BLUE
plugins.description: DeepSeek API usage dashboard for DSH Web: daily cache-hit/miss and output token statistics from session logs, per-model cost estimates, account balance, 7-day trends, and a composer usage summary.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek API 用量仪表盘：基于会话日志统计每日缓存命中/未命中输入与输出 Token，并展示分模型费用估算、账户余额、7 日趋势和 composer 用量摘要。

plugins.name: dsh-deeptutor
plugins.author: TecFancy
plugins.description: DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.
plugins.description_zh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-launcher
plugins.author: Yvesgao
plugins.description: Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置页一键创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式：为 DeepSeek Harness 或任意本地服务生成 .cmd 启动器与桌面图标，自动打开浏览器、可固定任务栏。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-shortcut
plugins.author: fuyue521
plugins.description: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
plugins.description_zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

plugins.name: dsh-devquest
plugins.author: lucky8197
plugins.description: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.
plugins.description_zh: 把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、27+ 成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动、纯函数计分——你的工作就是游戏。

plugins.name: dsh-devtoolbox
plugins.author: jean3690
plugins.description: Local toolbox for the DSH web GUI: 35 pure-client tools (text, encoding, hashing, extraction, conversion, reference tables) in a sidebar view, plus the /toolbox command and config-driven agent tool exposure.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 本地工具箱：侧边栏独立页面内置 35 个纯本地小工具（文本、编码、哈希、提取、转换、速查表），另有 /toolbox 命令与配置驱动的 agent 工具注册。

plugins.name: dsh-diagram
plugins.author: hanzhangzzz
plugins.description: Editable Excalidraw diagrams for DeepSeek Harness conversations.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话中的可编辑 Excalidraw 图表。

plugins.name: dsh-digipet
plugins.author: swaylq
plugins.description: Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.
plugins.description_zh: 数码宝贝式养成：孵一颗吃真实工作长大的蛋（回合、工具调用、报错都是营养），按你的工作方式走四条进化分支；零 token，模型完全看不见。

plugins.name: dsh-discord
plugins.author: suuuuuu-1
plugins.description: Discord-native remote controller for DeepSeek Harness: drive persisted coding-agent sessions from DMs, mention-gated guild channels, and threads, with slash commands, progress updates, approvals, structured questions, and image and text attachments.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Discord 原生远程控制器：通过私信、需提及机器人的服务器频道及 Thread 操作持久化的编程 Agent Session，并支持斜杠命令、进度更新、工具审批、结构化问题、图片和文本附件。

plugins.name: dsh-draw-router
plugins.author: xiaozhe7772222
plugins.description: Universal image generation for DeepSeek Harness: auto-discovers image models from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (SenseNova, StepFun, Agnes, Qwen, Flux, SD, Imagen and more), with agent tools and REST API.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 统一生图路由：自动识别任意 OpenAI 兼容端点的绘图模型（商汤、阶跃、Agnes、千问、Flux、SD、Imagen 等），提供 Agent 工具与 REST API。

plugins.name: dsh-ds-attach
plugins.author: wqx-txdsyl
plugins.description: **DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.
plugins.description_zh: **DeepSeek Chat（chat.deepseek.com）同款附件**：回形针上传按钮、240×64 DS 风格文件卡片（官方彩色文档图标，从 DS 前端 bundle 提取）、拖拽上传、文本提取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）注入消息、对话流中渲染真实附件卡片（自定义 user 渲染器）且模型读取完整内容。

plugins.name: dsh-ecc
plugins.author: gongyijie85
plugins.description: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
plugins.description_zh: ECC（227k⭐ 操作员系统）273 个技能（95.8%）分四批移植到 DSH。

plugins.name: dsh-edit-approval
plugins.author: SiriLee
plugins.description: Per-edit approval for write/edit/str_replace_editor: shows a red/green line diff before the file is touched and asks approve once or reject, with a master switch in Settings.
plugins.description_zh: write/edit/str_replace_editor 编辑前审批：改动落盘前展示红绿行级 diff，选择同意一次或拒绝，带设置页总开关。

plugins.name: dsh-enter-customizer
plugins.author: Boliban
plugins.description: Take over the system input shortcuts for the chat input box and configure behavior independently for each shortcut.
plugins.description_zh: 接管聊天输入框的回车等快捷键，每个快捷键的行为都能单独配置。

plugins.name: dsh-everything-oauth
plugins.author: kam74515-boop
plugins.description: Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.
plugins.description_zh: 把本机 Codex / Grok / Claude / OpenCode / CC Switch 登录态导入 DSH，在设置里自选来源并启用模型。

plugins.name: dsh-exam-countdown
plugins.author: zimai233
plugins.description: Query 64 Chinese exams (高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…) with rule-aware date math (2nd-Saturday, 1st-Sunday) and countdowns.
plugins.description_zh: 查询 64 场中国考试（高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…）的规则日期（第二个周六、第一个周日）与倒计时。

plugins.name: dsh-fabric
plugins.author: hellosky983
plugins.description: Unifies every DSH extensibility seam behind one declarative DSL: a runtime `fabric` service, `fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` tools, and a capability-graph settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 用一套声明式 DSL 统一 DSH 的所有可扩展接缝：提供 `fabric` 运行时服务、`fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` 工具，以及能力图谱设置页。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu
plugins.author: itr-del
plugins.description: Feishu (Lark) IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness via `dsh plugin add`; one DM user to one persistent dsh session, with full debugging docs.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 私聊桥接插件，支持 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装，配套完整调试文档。

plugins.name: dsh-forge
plugins.author: alex04130
plugins.description: Runtime extension suite for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session mailbox with wake cold-start, agent teams (captain + members + dependency task board + team_wait), subagent spawn policy with escalation approval, task-aware routing preset, plugin market, skill manager and runtime injector.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 扩展套件：跨会话邮箱与 wake 冷启动、代理团队（队长 + 成员 + 依赖任务板 + team_wait）、子代理派发策略（提权自动审批）、任务感知路由 preset、插件市场、技能管理器与运行时注入器。

plugins.name: dsh-foundry
plugins.author: hellosky983
plugins.description: Plugin compiler with a blueprint registry (scaffold → validate → deploy) exposed as a runtime service, three model tools, and a blueprint-gallery settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 插件编译器：以运行时服务提供蓝图注册表（脚手架 → 校验 → 部署），配三个模型工具和一个蓝图画廊设置页。

plugins.name: dsh-free-vision
plugins.author: FuzzySoul
plugins.description: Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.
plugins.description_zh: 免费视觉插件：纯文本模型看图 / OCR / UI / 报错分析，优先免费模型（千问 Qwen3-VL-Flash、豆包、DeepSeek-OCR），设置界面可配置。

plugins.name: dsh-genome
plugins.author: Elohia
plugins.description: Capability transform & assembly engine (Qian Xuesen cybernetics/systems framework): static resident layer manages the skill/MCP/plugin registries, auto-absorbs skills and tool metrics, and drives a negative-feedback evolution loop (scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select promote/reject → 30s rollback); includes a Web UI panel and a GitHub dsh-plugin store bridge.
plugins.description_zh: 能力转化与组装引擎（钱学森工程控制论/系统论框架）：静态常驻层管理 skill/MCP/插件三库、自动吸收技能与工具度量，驱动负反馈进化闭环（scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select 晋升/淘汰 → 30s 回滚）；含 Web UI 面板与 GitHub dsh-plugin 商店桥。

plugins.name: dsh-git-graph
plugins.author: WhitePlusMS
plugins.description: Dedicated read-only Git Graph view beside Chat and Trajectory: commit topology, local/remote/tag refs, HEAD and working-tree status, search, filtering, first-parent mode, refresh, and load more.
plugins.description_zh: Chat 和 Trajectory 旁的独立 Git Graph 视图：提交拓扑、本地/远程/tag 引用、HEAD 与工作区状态、搜索、筛选、首父模式、刷新和加载更多。

plugins.name: dsh-git-hygiene
plugins.author: lucky8197
plugins.description: Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).
plugins.description_zh: Git 卫生巡检：只读扫描已合并/过期分支、大文件、未跟踪文件与未提交修改，输出体检报告与清理建议，不自动删除任何东西。

plugins.name: dsh-gitflow
plugins.author: lonelymoon87
plugins.description: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
plugins.description_zh: 增加需要审批的 Git 状态、diff、日志、提交、分支和可选检查点工具。

plugins.name: dsh-go-balance
plugins.author: iamfromchangsha
plugins.description: OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-zh-cn
plugins.author: zjl1989-li
plugins.description: Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 中文汉化插件：通过 system-prompt/assemble 瀑布钩子在运行时把全部系统提示词、工具描述与运行时上下文翻译成中文（1788 条译文，零源码修改，卸载即还原英文）。

plugins.name: dsh-hermes-memory
plugins.author: isheng-eqi
plugins.description: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 上 hermes-agent 记忆机制的忠实移植（MEMORY.md / USER.md）：有界双记忆库（2200/1375 字符）、单个 memory 工具（add/replace/remove/batch 全有或全无）、每会话冻结快照注入与 nudge 提醒、DSH 原生 JSON 存储——零外部依赖、零 LLM 成本。

plugins.name: dsh-history
plugins.author: chenproton
plugins.description: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and click-to-jump that auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded.
plugins.description_zh: 会话历史消息查看：列出当前会话全部你发送的消息，支持排序、搜索、一键复制与点击跳转定位（目标未加载时自动加载更早历史）。

plugins.name: dsh-hooks
plugins.author: PeterBon
plugins.description: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.
plugins.description_zh: 配置驱动生命周期 hooks：在 cordis.patch.yml 声明事件→命令，附飞书卡片通知与扫码一键创建机器人。

plugins.name: dsh-image-gen
plugins.author: LeemanCheung
plugins.description: GPT Image 2 `image_gen` with Codex subscription OAuth by default or explicit API-key mode: developing card, up to three live API partials, durable attachment replay/lightbox/download, text-only model output, and bounded credential-safe requests.
plugins.description_zh: GPT Image 2 `image_gen`：默认复用 Codex 订阅 OAuth，也可显式使用 API Key；显影卡片、最多 3 张 API 实时局部图、持久附件回放/灯箱/下载、纯文本模型输出和受限的凭据安全请求。

plugins.name: dsh-input-traffic
plugins.author: drscrewdriver
plugins.description: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with freeze/resume and in-place multi-line editing.
plugins.description_zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持冻结/恢复与多行原位编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-kb-rag
plugins.author: Breeze136
plugins.description: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 8 tools (PDF/folder/Zotero ingest, hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, scope/strict modes, dedup/clear/stats), all-local bge embeddings + single-file SQLite, measured 242-doc/86s ingest and sub-second hot queries on 20k chunks.
plugins.description_zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：8 个工具（PDF/文件夹/Zotero 入库、BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答、范围/严格模式、去重/清空/统计），全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件 SQLite，实测 242 篇 86s 入库、2 万块亚秒热查询。

plugins.name: dsh-kb-sieve
plugins.author: omdsh-dev
plugins.description: Build auditable KB packs (SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval and original-text reading.
plugins.description_zh: 从 md/txt/docx/pdf 构建可审计知识库包（SQLite FTS5），确定性检索与原文阅读。

plugins.name: dsh-Kimi-WebBridge
plugins.author: MicroHEROX
plugins.description: Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 通过本地 Kimi WebBridge 守护进程驱动用户的真实浏览器：navigate、find-tab、snapshot、click、fill、evaluate、CDP、screenshot、network、upload、PDF 导出与标签管理工具，复用浏览器已登录会话。

plugins.name: dsh-lab
plugins.author: hackerFish
plugins.description: Tested-curation lab for DSH plugins: every entry passes real install/static-scan gates in an isolated environment, with full logs and reproduction commands (Chinese-first).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件实测实验室：每个条目都在隔离环境真机过四关（安装/冒烟/快检/钉版），公开完整日志与复现命令，只发测过的结论。

plugins.name: dsh-learning-mode
plugins.author: CHplus0
plugins.description: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).
plugins.description_zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

plugins.name: dsh-library
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Local document knowledge base: hybrid semantic + keyword retrieval, diversity reranking, citation-aware injection, SQLite index, zero model downloads.
plugins.description_zh: 本地文档知识库：语义+关键词混合检索、多样性重排、引用感知注入，SQLite 索引，零模型下载。

plugins.name: dsh-liquid-glass
plugins.author: Ultronen
plugins.description: One toggle makes the whole DeepSeek Harness shell translucent, with an opacity slider and a custom full-page background.
plugins.description_zh: 一键让整个 DeepSeek Harness 界面通透起来：透明度滑块随心调，背景图自由换。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-codex
plugins.author: NOirBRight
plugins.description: ChatGPT Codex subscription chat: official OAuth, a Sol/Terra/Luna catalog with Fast rows, live usage limits, and optional search and view_image tools.
plugins.description_zh: ChatGPT Codex 订阅聊天：官方 OAuth 登录，Sol/Terra/Luna 目录含 Fast 行，实时额度，以及可选的搜索与 view_image 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-deepseek-vision
plugins.author: NagasakiSoyo-ui
plugins.description: Vision-augmented DeepSeek adapter: a vision-capable model describes image input, then a text-only DeepSeek model reasons over the description.
plugins.description_zh: 视觉增强的 DeepSeek 适配器：由视觉模型把图片描述成文字，纯文本 DeepSeek 模型再基于描述推理。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-github-copilot
plugins.author: lujianjun19
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.
plugins.description_zh: GitHub Copilot LLM 适配器：OAuth 设备码登录、从 Copilot API 动态发现模型、视觉模型图片输入支持（gpt-4.1、gpt-4o），以及 Chat Completions 与 Responses 双协议，按模型自动路由。

plugins.name: dsh-markdown-preview
plugins.author: GitHubJiKe
plugins.description: In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-in-folder stay one click away.
plugins.description_zh: 产物文件聊天内预览：点击产物 chip 直接在对话中渲染 Markdown（宿主侧 markdown-it + highlight.js 代码高亮）、图片或纯文本，系统应用打开与在文件夹中显示仍一键可达。

plugins.name: dsh-mcpguard
plugins.author: ChenLaoshiYF
plugins.description: Scans skills and MCP configs for prompt injection, homoglyphs, hidden Unicode, dangerous shell, and credential leaks.
plugins.description_zh: 扫描 skill 与 MCP 配置中的提示注入、同形字、Unicode 隐形字符、危险 shell 与凭据泄露。

plugins.name: dsh-md-preview
plugins.author: LeslieWylie
plugins.description: Render Markdown to a standalone, self-contained HTML page: an `md_html_render` tool that works in a headless profile, plus a web drawer to browse, preview, edit and export local `.md` files; both share one renderer, with no runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 把 Markdown 渲染为自包含的独立 HTML 页面：提供在 headless 配置下同样可用的 `md_html_render` 工具，以及在网页端浏览、预览、编辑并导出本地 `.md` 文件的抽屉；两个入口共用同一个渲染器，无运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-memory
plugins.author: flymysql
plugins.description: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

plugins.name: dsh-memory
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 DSH 无损会话日志的引用式记忆：蒸馏出的事实带 `(sessionId, eventRange)` 引用，可随时展开回原始日志片段。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-palace
plugins.author: lovezi0
plugins.description: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.
plugins.description_zh: 人类可读的 Markdown 记忆插件：用户级（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md）+ 工作区级双层记忆，每轮自动注入提示词，回合结束自动写日志并按期蒸馏沉淀；可桥接已有 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 记忆目录；内置 memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read 三个工具（自动去重）与中英双语设置页。纯文件存储、无数据库，记事本即可编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-mermaid-image-preview
plugins.author: baconbao
plugins.description: Preview Mermaid diagrams as images via local rendering in DSH Web when the chat message contains a Mermaid fenced code block, and also allow integration with external rendering servers.
plugins.description_zh: 当 DSH Web 中的消息包含 Mermaid 语法时，通过本地渲染以图像形式预览 Mermaid Diagrams，并允许接入外部渲染服务器。

plugins.name: dsh-messaging#messaging-core
plugins.description: Unified messaging gateway for DeepSeek Harness: 27 IM platforms (Telegram, QQ, WeChat, Discord, WhatsApp, Feishu and more) in one plugin, with QR scan-to-authorize, per-platform workspaces, slash commands, and a web setup dialog.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一消息网关：一个插件接入 27 个 IM 平台（Telegram、QQ、微信、Discord、WhatsApp、飞书等），支持扫码授权、每平台独立工作区、斜杠命令与 Web 配置弹窗。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-css
plugins.author: ook826092-cloud
plugins.description: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：紧凑排版、全宽输入卡（含光标修复）、抽屉式侧边栏（点击遮罩关闭）、两页式设置流程、响应式表格与统计、安全触控目标。

plugins.name: dsh-model-picker
plugins.author: genius-alray
plugins.description: Dialog-style model picker for the DSH Web UI: fuzzy search, collapsible provider groups, favorites with a favorites-only filter, and a thinking-level dropdown, replacing the built-in model selector with official UI primitives and DSW tokens.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 模型选择器替换插件：对话框式选择，支持模糊搜索、供应商折叠分组、收藏与只看收藏过滤，以及思考档位下拉，复用官方组件库与 DSW 设计 token。

plugins.name: dsh-model-router
plugins.author: superboy911
plugins.description: Deterministic keyword routing, allowlisted model switching, and an isolated image_gen channel for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 关键词路由与隔离生图插件：确定性关键词路由、白名单模型切换与隔离的 image_gen 生图通道。

plugins.name: dsh-model-search
plugins.author: a1073097082
plugins.description: Adds searchable filtering to the model selector by provider, model name, and model ID; spaces act as wildcards.
plugins.description_zh: 为模型选择器增加按提供方、模型名称和模型 ID 搜索的筛选框，空格表示任意字符。

plugins.name: dsh-models-dev-reasoning
plugins.author: aerince
plugins.description: Adds models.dev reasoning levels to unconfigured third-party DeepSeek Harness models.
plugins.description_zh: 为未配置的第三方 DeepSeek Harness 模型添加 models.dev 推理级别支持。

plugins.name: dsh-monitor
plugins.author: AbnerAI
plugins.description: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
plugins.description_zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

plugins.name: dsh-msg-hub
plugins.author: AbcdefgXW
plugins.description: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
plugins.description_zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

plugins.name: dsh-multi-chat
plugins.author: daetz-coder
plugins.description: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

plugins.name: dsh-neo-skin
plugins.author: 0nt-one
plugins.description: Neo-brutalism skin with two switchable schemes (Blue Command / Aged Newspaper), hard shadows, sharp corners, and light/dark theme support.
plugins.description_zh: 新粗野主义换肤皮肤：双方案（蓝统治 / 做旧报纸）随时切换，硬阴影 + 直角 + 2px 边框结构层，浅色/深色自适应。

plugins.name: dsh-net-tools
plugins.author: izwarm195
plugins.description: Lets sandboxed agents reach the web through your local proxy: net_fetch fetches pages, net_proxy_status reports proxy status.
plugins.description_zh: 让沙箱里的 agent 通过你的本地代理联网：net_fetch 抓取网页，net_proxy_status 查看代理状态。

plugins.name: dsh-notify
plugins.author: yangyongzhen
plugins.description: Task-completion notifications via ServerChan / DingTalk / Feishu / generic webhooks.
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成通知：ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-center
plugins.author: SingleOne
plugins.description: Native desktop and webhook notifications for turn completions, failures, and approval requests, with outcome filters, content rules, privacy controls, and retrying delivery.
plugins.description_zh: 回合完成、失败和待审批时发送跨平台本机通知与 Webhook，支持结果过滤、内容规则、隐私控制和失败重试。

plugins.name: dsh-novel-writer
plugins.author: siweina
plugins.description: Novel writing assistant: chapter library, sentence-pattern analysis (9 categories / emotion curve / style fingerprint), style check, plot tracking, batch import and continuation writing, with per-tool Web UI toggles.
plugins.description_zh: 小说写作助手：章节库管理、句式模式分析（九类句式/情感曲线/风格指纹）、风格自检、伏笔登记、批量导入与续写辅助，带 Web UI 开关。

plugins.name: dsh-open-explorer
plugins.author: YooRarely
plugins.description: Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 会话标题和工作区菜单中添加按钮，用系统文件管理器打开当前 Workspace 根目录。

plugins.name: dsh-open-eyes
plugins.author: Hyp6666
plugins.description: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek routes that analyzes attached and local images through configurable OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, or Anthropic Messages endpoints while leaving image-capable routes native.
plugins.description_zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 路由提供视觉桥接：通过可配置的 OpenAI Responses、Chat Completions 或 Anthropic Messages 端点分析附件与本地图片，同时保持支持图片的路由走原生路径。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
plugins.author: xiaweiliang060035
plugins.description: Floating widget showing real-time OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) for every API key, with rate-limit alerts and automatic key-pool discovery.
plugins.description_zh: 悬浮组件实时显示 OpenCode Go 各 key 用量（滚动/每周/每月），限流预警，自动发现 key 池。

plugins.name: dsh-ops-health
plugins.author: MiraculousGarfield
plugins.description: One-click health check for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar button runs the ops kit's check-health.ps1 through a plain HTTP route (independent of the tool registry) and renders a structured report card; colors follow the active theme, Windows/PowerShell.
plugins.description_zh: 一键健康检查：侧边栏按钮经纯 HTTP 路由（独立于工具注册表）调用 check-health.ps1 并渲染结构化报告卡片；配色跟随当前主题，Windows/PowerShell。

plugins.name: dsh-paste-to-path
plugins.author: Johnny-xuan
plugins.description: Adds a path-backed attachment dock for images, documents, archives, code, and other files, leaving file reading to the Agent's available tools.
plugins.description_zh: 为图片、文档、压缩包、代码及其他文件提供路径附件 Dock，文件读取交由 Agent 的当前可用工具完成。

plugins.name: dsh-pi-tui
plugins.author: lqhl
plugins.description: Differential-rendering TUI front end with streaming markdown and tool cards.
plugins.description_zh: 差分渲染 TUI 前端：流式 Markdown 与工具卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-automations
plugins.author: Sev7een
plugins.description: Settings-based scheduled tasks that run on time or during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with one-time and daily schedules backed by durable task state.
plugins.description_zh: 设置页定时任务：支持准点或 DeepSeek 谷时段执行、单次/每日重复，并持久化任务状态。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-balance
plugins.author: lmmzss-jk
plugins.description: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 余额与会话用量插件：头部余额按钮（Session log 左侧），下拉展示账户余额、实时 token 明细（缓存未命中/命中、缓存写入、输出）、缓存命中率，以及按官方峰谷价自动切换的费用估算。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-description
plugins.author: MysaDC
plugins.description: Bilingual descriptions on every plugin card in the Web Settings plugin list.
plugins.description_zh: 为 Web 设置页插件卡片补上中英文功能说明。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-device-info
plugins.author: lsz-asd
plugins.description: Read-only Windows device information tools: one agent tool per Win32 device category (time, system, cpu, memory, disk, gpu, network, battery, processes, usb, audio, printers) via WMI/CIM and Node os collectors.
plugins.description_zh: 只读的 Windows 设备信息工具：每个 Win32 设备类别一个 agent 工具（时间、系统、CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU、网络、电池、进程、USB、音频、打印机），基于 WMI/CIM 与 Node os 采集。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-git-workflow
plugins.author: truelove-dreamer
plugins.description: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
plugins.description_zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-mall
plugins.author: 1e0zj
plugins.description: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only filter), npm-first installs with same-source anti-squatting checks, update detection, and five agent tools for headless use.
plugins.description_zh: 开放式插件市场：GitHub dsh-plugin 话题实时搜索，逐仓库 package.json 验证（dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明徽章与只看已验证过滤），npm 优先安装带同源防抢注校验，更新检测，并附五个可在无界面环境使用的 agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.author: kkkkkklze
plugins.description: In-web plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: categorized plugin list, preset bundles with one-click switching, import/export and failure auto-rollback, plugin market with one-click install.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页内管理插件：分类列表、预设整合包一键切换与导入导出、失败自动回退、插件市场一键安装。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-muapi
plugins.author: SamurAIGPT
plugins.description: MuApi media-generation tool: a muapi_generate tool that submits and polls jobs against any of MuApi's 100+ image, video, audio, and 3D models through one x-api-key.
plugins.description_zh: MuApi 媒体生成工具：muapi_generate 工具通过一个 x-api-key 提交并轮询 MuApi 100 多个图片、视频、音频与 3D 模型的生成任务。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-notify-sound
plugins.author: ldchaowin
plugins.description: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.
plugins.description_zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-panel
plugins.author: Dylan37670
plugins.description: In-app DSH plugin marketplace panel with curated and full catalogs, keyword and semantic search, Chinese translation, favorites, installed-state tracking, and install/update/uninstall via the official CLI.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 内置插件市场面板：精选与全量目录、关键词与语义搜索、中文翻译、收藏、已安装状态，以及通过官方命令安装、更新和卸载。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-sync
plugins.author: AngLi1997
plugins.description: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
plugins.description_zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-vet
plugins.author: wulun811
plugins.description: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins-store
plugins.author: DshMarketPlace
plugins.description: Browse and install DSH plugins without leaving the harness: a /store command, a Settings → Plugins tab, two agent-callable tools and a bundled skill, with an approval gate that lists the detected risk flags before anything installs.
plugins.description_zh: 不离开 harness 就能找插件、装插件：/store 命令、设置页的插件标签页、两个可供 agent 调用的工具和一个随包技能，安装前先确认并列出检测到的风险项。

plugins.name: dsh-ponytail
plugins.author: gongyijie85
plugins.description: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode: 6 skills adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
plugins.description_zh: Ponytail 最懒资深工程师模式：6 个技能，改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail。

plugins.name: dsh-portable-launcher
plugins.description: One-click portable Windows launcher with CN mirror fallback.
plugins.description_zh: Windows 一键便携启动器，国内镜像回退。

plugins.name: dsh-project-kanban
plugins.author: StruggleYang
plugins.description: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.
plugins.description_zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt
plugins.author: FeatherHunter
plugins.description: Right-side prompt toolbox panel with 24 built-in deep templates plus user-defined ones, accessible via the /prompt slash trigger and a context-aware floating suggestion card; one-click inserts the selected prompt into the composer.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框旁的 prompt 工具箱面板：24 条内置深度模板 + 自定义模板，/prompt 触发源 + 智能推荐悬浮卡，点选即插入当前对话。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-polish
plugins.author: jinhuoooo
plugins.description: One-click ✨ polish button for the composer: rewrites prompts and drafts with WorkBuddy humanizer-style rules (kills AI-flavored phrasing, varies rhythm, mode-aware for instructions/questions/prose) via free Zhipu GLM-4.5-Flash or any OpenAI-compatible API, falling back to offline local rules.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框 ✨ 一键润色按钮：参考 WorkBuddy 润色（humanizer-zh）规则改写提示词与草稿（去除 AI 写作痕迹、调整句式节奏，按指令/提问/普通文本分类处理），默认使用免费的智谱 GLM-4.5-Flash，也支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 API，断网时回退到本地规则引擎。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-access-web#remote-access-web
plugins.author: wikkd
plugins.description: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-replay
plugins.author: MingoZhou
plugins.description: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.
plugins.description_zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

plugins.name: dsh-revdiff
plugins.author: BrambleXu
plugins.description: Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。

plugins.name: dsh-review-loop
plugins.author: wuxiangru915
plugins.description: Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 增量代码审查插件：批准一批改动后只审查检查点之后的新改动，提供 Web 审查面板与 `/review` 命令，并把审查意见注入回 agent。

plugins.name: DSH-Right-Sidebar
plugins.author: Limitinfinitude
plugins.description: DSH Web right-side output dock that collects session artifacts, previews user-facing files, and preserves tab state per session.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 原生右侧产物栏，按会话收集用户产物，预览用户可读文件并保存标签状态。

plugins.name: dsh-rigorquant
plugins.author: linxichen
plugins.description: RigorQuant preset + skill pack: unattended walled multi-agent research for empirical and computational mathematics (economics, finance, portfolio), with a four-part pre-implementation check battery and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane.
plugins.description_zh: RigorQuant 预设与技能包：面向实证与计算数学（经济学、金融、组合）的无人值守隔离多智能体研究，内置四重实现前校验与 jacobian/Lean 升级通道。

plugins.name: dsh-rules-manager#dsh-rules-manager
plugins.author: jilian-dsh
plugins.description: Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 规则、命令与技能管理：/rules 斜杠命令、设置面板可视化编辑规则（增改禁用删除、自由区域支持）、带参数的自定义命令、技能管理、AGENTS.md 自动备份与一键恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-running-liang
plugins.author: skiuniverse
plugins.description: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
plugins.description_zh: 等待 Agent 回复时的恐龙快跑小游戏：常驻进度条从「梁子」冲向「梁圣」，折叠即暂停、任意键恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-self-evolving
plugins.author: timwhitez
plugins.description: Evidence-first, crash-resumable self-evolution engine for DSH: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and an auditable journaled lineage.
plugins.description_zh: 证据优先、可崩溃恢复的自进化引擎：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件、一次性真实 Loader 准入、Harbor 评估，并保留可审计的日志化谱系。

plugins.name: dsh-self-evolving#packages/dsh-self-evolving
plugins.author: timwhitez
plugins.description: Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.
plugins.description_zh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

plugins.name: dsh-serendipity
plugins.author: PocketSWPU
plugins.description: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI.
plugins.description_zh: 把用户本人当作 RPG 主角：每轮对话结束后有几率触发随机「奇遇」，事件库 700+，覆盖科幻/玄幻/远古/动漫/小说/武侠/都市七大主题，增减力量/智力/敏捷/魅力/幸运/体魄六维属性，积累经验升级并随等级解锁更宏大的事件，含属性加权分支与设置页可视化配置。

plugins.name: dsh-session-actions
plugins.author: xingyingyuzhui
plugins.description: Session row menu extras for DeepSeek Harness: pin sessions, copy session id, export structured Markdown, and permanently delete sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 会话行菜单增强：置顶会话、复制会话 ID、导出结构化 Markdown、弹窗确认后永久删除会话。

plugins.name: dsh-session-doctor
plugins.author: mayf3
plugins.description: Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 会话医生：列出会话（含 agent 运行状态）、读取会话记录、诊断卡死的 agent、解卡（cancel + keepInbox 保留排队消息）、向其他会话发送消息。

plugins.name: dsh-session-flow
plugins.author: YeqingTang
plugins.description: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel, rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + header chip (stall detection).
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与头部芯片（疑似卡死识别）。

plugins.name: dsh-session-hotkeys
plugins.author: YEYEYEYESHIFU
plugins.description: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename, navigation mode, search focus), all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets.
plugins.description_zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、导航模式、聚焦搜索，键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。

plugins.name: dsh-session-manager
plugins.author: Semidia
plugins.description: Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
plugins.description_zh: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

plugins.name: dsh-session-pin
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
plugins.description_zh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

plugins.name: dsh-session-report
plugins.author: yangyongzhen
plugins.description: Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.
plugins.description_zh: 会话成本与耗时报表：tokens / 缓存命中 / 耗时。

plugins.name: dsh-share
plugins.author: zljr
plugins.description: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
plugins.description_zh: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。

plugins.name: dsh-shortcuts
plugins.author: Ricketts-Guo
plugins.description: Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 可自定义键盘快捷键：34 个预置功能（会话、视图、剪贴板、模型、静默权限切换、设置），一键录制自定义组合键，内置快捷键速查表与诊断面板。

plugins.name: dsh-sideband
plugins.author: ishuowang
plugins.description: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available.
plugins.description_zh: 无需等待或打断正在工作的 Agent：即时冻结有界 Session 快照，由隔离且无工具的 LLM 异步总结，再将带来源信息的上下文胶囊投递到另一 Session 或已授权 Room；对 Session 默认 quiet，也可显式 wakeup。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-manager
plugins.author: AKS1st
plugins.description: Skill Manager page in the DSH settings panel: browse system / user / workspace / preset skills, expand a skill to its file tree, view and edit files, import skills from a zip, and export or delete them (system skills read-only).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 设置面板内的「技能管理」页面：按系统 / 用户 / 工作区 / 预设浏览技能，展开技能查看文件树、查看和编辑文件，支持从 zip 导入技能，以及导出、删除（系统技能只读）。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-pack-security
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Security-audit methodology skill pack plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an npm provider bundle that mounts the skills and registers the automated plugin_vet pre-install scanner.
plugins.description_zh: 安全审计方法论技能包 + plugin_vet 供应链门禁：八个 agent 技能（密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链评审、提示注入审查、审计总编排、威胁建模、漏洞情报、事件响应），中英双版本，附 npm provider 包一键挂载并注册自动化 plugin_vet 安装前扫描。

plugins.name: dsh-skillport
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.
plugins.description_zh: 把已有的 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）技能库带进 DSH：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录、注入渐进式索引，按需加载技能正文。

plugins.name: dsh-splash-launcher
plugins.author: Isilsolme
plugins.description: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.
plugins.description_zh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-sql
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Database tools for agents: list/query/exec/schema across SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL, with lexer-grade read-only protection, row caps and an approval-gated write path.
plugins.description_zh: 数据库工具：sql_list/query/exec/schema，SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 三引擎，词法级只读保护、行数钳制与写审批门。

plugins.name: dsh-starter-pack
plugins.author: Dariandai
plugins.description: A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.
plugins.description_zh: 精选插件启动包：从设置页或 /setup 命令一键批量安装并配置 4 组共 15 个经过筛选的社区插件。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-tools
plugins.author: lynx-gt
