plugins.description: Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.
plugins.description_zh: 子代理委派的按调用覆盖：model/provider/persona/toolFilter、@preset: 引用与 provider/model 组合 id。

plugins.name: dsh-task-control
plugins.author: p2coder
plugins.description: Pause / resume / cancel the in-flight conversation task from the composer area: forced pause interrupts immediately and remembers the interrupted tool, safe pause lands after the tool or reasoning finishes, resume asks for confirmation, and the default pause granularity is configurable in the settings.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入区暂停/恢复/取消正在运行的对话任务：强制暂停立即中断并记住被中断的工具，安全暂停等工具/推理完成后再落地，恢复时需确认；默认暂停粒度可在设置中配置（出厂 safe wait）。

plugins.name: dsh-tesseract-ocr
plugins.author: maxwell-feng
plugins.description: Local OCR for attached images via Tesseract: only the recognized text is sent to the model, never the image bytes; vision passthrough is opt-in.
plugins.description_zh: 本地 Tesseract 识别附加图片：只把识别出的文字发送给模型，图片字节不进入上下文；视觉直通可选开启。

plugins.name: dsh-test-runner
plugins.author: suimi8
plugins.description: Structured test runner tool: auto-detects Vitest/Jest/pytest/node:test and parses failures.
plugins.description_zh: 结构化测试运行工具：自动识别 Vitest/Jest/pytest/node:test 并解析失败。

plugins.name: dsh-thought-buddy
plugins.author: dsh-plugins
plugins.description: A GrokBot-style animated avatar with a synchronized typewriter status line — right in front of the "Deep diving..." indicator.
plugins.description_zh: 在「Deep diving...」状态提示前，放一只动态小伙伴——GrokBot 风格动画头像，状态文字还会同步打字机变换。

plugins.name: dsh-token-billing
plugins.author: 2006spy
plugins.description: Real-time token billing for DSH web: official DeepSeek CNY pricing with automatic peak/off-peak switching, hourly price sync from the official site, visual custom model prices, and multi-currency fallback.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 实时 token 计费插件：官网人民币价直接计费、高峰/错峰自动切换、价格实时跟随官网、可视化自定义模型价格、多币种兜底。

plugins.name: dsh-token-cost-meter
plugins.author: YZz-S
plugins.description: Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框下方统计行实时显示当前会话累计 token 消耗与估算费用（人民币），价格从 DeepSeek 官方价格页动态获取。

plugins.name: dsh-token-pet
plugins.author: pk7j7sqryy-ops
plugins.description: Cute token-usage widget in the session header: a Bubu doll plus context occupancy, session usage and breakdown, with date/weekday, weather, 3-day forecast and severe-weather alerts (raindrop/snowflake animation), following the theme color.
plugins.description_zh: 会话头部卡通用量小部件：布布玩偶 + 上下文占用/会话累计/构成，附日期周几、天气、3 天预报与极端天气预警（雨滴/雪花动画），跟随主题色。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-search
plugins.author: vibeinging
plugins.description: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.
plugins.description_zh: 按 agent 的按需工具发现与渐进式 schema 披露。

plugins.name: dsh-trace
plugins.author: vibeinging
plugins.description: Telemetry backend exporting turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace.
plugins.description_zh: 遥测后端：把 turns、model steps、tool calls 导出到 yiTrace。

plugins.name: dsh-tui
plugins.author: xiaoshihou514
plugins.description: Clean and simple TUI.
plugins.description_zh: 干净简单的终端交互式界面。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-approval
plugins.author: arrow949
plugins.description: Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching `danger-full-access` escalations only for the current task, then expire.
plugins.description_zh: DSH「允许本次任务」临时授权：仅在当前任务内自动放行同类 `danger-full-access` 请求，任务结束自动失效。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-fold
plugins.author: Winter-And-You-Gone
plugins.description: Automatically folds tool calls into Think-segment groups and collapses each finished turn into a single header showing duration, token, throughput, and cache-hit metrics.
plugins.description_zh: 工具调用按 Think 段自动分组折叠；回合结束后整回合收成一个大组头，显示耗时/token/tok/s/缓存命中率指标。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-navigator
plugins.author: vibeinging
plugins.description: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 对话轮次导航。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-rail
plugins.author: Yujm888
plugins.description: Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格自动隐藏右缘轮次导航：靠边浮现、单轮 tooltip、会话内搜索、长会话 30 轮滚动窗口。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-hub
plugins.author: Han-1413141
plugins.description: UI butler for every plugin UI: official/plugin categories, per-widget toggles, drag move/resize, collision avoidance and one-click auto arrange.
plugins.description_zh: UI 管家：官方/插件 UI 分区折叠、逐条开关，拖拽移动/改大小，碰撞避让与一键自动排布。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-mobile
plugins.author: jasondu
plugins.description: Mobile-first DeepSeek Harness UI with an installable PWA, responsive navigation, and Web Push notifications when an agent completes successfully.
plugins.description_zh: 面向手机的 DeepSeek Harness 界面，提供可安装 PWA、响应式导航，以及 Agent 成功完成时的 Web Push 通知。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-tweaks
plugins.author: wlj521
plugins.description: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.
plugins.description_zh: 从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-usage-billing
plugins.author: kenz1117
plugins.description: Sidebar billing dashboard: real usage aggregated from session logs (per-model and per-day calls/tokens/cache), cost estimated in CNY from a current multi-provider pricing catalog, subscription-plan (coding/token/agent) routes exempt, and per-provider health dots.

plugins.author: WJNCT55555
plugins.description: Achievement system for the DSH Web UI: gallery with category/rarity sorting, unlock toasts, sidebar trophy, composer dock, crossover achievements, and local persistence.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 成就系统：画廊支持按分类/难度双排序、解锁 toast、侧栏奖杯、输入坞进度读条、联动成就，并本地持久化进度。

plugins.name: dsh-active-context-pruning
plugins.author: aerince
plugins.description: Model-authored context pruning for DeepSeek Harness through the official compaction API.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的模型驱动上下文裁剪插件，通过官方 compaction API 释放上下文空间。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-conductor
plugins.author: MJorgin
plugins.description: Dispatch self-contained tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok): a host-only bundle registering the conductor_dispatch tool plus an auto-triggered conductor skill.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 里派活给 11 种外部 agent CLI（Codex、Claude Code、TraeCode、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Kimi、Qwen、Copilot、WorkBuddy、Grok）：host-only bundle 注册 conductor_dispatch 工具，附自动触发的指挥家技能。

plugins.name: dsh-agfs
plugins.author: openAGFS
plugins.description: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.
plugins.description_zh: 文件浏览器 Web 应用：React 前端与 REST API 由宿主 webserver 托管，/dsh-agfs 命令自动定位当前工作区，附 browse_files 模型工具。

plugins.name: dsh-alive
plugins.author: AikenFra
plugins.description: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
plugins.description_zh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

plugins.name: dsh-api-balance
plugins.author: GPIOX
plugins.description: Floating API-balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: live balance for DeepSeek, Moonshot, OpenAI and custom endpoints; draggable, resizable, frosted-glass look, with text color adapting to the content beneath.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 悬浮 API 余额徽章：实时显示 DeepSeek / Moonshot / OpenAI / 自定义接口余额；可拖动缩放、亚克力质感、文字颜色随下方内容明暗自适应。

plugins.name: dsh-apple-mode
plugins.author: jihongboo
plugins.description: Xcode AI integration for DSH: 26 Xcode MCP tools (mcpbridge) + Apple platform skills + Xcode Intelligence-style persona (agent preset or global bundle).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 Xcode AI 集成：26 个 Xcode MCP 工具（mcpbridge）+ Apple 平台技能 + Xcode Intelligence 风格 persona（agent preset 或全局 bundle）。

plugins.name: dsh-argp
plugins.author: yoza10635
plugins.description: Deterministic context compaction: prunes conversation atoms in reference-graph topological order with no LLM calls during compaction, and keeps pruned atoms recallable by marker.
plugins.description_zh: 确定性上下文压缩：按引用图拓扑序摘除对话原子，压缩阶段不调用 LLM；被摘除的原子保留 marker，可按需回拉。

plugins.name: dsh-aura-scheduler
plugins.author: ljsysfurryACE
plugins.description: Proactive scheduling: an adaptive heartbeat plus a value network (urgency, relevance, interruption cost) decides when the agent should speak unprompted.
plugins.description_zh: 主动调度：自适应心跳 + 价值网络（紧迫度、相关性、打断代价）决定 Agent 何时主动开口。

plugins.name: dsh-auth
plugins.author: hxy91819
plugins.description: Caddy forward_auth administrator login for DeepSeek Harness Web, with Argon2id passwords, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, and a native sidebar sign-out action.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 Caddy forward_auth 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供管理员登录，含 Argon2id 口令、可撤销会话、中英界面和侧栏原生退出。

plugins.name: dsh-auth-tunnel
plugins.author: ai-eks
plugins.description: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
plugins.description_zh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-compact
plugins.author: songoao25
plugins.description: Enhanced auto-compaction defaults for DeepSeek Harness agent presets: apply tuned threshold/retention budgets and per-model policies with one command, idempotent with backups and rollback.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 智能体预设注入增强的自动压缩默认值：一键应用调优的触发阈值/保留比例与分模型策略，幂等执行、自动备份、可回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-exit
plugins.author: xiaxingtianxia2-glitch
plugins.description: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
plugins.description_zh: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-vision
plugins.author: NormanFxxkingRockwell
plugins.description: Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.
plugins.description_zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

plugins.name: dsh-bili-summary
plugins.author: YZz-S
plugins.description: Provides the bili_summary tool: Bilibili video metadata, subtitle timeline, and sharp-based frame capture with built-in error handling and graceful degradation.
plugins.description_zh: 提供 bili_summary 工具：B 站视频元数据、字幕时间轴与 sharp 切帧配图，内置错误处理与优雅降级。

plugins.name: dsh-billing-balance
plugins.author: YZz-S
plugins.description: Shows DeepSeek API account balance and Volcengine Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota windows (5h/weekly/monthly with reset countdowns) in the settings panel, composer dock, and a draggable floating refresh button.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置页、输入框下方读数条与可拖动悬浮按钮三处显示 DeepSeek 官方 API 余额与火山方舟 Coding/Agent Plan 套餐额度（5小时/周/月窗口及重置倒计时）。

plugins.name: dsh-budget
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Cost governance: token and cost metering aggregated by model/session/day, with budget caps, threshold alerts, and alert/block/degrade over-limit policies via the /budget command.
plugins.description_zh: 成本治理：按模型/会话/日聚合 token 与成本计量，预算上限 + 阈值告警 + alert/block/degrade 超限策略，/budget 命令。

plugins.name: dsh-cache-miss
plugins.author: wefio
plugins.description: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
plugins.description_zh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

plugins.name: dsh-canvas-preview
plugins.author: jiuyuechuwuhao
plugins.description: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
plugins.description_zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

plugins.name: dsh-capability-index
plugins.author: 777-Zen
plugins.description: Pre-flight plugin-library index for DSH agents: injects per-step trigger-table hints into the runtime context so suitable installed plugins get used predictably instead of opportunistically.
plugins.description_zh: DSH agent 的插件库起飞检查：向运行时上下文注入按步骤触发的提示，让合适的已装插件从「碰巧想起」变成「可预期使用」。

plugins.name: dsh-character-profiler
plugins.author: MlittleFriend
plugins.description: Character consistency toolkit: personality profile cards, appearance-weight stats, and behavioral-drift detection for long-form fiction.
plugins.description_zh: 角色一致性工具包：性格侧写档案、出场权重统计与行为偏离检测。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-tidy
plugins.author: ChuanTianML
plugins.description: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter heading ladder, list and block rhythm, blockquote bar and table cells, with no settings to choose and before/after captures in the README.
plugins.description_zh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文、更紧凑的标题层级、列表与块级节奏、引用条与表格单元格；无需任何设置，README 内附前后对比图。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-width-customizer
plugins.author: magicOF2
plugins.description: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
plugins.description_zh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

plugins.name: dsh-chatvoice
plugins.author: FuzzySoul
plugins.description: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 免费语音闭环：浏览器语音识别输入（实时中间结果上屏）+ 助手回复朗读与自动朗读，零配置、免 API key。

plugins.name: dsh-chinese-thinking
plugins.author: Max-Null
plugins.description: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
plugins.description_zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

plugins.name: dsh-ci
plugins.author: xxiaoxiong
plugins.description: Provider-neutral CI/CD capability for DeepSeek Harness with GitHub Actions support, bounded failure evidence, source-aware diagnostics, and approval-gated rerun/cancel controls.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的通用 CI/CD 能力，支持 GitHub Actions、有限失败证据提取、源码定位诊断，以及带审批控制的重跑与取消操作。

plugins.name: dsh-cite
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Citation tools for agents: exact DOI lookup, Crossref bibliographic search, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago formatting, BibTeX generation and bounded-concurrency DOI validation.
plugins.description_zh: 参考文献工具：DOI 精确查询与 Crossref 题录检索，GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago 格式化，BibTeX 生成与有界并发 DOI 校验。

plugins.name: dsh-clawshell
plugins.author: jorinyang
plugins.description: Self-healing runtime layer: a resource control loop with strategy switching and repair escalation, error-storm and fiber-failure insight, cross-session knowledge carry-over, a self-healing dashboard and 7 tools.
plugins.description_zh: 运行时自愈层：资源控制闭环（策略切换 + 修复升级链）、错误风暴与 fiber 失败洞察、跨会话知识传承，附自愈可视化面板与 7 个工具。

plugins.name: dsh-client-deep-sneak
plugins.author: Rain-Shuoyu
plugins.description: Slacking-off companion: a floating mini player that streams Bilibili videos (native player, danmaku, comments, search) and pauses when your agent needs you, resuming exactly where you left off.
plugins.description_zh: 摸鱼伴侣：右下角小窗播放 B站视频（原生播放器/弹幕/评论/搜索），agent 需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完从原位置精确续播。

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-quote
plugins.author: skyhancloud
plugins.description: Adds a removable quote banner above the web chat composer for text selected from an AI reply, included in the next message.
plugins.description_zh: 在网页聊天输入框上方为选中的 AI 回复内容添加可移除的引用横幅，随下一条消息一并发送。

plugins.name: dsh-code-security
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance and SBOM-lite dependency inventory.
plugins.description_zh: 确定性代码安全审查：40+ 规则、密钥熵检测、staged diff 审查、SARIF 导出、基线接受与 SBOM-lite 依赖清单。

plugins.name: dsh-code-smell
plugins.author: lucky8197
plugins.description: Code smell radar: statically scans TODO/FIXME debt, stub implementations, long lines, oversized files and duplicated blocks, with severity-sorted read-only fix suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: 代码气味雷达：静态扫描 TODO/FIXME 债务、未实现桩、超长行、大文件与重复代码块，按严重度输出修复建议，全程只读。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-ui
plugins.author: MichengAI
plugins.description: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。

plugins.name: dsh-community-hot
plugins.author: littleboylittlegirl
plugins.description: Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 的社区热门悬浮面板：24 小时热门话题与热门插件 TOP10，悬浮按钮可拖动置顶、点击居中展开。

plugins.name: dsh-compressor#dsh-compressor
plugins.author: lifeodyssey
plugins.description: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.
plugins.description_zh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-computer-use-win
plugins.author: Yu-tao-Li
plugins.description: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP stdio server over a PowerShell UIA backend exposing 22 desktop tools (UIA tree, screenshots, typed input, OCR, window management, failsafe).
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 电脑操控：MCP stdio 服务器 + PowerShell UIA 后端，22 个桌面工具（UIA 树、截图、键鼠输入、OCR、窗口管理、急停保护）。

plugins.name: dsh-contract-drafting-agent
plugins.author: songoao25
plugins.description: Contract-drafting agent preset: 11-stage lawyer workflow with 5-way parallel AI review, decision gates, and domain packs for general, employment and equity-investment contracts.
plugins.description_zh: 合同起草模式：11 阶段律师工作流，五路并行 AI 评审与决策门，内置通用/劳动/股权三类合同领域包。

plugins.name: dsh-conversation-minimap
plugins.author: Braidy-Wu
plugins.description: A conversation minimap for the DSH Web GUI (ChatGPT desktop style): one evenly-spaced capsule anchor per user prompt, fish-eye bell-curve magnification on hover with full prompt preview, top/bottom edge fade, blue highlight that follows the current prompt, click to jump to the message, and automatic full-history loading.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 对话迷你地图（复刻 ChatGPT 桌面端）：每轮 Prompt 一个等距胶囊锚点，鱼眼钟形悬停放大 + 完整 Prompt 预览，顶部/底部渐隐，蓝色高亮跟随当前 Prompt，点击跳转对应消息，自动拉取完整历史。

plugins.name: dsh-conversation-share
plugins.author: bill9109
plugins.description: Share any excerpt of a conversation.
plugins.description_zh: 分享任意段落的对话。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-meter
plugins.author: Sttrevens
plugins.description: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。

plugins.name: dsh-coyote
plugins.author: THEWOLFWALKER
plugins.description: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话冷却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。

plugins.name: dsh-cursor-acp
plugins.author: loeanxi
plugins.description: Hands standalone jobs to the Cursor CLI signed in on the same machine, with child-model settings and a read-only connectivity test.
plugins.description_zh: 将独立任务交给同机已登录的 Cursor 命令行，并提供子模型设置和只读连通性测试。

plugins.name: dsh-custom-theme-import
plugins.author: Juryorca
plugins.description: DSH Web custom theme importer: one-click import from local paths or GitHub theme collections, live preview and refresh, hosted theme library; the lightweight format lets authors edit CSS/DOM files and hot-reload, making it a friendly option for personal theme development and sharing.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 自定义主题导入插件：支持本地路径/GitHub 集合一键导入、主题预览与实时刷新、托管主题库；格式轻量，作者可直接改 CSS/DOM 文件热加载，适合个人主题开发与分享。

plugins.name: dsh-cve-audit
plugins.author: SARTHAK2511
plugins.description: Live CVE/supply-chain audit for your workspace's own project dependencies (npm/pip/go), backed by OSV.dev, with a `cve_audit` tool plus optional automatic re-scan on lockfile changes.
plugins.description_zh: 面向你自己项目依赖（npm/pip/go）的实时 CVE/供应链审计，基于 OSV.dev，提供 `cve_audit` 工具，并支持在 lockfile 变化时自动重新扫描。

plugins.name: dsh-data-insight
plugins.author: ClaireXi99
plugins.description: Data analysis toolkit: CSV/TSV/JSON profiling, IQR and z-score anomaly detection, structured summarization with quality issues, and code-free filter/group/aggregate queries.
plugins.description_zh: 数据分析工具包：CSV/TSV/JSON 数据画像、IQR 与 z-score 异常检测、带质量问题提示的结构化摘要、以及无需写代码的筛选/分组/聚合查询。

plugins.name: dsh-data-insight
plugins.author: duyanta123
plugins.description: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
plugins.description_zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-balance
plugins.author: CN-Leo
plugins.description: Real-time DeepSeek account balance in the composer dock, auto-refreshing every 15 seconds with hover details.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，每 15 秒自动刷新，悬停查看总额、赠送与充值明细。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-balance
plugins.author: Choi-Peng
plugins.description: DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-usage
plugins.author: yyb16yyb-hub
plugins.description: Real-time DeepSeek API usage: account balance with low-balance alerts (browser notification on threshold crossing), token & request stats (total/today/last-60s windows, per-model and per-session), estimated cost — a composer dock plus a settings-page usage panel.
plugins.description_zh: 实时 DeepSeek API 用量：账户余额与低余额告警（跨阈值浏览器通知）、请求/token 统计（全部/今日/近 60s，按模型与会话下钻）、估算花费——输入框下方统计条 + 设置页用量面板。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-vision
plugins.author: Cheng-cheng9669
plugins.description: Reuses DeepSeek web's built-in vision mode for text-only models: the deepseek_vision tool drives the local deepseek-vision-cli browser automation (manual login helper, deep-think enabled, auto-closes browser) and returns image descriptions as text.
plugins.description_zh: 复用 DeepSeek 网页端识图模式给纯文本模型补上看图能力：deepseek_vision 工具调用本地 deepseek-vision-cli 浏览器自动化（手动登录助手、自动开启深度思考、用后自动关窗），把图片描述以文字返回给模型。

plugins.name: dsh-depguard
plugins.author: DeLightor
plugins.description: Dependency-topology guard: pre-install conflict prediction and post-install detection of duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-* copies, version drift, and vendored core services that cause Symbol-key crashes like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')".
plugins.description_zh: 依赖拓扑安全：装前预测 + 装后检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 多副本、版本漂移与插件私包，防 Symbol 键冲突崩溃（Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')）。

plugins.name: dsh-devtools
plugins.author: izz-BLUE
plugins.description: Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

plugins.name: dsh-doc-guard
plugins.author: lucky8197
plugins.description: Document-code consistency guard: audits version headers / changelog tables / directory trees / module & test counts / cross-doc references for drift, with severity-sorted, read-only fix suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: 文档与代码一致性守护：版本号/更新记录表/结构树/模块清单/测试计数/交叉引用漂移审计与修复建议，全程只读。

plugins.name: dsh-docker
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.
plugins.description_zh: 类型安全、带护栏的容器控制：ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop 与 compose up/down，JSON 输出、项目感知定位、破坏性操作需审批。

plugins.name: dsh-doctor
plugins.author: jorinyang
plugins.description: DSH environment diagnosis, graded repair with one-click rollback, and a runtime self-healing service.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 环境诊断、分级修复与一键回滚，附带运行时自愈服务。

plugins.name: dsh-doctor
plugins.author: asdf17128
plugins.description: Registers a `config_doctor` tool that checks the harness's own configuration for problems that boot silently: fields a patch dropped by whole-config replacement, patches targeting missing entry ids, and tool-name collisions. Read-only.
plugins.description_zh: 注册 `config_doctor` 工具，检查 harness 自身配置里那些会静默通过启动的问题：patch 整体替换 config 而丢失的字段、指向不存在 entry id 的 patch、工具重名冲突。只读。

plugins.name: dsh-doctor#plugin
plugins.author: moonquake2004
plugins.description: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
plugins.description_zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

plugins.name: dsh-draw-gacha
plugins.author: Aik358
plugins.description: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
plugins.description_zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

plugins.name: dsh-egress-guard
plugins.author: tancheng33
plugins.description: Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode.
plugins.description_zh: 工具管线上的运行时安全网关：拦截出站白名单之外的主机调用，在 canonical value（而非仅渲染内容）层面脱敏结果中的凭据，每个决策写入 JSONL 审计日志；默认仅监控不拦截。

plugins.name: dsh-engineering-workflow
plugins.author: 82c86b8z86-stack
plugins.description: Engineering workflow agent preset for dsh: five gated phases (requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagents, verified finishing) with six workflow skills adapted from obra/superpowers.
plugins.description_zh: 工程化工作流 agent preset：五阶段硬门禁（需求澄清、计划审批、TDD、子 Agent 并行、验证收尾），附 6 个改编自 obra/superpowers 的工作流技能。

plugins.name: dsh-eye-vision
plugins.author: AlloyPlane
plugins.description: Vision bridge for text-only models: image_understand tool via any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API (OCR/UI analysis), with an allowed-directories whitelist.
plugins.description_zh: 纯文本模型识图桥接：通过任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API 提供 image_understand 工具（识图/OCR/UI 分析），支持允许目录白名单。

plugins.name: dsh-eyes
plugins.author: Leeminjing
plugins.description: On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek models: upload images, and the model calls a view_image tool backed by any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (Qwen/DashScope by default).
plugins.description_zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供按需视觉：上传图片后，模型通过 view_image 工具调用任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点（默认 Qwen/DashScope）。

plugins.name: dsh-figma-to-lottie
plugins.author: zimai233
plugins.description: Compile SVG paths and keyframe specs into self-contained Lottie JSON animation files.
plugins.description_zh: 将 SVG 路径与关键帧参数编译成自包含的 Lottie JSON 动画文件。

plugins.name: dsh-file
plugins.author: chengzhi43
plugins.description: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
plugins.description_zh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

plugins.name: dsh-file-uploads
plugins.author: l541402398
plugins.description: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web 输入框上传任意本地文件，以待发送卡片展示，并在设置中管理已存文件。

plugins.name: dsh-flakefinder
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history and maintain a quarantine manifest.
plugins.description_zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档与隔离清单。

plugins.name: dsh-fleet-audit
plugins.author: LeslieWylie
plugins.description: Read-only agent-fleet credential hygiene audit: credential-file permissions, embedded credentials in git remotes (masked in output), and provider token literal counts; zero-dependency and deterministic.
plugins.description_zh: 只读的 agent 机群凭据卫生审计：检查凭据文件权限、git remote 内嵌凭据（输出脱敏）与 provider token 字面量计数；零依赖、确定性。

plugins.name: dsh-focus-overlay
plugins.author: boogoo619
plugins.description: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
plugins.description_zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

plugins.name: dsh-frosted-window
plugins.author: SenryLee
plugins.description: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme: sidebar/conversation/details share one frost layer, Save/Delete, official Light/Dark/System stay in charge.
plugins.description_zh: 上传图片作为整窗磨砂玻璃主题：侧栏/会话/详情同一层磨砂，保存/删除，官方浅色/深色/跟随系统仍有效。

plugins.name: dsh-galgame-generator
plugins.author: baisama-cloud
plugins.description: Galgame generator: give it a script document plus character/background/BGM/animation assets in the workspace (img_human/, img_bg/, audio/, img_cg/) and it builds a playable visual-novel web page with configurable save slots (`[存档 N]`, default 9), speaker-following sprites with multi-pose variant switching (`[表情]`), opening/ending/CG animations (`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`), BGM play/stop/volume control, and if-line branching.
plugins.description_zh: Galgame 生成器：提供剧本文档与立绘/背景/音乐/动画素材（工作区 img_human/、img_bg/、audio/、img_cg/）即可生成可玩视觉小说网页，支持可配置存档槽位（`[存档 N]`，默认 9）、立绘自动跟随说话人并切换多表情立绘（`[表情]`）、开局/结束/CG 动画（`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`）、BGM 播放/停止/音量控制与 if 条件线分支。

plugins.name: dsh-genie
plugins.author: swaylq
plugins.description: Keeps what the agent builds at runtime: turns a `cordis_define` dynamic package into a real installed plugin that survives restart, writing the bundle and registering the profile layer with no pnpm, no network, and no build authorization.
plugins.description_zh: 把 agent 现场造出来的插件留下来：将 `cordis_define` 的动态包固化成能跨重启存活的正式插件，写包并注册 profile 层的全过程不用 pnpm、不联网、不需要构建授权。

plugins.name: dsh-git-status
plugins.author: Wongzexu
plugins.description: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
plugins.description_zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。

plugins.name: dsh-git-workflow
plugins.author: yangyongzhen
plugins.description: Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
plugins.description_zh: 规范提交（Conventional Commits）、自动 changelog、PR 描述生成与分支推送，纯 git CLI 实现。

plugins.name: dsh-git-worktree
plugins.author: LaoYueHanNi
plugins.description: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

plugins.name: dsh-git-worktree
plugins.author: wloops
plugins.description: Domi-grade git worktree isolation and delivery: permanent worktrees under .dsh-worktrees, ready-for-review / apply / finish / discard lifecycle with conflict handling and safe cleanup (ported from Domi's production system).
plugins.description_zh: Domi 级 git worktree 隔离与交付：.dsh-worktrees 永久 worktree，ready-for-review / apply / finish / discard 完整生命周期，冲突处理与安全清理（移植自 Domi 生产系统）。

plugins.name: dsh-guardian
plugins.author: lonelymoon87
plugins.description: Adds dangerous-operation policy checks, output redaction, and a security-review workflow.
plugins.description_zh: 增加危险操作策略检查、输出脱敏和安全审查工作流。

plugins.name: dsh-handoff
plugins.author: FleetingEcho
plugins.description: Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.
plugins.description_zh: 每个工作目录与 git 分支自动维护 handoff.md：记录回合、折叠为简洁 Markdown 并注入后续会话，存储于 ~/.agent/agent-handoff，与 pi-handoff 字节级兼容。

plugins.name: dsh-homepage-skin
plugins.author: yushi-xxh
plugins.description: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
plugins.description_zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

plugins.name: dsh-hot-plugin-host
plugins.author: tianyaZTY
plugins.description: Runtime plugin loading for the Web UI: a watched hot directory installs/updates client-plugin bundles live on every open page, no restart. Includes a right-column subagent dashboard example.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 运行时插件加载：监视热目录，运行中安装/更新客户端插件 bundle，所有页面即时生效，免重启。附子智能体看板示例。

plugins.name: dsh-housekeeper
plugins.author: guo6x
plugins.description: Environment housekeeper for the agent: toolchain inventory (node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/browsers), scratch/cache scan with whitelist-guarded one-click cleanup, and the machine rules file (AGENTS.md) editor - all in the Web GUI settings.
plugins.description_zh: agent 的环境管家：工具链台账（node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/浏览器）、缓存与临时目录扫描 + 白名单安全一键清理、机器规则（AGENTS.md）编辑，全在 Web GUI 设置面板。

plugins.name: dsh-im-connect
plugins.author: MichengAI
plugins.description: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
plugins.description_zh: 把微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

plugins.name: dsh-image-vision
plugins.author: xsoc1
plugins.description: Chat image-attachment bridge with a `view_image` tool for any OpenAI-compatible VLM (local Ollama or cloud): pasted/dropped images become `view_image` path markers before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
plugins.description_zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的聊天识图插件：view_image 工具转发任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM（本地 Ollama 或云端），对话框粘贴/拖拽的图片自动改写为 view_image 路径标记供模型查看。

plugins.name: dsh-issue-tracker
plugins.author: xxiaoxiong
plugins.description: Jira Cloud issue-tracker integration exposing eight model tools for issue search, project and transition lookup, creation, updates, comments, and transitions; writes are opt-in and support dry-run.
plugins.description_zh: Jira Cloud 工单集成，提供 8 个模型工具用于工单查询、项目与流转查询、创建、更新、评论和状态流转；写操作默认关闭并支持 dry-run。

plugins.name: dsh-ivory
plugins.author: ZJUZhiyuCai
plugins.description: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

plugins.name: dsh-keyboard-history
plugins.author: NormanFxxkingRockwell
plugins.description: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge
plugins.author: lemoncat7
plugins.description: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.
plugins.description_zh: 提供本地与远程知识库，支持项目和会话范围检索、可控回写以及内嵌 Web 管理台。

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge
plugins.author: ICCuse
plugins.description: Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.
plugins.description_zh: 全局 Markdown 知识库桥：kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline 读写与 Codex kb.cmd CLI 共享的知识库（格式逐字节兼容）。

plugins.name: dsh-koboldcpp-hands
plugins.author: MicroHEROX
plugins.description: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
plugins.description_zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

plugins.name: dsh-kubernetes
plugins.author: xxiaoxiong
plugins.description: Safe Kubernetes capability for DeepSeek Harness with workload inspection, bounded logs and events, failure diagnosis, and approval-gated operations.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的安全 Kubernetes 能力，支持工作负载检查、有限日志与事件获取、故障诊断以及带审批控制的集群操作。

plugins.name: dsh-lark-bridge
plugins.author: shrekcg
plugins.description: Bidirectional Feishu/Lark channel for DeepSeek Harness: persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向通道：持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

plugins.name: dsh-layered-memory
plugins.author: JunNanLYS
plugins.description: Layered memory pipeline for DSH: auto-distills conversations into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile (L0–L3), with hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, chat/work family separation, and context injection before each model step.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 分层记忆管线：自动把会话蒸馏为原子事实、场景摘要与用户画像（L0~L3），BM25 + 向量混合检索，chat/work 双族隔离，每步模型调用前注入相关上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-line-select
plugins.author: fengMax1997
plugins.description: Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a `@path:start-end` reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.
plugins.description_zh: 行选区：浏览工作区文件、带行号预览代码、可视化选中行范围，一键把 `@path:start-end` 引用写入输入框，agent 发送时自动收到所选行原文，精准修改指定行。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-balance
plugins.author: JonyChan8394
plugins.description: Multi-provider LLM API balances under the chat input, with presets for DeepSeek, OpenRouter and SiliconFlow.
plugins.description_zh: 聊天输入框下方显示多个 LLM API 账户余额，内置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow 预设。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-ollama
plugins.author: NOirBRight
plugins.description: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.
plugins.description_zh: Ollama Cloud 原生聊天适配器：直连 NDJSON 翻译 Ollama /api/chat 协议，模型发现带上下文窗口与能力信息，并注册 web 搜索/抓取 provider，附 Web 设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-local-ai
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Local Ollama model integration: discover/pull/remove/inspect, route by task type or keyword with automatic cloud fallback, and a /ollama overview.
plugins.description_zh: Ollama 本地模型集成：发现/拉取/移除/查看，按任务类型或关键词路由并自动回退云端，/ollama 总览。

plugins.name: dsh-longtask-orchestrator
plugins.author: rocker2018-droid
plugins.description: Long-task orchestration loop: Codex plans/scores/reviews, DeepSeek executes, Kimi supplements (vision acceptance, summarization, cross-check).
plugins.description_zh: 长任务编排闭环：Codex 规划/打分/审核，DeepSeek 执行，Kimi 补充（视觉验收/摘要/交叉验证）。

plugins.name: dsh-mascot
plugins.author: falser101
plugins.description: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

plugins.name: dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck#package
plugins.author: FeatherHunter
plugins.description: Right-side details panel that turns the Matt Pocock skills collection into a DSH quest board: wayfinder decision maps, per-issue triage / fix / discuss / execute actions, 9-item core-skill probe plus 20-skill radar, environment checks, and one-click handoff across sessions.
plugins.description_zh: Matt Pocock 技能套件的 DSH 控制面板：右侧 details 列打开；含 wayfinder 决策地图、issue 行级 triage / 修复 / 讨论 / 执行按钮、9 项核心套件探测 + 20 个技能雷达、环境检查、跨会话 handoff 交接。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-bridge
plugins.author: Chhlafiu4312
plugins.description: Zero-dependency MCP client bridge that connects stdio and HTTP MCP servers and registers their tools as mcp_<server>_<tool> for the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 零依赖 MCP 客户端桥接，连接 stdio 与 HTTP MCP server，把其工具注册为 mcp_<server>_<tool> 供 agent 调用。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-market
plugins.author: LKMeng2001
plugins.description: MCP server marketplace for DSH: browse a curated, npm-verified catalog and install MCP servers into the current profile with one click, live without restart.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器商场：浏览经过 npm 校验的精选目录，一键安装 MCP 服务器到当前 profile，免重启立即生效。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-skill-panel
plugins.author: lilyblessing
plugins.description: MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) calls disabled servers on demand, with state-based visibility filtering that keeps user-enabled servers visible.
plugins.description_zh: MCP 与技能管理面板：设置页面板实时启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill 释放上下文占用；可选 AI 中间层（mcp_search/mcp_call）按需调用停用服务器，按 server 状态过滤模型可见性（用户打开的保持可见）。

plugins.name: dsh-md-preview
plugins.author: poiuyjie
plugins.description: Dockable Markdown preview for the DSH Web UI: side-by-side with the conversation, a per-session recently-read .md list, local relative-path images render in place, and clicking an in-chat .md reference previews it instead of launching the system editor; follows the shell light/dark theme.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 端可停靠的 Markdown 预览面板：与对话并排展示，会话级「最近打开 .md」列表，本地相对路径图片可直接渲染；点击对话中的 .md 引用改为并排预览而非唤起系统编辑器；跟随 shell 深浅色主题。

plugins.name: dsh-mem0
plugins.author: orangeshinee
plugins.description: Agent tools for a self-hosted mem0 server: add, search, get, update, delete, history, reset and status memories, with a settings-panel configuration card.
plugins.description_zh: 自托管 mem0 记忆读写插件：agent 直接读写自有 mem0 服务（增删查改、搜索、历史、重置、状态），并带设置面板配置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-memoria
plugins.author: jiayan-xu
plugins.description: Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.
plugins.description_zh: 向量+图记忆后端：observe/remember/search/recall 四个工具对接本地 memoria 服务，HNSW 语义召回 + FTS5 关键词 + 知识图谱信号经 RRF 融合排序，回合结束自动写入，按 Agent 命名空间隔离。

plugins.name: dsh-memory
plugins.author: flymysql
plugins.description: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

plugins.name: dsh-memory
plugins.author: Max-Null
plugins.description: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

plugins.name: dsh-memory
plugins.author: yangyongzhen
plugins.description: Long-term memory injected at session start: preferences/facts/summaries/knowledge in global and per-project scopes, budgeted recall via `agent/pre-step`, durable JSON store.
plugins.description_zh: 会话开始自动注入的长期记忆：preference/fact/summary/knowledge 四类、global/project 双作用域，`agent/pre-step` 字节预算召回，JSON 原子持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-porter
plugins.author: Shiye-10Pages
plugins.description: Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.
plugins.description_zh: 把你在 Claude / ChatGPT 里已有的历史搬进 DSH：Claude 导出包里的 memories.json 零 token 瞬时入库，本机 Claude Code 记录免导出直读，历史对话用你在 DSH 里已配好的模型提纯。每条记忆都带由代码回原文核对的逐字证据——转述会被丢弃并计数，只在 AI 回复里找到的证据一律转人工确认而非直接入库。

plugins.name: dsh-mermaid-render
plugins.author: genius-alray
plugins.description: Mermaid diagram renderer for the Web UI conversation: renders mermaid code blocks into interactive cards (zoom, fit-width, fullscreen viewer, preview/code toggle) with official UI primitives, and keeps the original code block with an inline error banner when rendering fails.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 对话 mermaid 渲染插件：将消息中的 mermaid 代码块渲染为可交互图表卡片（缩放 / 适应宽度 / 全屏查看 / 预览代码切换），复用官方组件原语，渲染失败时保留原代码块并内联展示错误。

plugins.name: dsh-messages-sanitizer
plugins.author: Leeminjing
plugins.description: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
plugins.description_zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

plugins.name: dsh-mindseye
plugins.author: kanchengw
plugins.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models on DSH, with native interaction for image understanding and generation, layered evidence memory and cache, and intent-driven VLM router.
plugins.description_zh: 为纯文本模型提供 DSH 视觉插件：原生图片理解与生成交互、分层证据记忆与缓存、意图驱动的 VLM 路由。

plugins.name: dsh-minimal-first-turn
plugins.author: ZRui-C
plugins.description: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
plugins.description_zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

plugins.name: dsh-minimal-ptc
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Minimal prompt x full PTC tools: one-line persona, Code Mode SDK, subagents, workflows, web search, and Windows Git Bash.
plugins.description_zh: 极简提示词 × PTC 全量工具：一句人格、Code Mode SDK、子代理、工作流、联网搜索与 Windows Git Bash。

plugins.name: dsh-minimax-usage#trusted-plugin
plugins.author: Floating-Dreaming
plugins.description: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

plugins.name: dsh-model-picker
plugins.author: Sanqi-normal
plugins.description: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-model-sync
plugins.author: jiay98528-dev
plugins.description: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
plugins.description_zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

plugins.name: dsh-mojibake-interceptor
plugins.author: fire-disposal
plugins.description: Mojibake guard bundle for DSH: feature-based garbled-text detection before writes with review-then-release (an identical retry passes), plus pre-execution pwsh encoding audit (ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/Default), Windows and Chinese first.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 乱码拦截器 bundle：写入前特征值/编码回环检测乱码并复查放行（原样重试即通过），pwsh 写入编码执行前审计（ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/默认编码），Windows 与中文场景优先。

plugins.name: dsh-news-plugin
plugins.author: canghai666x
plugins.description: RSS news fetch tool that grabs 10+ CN/EN feeds into structured items.
plugins.description_zh: RSS 新闻采集工具，抓取 10+ 中英文源为结构化条目。

plugins.name: dsh-notifier
plugins.author: YZz-S
plugins.description: System-native notifications when a task finishes or needs your confirmation: Windows toast, macOS osascript, and Linux notify-send.
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成或需要确认/输入时发送操作系统原生通知：Windows toast、macOS osascript、Linux notify-send。

plugins.name: dsh-notify
plugins.author: aokamoaki
plugins.description: Conversation-completion notifications for DeepSeek Harness: Windows toast + sound on turn done / error / goal, plus ask & approval alerts - background-only, with a volume-adjustable bell in the conversation header.
plugins.description_zh: 对话完成通知：回合完成/出错/目标完成/提问/审批时弹出 Windows toast 与提示音，仅后台提醒，会话头部铃铛即控制中心。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-bark
plugins.author: pc439527
plugins.description: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
plugins.description_zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-win
plugins.author: Andyqwe44
plugins.description: Native Windows toast + taskbar flash for task done / approval / ask_user_question, Win10/11, npm install `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-win`.
plugins.description_zh: 原生 Windows toast + 任务栏闪烁，任务完成/审批/提问时触发，支持 Win10/11，npm 安装 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-win`。

plugins.name: dsh-notion
plugins.author: mingzeng21
plugins.description: Connect dsh to Notion via the official Notion MCP (OAuth + PKCE): search, read, and write pages, databases, and comments through `mcp__notion__*` tools.
plugins.description_zh: 通过官方 Notion MCP（OAuth + PKCE）把 dsh 连接到 Notion：通过 `mcp__notion__*` 工具搜索、读写页面、数据库与评论。

plugins.name: dsh-office
plugins.author: Fayelin12
plugins.description: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents.
plugins.description_zh: 办公室工作区/会话仪表盘：悬浮 6 列精灵面板，可视化工作区、会话、token 用量与子代理。

plugins.name: dsh-omv
plugins.author: bx33661
plugins.description: Evidence-first vulnerability research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: native audit views, 29 OMV tools, Evidence.v1 findings, reproducible runs, Campaign workflows, and isolated PoC evidence.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先漏洞研究工作台：原生审计视图、29 个 OMV 工具、Evidence.v1 Finding、可复现 Run、Campaign 工作流和隔离 PoC 证据。

plugins.name: dsh-origin-plugin
plugins.author: Fantasality
plugins.description: Drive Origin scientific plotting from DeepSeek Harness AI chat via MCP: write data, plot line/scatter/column, export PNG/SVG.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话里驱动 Origin 科学绘图：写数据、折线/散点/柱状图，导出 PNG/SVG。

plugins.name: dsh-packer
plugins.author: KLRSL
plugins.description: Agent config packer for DeepSeek Harness: pack local agent assets (skills/sessions/profiles/settings/memory) into a zip for migration or sharing, with privacy scanning, diff-based restore, pack management, and a settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Agent 配置打包器：把本地 Agent 资产（Skills/会话/Profile/全局设置/记忆）打包成 zip，用于迁移或分享；带隐私安全扫描、恢复差异对比、包管理与设置面板。

plugins.name: dsh-pain-point-check
plugins.author: ICCuse
plugins.description: Enforced pain-point gate: after two non-converged experiments it injects the three questions, denies non-investigative tool calls until answered, and blocks same-direction retries.
plugins.description_zh: 强制痛点检查：同一问题连续 2 个实验未收敛后注入三问、拦截非调查类工具调用直到答出、阻止同方向重试。

plugins.name: dsh-patchouli
plugins.author: memorax-ai
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

plugins.name: dsh-path-reveal
plugins.author: futongxu9-maker
plugins.description: Click any absolute Windows path in DSH messages to reveal it in Explorer (select the file or open the folder).
plugins.description_zh: 点击消息里的 Windows 绝对路径在资源管理器中打开所在文件夹（文件定位选中/目录直接打开）。

plugins.name: dsh-pathlink
plugins.author: penguin-oo
plugins.description: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
plugins.description_zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

plugins.name: dsh-pdf
plugins.author: zhtx2024
plugins.description: PDF parsing tools for DSH: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, and pdf_render_page with dual pdfjs and built-in rendering engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embedded CJK fonts.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 PDF 解析工具：pdf_info、pdf_extract_text、pdf_render_page 三件套，pdfjs 与自研渲染器双引擎，未内嵌 CJK 字体的 PDF 也能用系统字体渲染出图。

plugins.name: dsh-personal-workbench
plugins.author: Dely0
plugins.description: Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus reminders and per-task AI session workspaces.
plugins.description_zh: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-pet
plugins.author: ysyyhhh
plugins.description: Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.
plugins.description_zh: 跟随 agent 状态的 DSH 原生桌宠，兼容 Codex 桌宠包，并可在插件内直接从 Petdex 导入已审核桌宠，无需 Petdex CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-advisor
plugins.author: ChengxiuCDP
plugins.description: Quality-aware in-agent plugin discovery: a find_dsh_plugins tool that ranks the whole dsh-plugin topic through a daily quality-scored index (installable manifest, curated listing, license, activity) merged with a live gh search — zero LLM API cost, risk flags and exact install commands in every result.
plugins.description_zh: 质量感知的会话内插件发现：find_dsh_plugins 工具基于每日更新的质量评分索引（可安装声明 / 精选收录 / 许可证 / 活跃度）对 dsh-plugin topic 全量排序，并叠加实时 gh 搜索——零 LLM API 成本，每条结果附风险徽章与精确安装命令。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-approval-alert
plugins.author: doncelee229-cmyk
plugins.description: Native OS notifications for approval and question/plan prompts: the toast names the workspace, click jumps to it, bilingual (zh-CN/zh-TW/en), with chime.
plugins.description_zh: 审批与选择方案的系统级桌面通知：通知显示所属工作区、点击跳转到对应工作区，多语言（简中/繁中/英文），附提示音。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-Audit
plugins.author: tttwh
plugins.description: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update.
plugins.description_zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-audit
plugins.description: Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.
plugins.description_zh: 插件生态体检：将 dsh-plugin 话题同步为本地评分目录（维护/文档/npm+周下载/生态四维，0-100 分 A-D 级），静态安全扫描高危一票否决，支持 star 历史快照、Web 榜单与 Agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-center
plugins.author: Max-Null
plugins.description: Plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: installed-plugin metadata, a community market with stars and versions, one-click install and update, and a What's New dialog.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：已安装插件信息、带星标与版本号的社区市场、一键安装与更新，以及启动时的更新日志弹窗。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-clinic
plugins.author: ayahunter
plugins.description: Read-only health clinic for the installed DSH plugin set: loader health, dependency integrity, version compatibility, install-script risk, duplicates and patch integrity, delivered as a model tool, a Settings dashboard and JSON reports.
plugins.description_zh: 已安装 DSH 插件集合的只读体检诊所：加载健康、依赖完整、版本兼容、安装脚本风险、重复与 patch 引用，交付模型工具、设置面板与 JSON 报告。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-finance-data
plugins.description: Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供金融数据工具包：数字与货币格式化（含中文万/亿单位）、收益与年化计算、估值与盈利比率、现值/终值、风险指标与数据质量清单。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-grok2api-media-tool
plugins.author: lsjspl
plugins.description: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
plugins.description_zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-gzip
plugins.author: wingsky-1
plugins.description: Gzip compression for /api responses, fixing history-load timeouts over remote/low-bandwidth connections; skips SSE and already-encoded responses.
plugins.description_zh: /api 响应 gzip 压缩，解决远程/低带宽访问时历史加载超时；SSE 与已编码响应自动豁免。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-idle-archive
plugins.author: wingsky-1
plugins.description: Idle session reminder: prompts to archive sessions untouched for N hours, with a snooze window after each refusal, using the official archiveSession API.
plugins.description_zh: 会话闲置提醒：超过 N 小时未对话的会话弹窗询问是否归档，拒绝后进入静默期；归档走官方 archiveSession 接口。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-lan-proxy
plugins.author: wingsky-1
plugins.description: LAN access to the dsh web UI: forwards HTTP/HTTPS and WebSocket/wss from 0.0.0.0 to the loopback web server, with DNS-rebinding protection and a loopback-only upstream whitelist.
plugins.description_zh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：在 0.0.0.0 监听并把 HTTP/HTTPS 与 WebSocket/wss 转发到回环 web 服务器，带 DNS 重绑定防护与回环-only 上游白名单。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-mcp-manager
plugins.author: wingsky-1
plugins.description: MCP server manager: side-panel with per-status server listing, stdio/streamable-http setup forms, mcpServers JSON import, exponential-backoff reconnect, and tools registered to the model as mcp__<server>__<tool>.
plugins.description_zh: MCP 服务器管理器：侧边栏面板按状态分级展示服务器，支持 stdio/streamable-http 表单接入与 mcpServers JSON 导入，断线指数退避重连，工具以 mcp__<server>__<tool> 注册给模型。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-notifier
plugins.author: wingsky-1
plugins.description: Approval/completion/error event notifications: browser Notification plus native toasts (PowerShell WinRT on Windows, notify-send on Linux/macOS), quiet hours, same-kind error merging, and an independent switch for subagent completion.
plugins.description_zh: 审批/完成/错误事件通知：浏览器 Notification + 系统原生 toast（Windows PowerShell WinRT、Linux/macOS notify-send），支持免打扰时段、同类错误合并、子代理完成独立开关。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-opencode-usage
plugins.author: wingsky-1
plugins.description: OpenCode Go plan usage floating pill: three-window consumption percentages (rolling/weekly/monthly) with mini area charts, backed by background sampling against the official /v1/usage API.
plugins.description_zh: OpenCode Go 套餐用量悬浮框：三窗口（rolling/weekly/monthly）消耗百分比常驻展示，展开为迷你面积图；后台采样官方 /v1/usage 接口，零本地计算。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-skill-explorer
plugins.author: wingsky-1
plugins.description: Skill center in the DSH web GUI: browse loaded skills grouped by source (system / project / user / custom / runtime), with create, enable/disable, and delete (moves to .trash) actions.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 技能中心：按来源分级（系统内置/项目/用户/自定义/运行时）浏览已加载技能，支持创建、启用/禁用与删除（移入 .trash 可恢复）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-web-file-preview
plugins.author: wingsky-1
plugins.description: Preview conversation file links in the web UI (images / text / Markdown / highlighted code / git diff) — click a link to open a preview modal instead of the desktop opener; loopback-fenced routes with weak ETag/304 caching and DOMPurify sanitization.
plugins.description_zh: 在 web 端预览对话中的文件链接（图片 / 文本 / Markdown / 代码高亮 / git diff）：点击链接即可弹窗预览，替代桌面原生打开；loopback 围栏 + 弱 ETag/304 缓存 + DOMPurify 消毒。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-kit#rss
plugins.author: hyzyn
plugins.description: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），每天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-kit#search
plugins.author: hyzyn
plugins.description: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: The `dsh pm` plugin manager: multi-source search (awesome list + GitHub + npm), install/remove/update per profile, and a doctor audit of manifests, bundle patches, and version drift.
plugins.description_zh: `dsh pm` 插件管理器：多源搜索（awesome 列表 + GitHub + npm）、按 profile 安装/移除/更新，以及 doctor 审计（清单、bundle patch、版本漂移）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-manager#cli
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: The `dsh pm` plugin manager: multi-source search (awesome list + GitHub + npm), install/remove/update per profile, and a doctor audit of manifests, bundle patches, and version drift.
plugins.description_zh: `dsh pm` 插件管理器：多源搜索（awesome 列表 + GitHub + npm）、按 profile 安装/移除/更新，以及 doctor 审计（清单、bundle patch、版本漂移）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-manager-registry
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Offline-tolerant registry that discovers and deduplicates DSH plugins from lists, topics and npm.
plugins.description_zh: 离线容错的插件注册表，聚合并去重各类来源的 DSH 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-market
plugins.author: kimiya1010
plugins.description: A plugin market for DeepSeek Harness: search and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugin plugins straight from the web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场：在 Web 界面里搜索并一键安装 GitHub 上的 dsh-plugin 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-mm-vision
plugins.author: Elohia
plugins.description: Synesthesia Encoder for DSH: a vision model translates images into compact structured spatial text (canvas/elements/percentage coordinates), giving text-only LLMs pixel-level image understanding via the `mm_vision` tool.
plugins.description_zh: 通感编码器（Synesthesia Encoder）：调用视觉模型把图片翻译成紧凑的结构化空间文字（画布/元素/百分比坐标），让纯文本 LLM 获得像素级看图能力（`mm_vision` 工具）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-nintendo
plugins.author: beancookie
plugins.description: NES emulator built on jsnes: play in a popup window with a hotkey toggle, agents can load ROMs via the `nes_play` tool, with save/load and screenshots.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 jsnes 的 NES 模拟器：独立弹窗游玩、快捷键开关，Agent 可调用 `nes_play` 工具加载 ROM，支持存档/读档/截图。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-qcc
plugins.author: Samge0
plugins.description: Qichacha (企查查) enterprise data source as a dynamic Cordis plugin: 5 agent tools (auth with QR login, company search, knowledge search, tool search, tool execute) covering 100+ data dimensions (business registration, shareholders, judicial, IP), plus a settings-page account manager; network/file IO via DSH subprocess spawning node -e, credentials interop with the local BizOwl client.
plugins.description_zh: 企查查企业数据源动态 Cordis 插件：5 个 agent 工具（扫码登录认证、企业快搜、知识库检索、工具发现、取数执行），覆盖工商/股东/司法/知识产权等 100+ 数据维度，附设置页账号管理；网络与文件 IO 经 DSH subprocess 拉起 node -e 完成，凭证与本地 BizOwl 客户端互通。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-surgery
plugins.author: ruimin251204
plugins.description: Plugin surgery: safe uninstall (dry-run impact preview, snapshot, three-way verification, auto-rollback on failure), one-click rollback, restart-pending confirmation, and a plugin doctor.
plugins.description_zh: 插件手术刀：安全卸载（dry-run 预览影响面、快照、三方对账、失败自动回滚）、一键回滚、restart-pending 确认与插件体检。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-toggle
plugins.author: tuogusa
plugins.description: Toggle, delete, undo-delete, and check/update plugins from the Web settings panel; runtime enable/disable is persisted to the profile.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web 设置面板中启用、停用、删除/撤回插件，并支持版本检测与 npm 插件更新；运行时开关持久化到 profile。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-lan-gateway
plugins.author: TZHR-invest
plugins.description: Complete LAN/remote access for the Web UI: 0.0.0.0 binding, crypto.randomUUID polyfill, token gate (401 login page + WebSocket interception, loopback exempt), privileged-fence and settings-persistence exemptions, and an idempotent installer with upgrade recovery.
plugins.description_zh: 完整的 Web GUI 局域网/远程访问方案：0.0.0.0 绑定、crypto.randomUUID polyfill、令牌门卫（401 登录页 + WebSocket 拦截，回环豁免）、特权围栏与设置持久化放行，附带幂等安装器与升级恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-mobile-ui
plugins.author: TZHR-invest
plugins.description: Mobile UI for the Web GUI on narrow screens: full-width responsive layout, overlay session drawer, 44px touch targets, safe-area support, and reading enhancements with zero desktop impact.
plugins.description_zh: Web GUI 移动端适配：窄屏全宽响应式布局、会话抽屉、44px 触摸目标、安全区适配与阅读增强，桌面端零影响。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-vision-tool
plugins.author: TZHR-invest
plugins.description: Agent-callable vision tool that describes local images via any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint you configure, with an optional multi-model cross-check and no built-in keys.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 可调用的视觉工具：通过你配置的任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点描述本地图片，支持多模型交叉核对，不内置任何密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search-metaso
plugins.author: TZHR-invest
plugins.description: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).
plugins.description_zh: 秘塔AI搜索 providers for ctx.web：web_search 返回网页摘要，web_fetch 读取网页全文 markdown，多范围搜索（网页/文库/论文/图片/视频/播客）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#plugins/dsh-balance-plugin
plugins.author: luokai-demo
plugins.description: DeepSeek wallet balance at the sidebar foot: a credit-card icon with the amount tinted by remaining balance (green over ¥2, amber ¥0–2, red below), refreshed on mount, per turn-end, and on click; a signed delta floats up and fades on each balance change.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

plugins.name: dsh-poison-guard
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

plugins.name: dsh-power-button
plugins.author: huasheng33991
plugins.description: One-click start/stop button pinned to the window bottom-right corner: restarts DeepSeek Harness in place via a detached helper that relaunches the exact boot invocation (loopback same-origin guarded), with an optional stop-only action.
plugins.description_zh: 固定在窗口右下角的一键启停按钮：通过脱离终端的辅助进程按原始启动命令重启 DeepSeek Harness（仅本机同源可调），附「仅停止」小按钮。

plugins.name: dsh-powerdesk
plugins.author: FleetingEcho
plugins.description: A dockable IDE workbench for the DSH web UI: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer over a Rust PTY), a CodeMirror editor, a file explorer, notes, a sandboxed browser, and ripgrep content search.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 界面的可停靠 IDE 工作台：GPU 加速终端（restty 渲染器 + Rust PTY）、CodeMirror 编辑器、文件浏览器、笔记、沙箱浏览器，以及基于 ripgrep 的内容搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-ppt
plugins.author: STARDUSTLC666
plugins.description: Presentation skill and tools: one sentence or one document to an HTML slideshow plus editable PPTX, with five built-in themes, default theme/language config and bilingual support.
plugins.description_zh: 演示文稿技能与工具：一句话或一篇文档生成 HTML 放映与可编辑 PPTX，内置 5 套主题，可配置默认主题/语言，中英双语。

plugins.name: dsh-progress-viz#plugin
plugins.description: Real-time stage, ETA & cost dashboard for headless dsh tasks: turns the black-box session event stream into a live multi-task grid (cordis plugin + standalone local dashboard, no API calls).
plugins.description_zh: headless dsh 任务的实时阶段、ETA 与成本看板：把黑盒会话事件流变成实时多任务网格（cordis 插件 + 本地独立看板，零 API 调用）。

plugins.name: dsh-prometheus
plugins.author: xxiaoxiong
plugins.description: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.
plugins.description_zh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
plugins.author: LCQ-1024
plugins.description: Adds a prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites drafts into agent-ready prompts.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 输入框添加提示词增强按钮，将草稿改写为可直接交给 Agent 执行的提示词。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-manager
plugins.author: SaiSenBox
plugins.description: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
plugins.description_zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-profile
plugins.author: BrambleXu
plugins.description: Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn model selection, argument substitution, and state restoration.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 可复用 Markdown Prompt Profile，支持单轮模型选择、参数替换和状态恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-self
plugins.author: Hua1Q1nG
plugins.description: Rewrites each request against a learned prompt profile and automatically updates habits, anti-hallucination rules, and learning records.
plugins.description_zh: 按学习到的 Prompt 画像改写每个请求，并自动更新习惯清单、防幻觉规则与学习记录。

plugins.name: dsh-proof
plugins.author: EvilIrving
plugins.description: Independent read-only acceptance layer: spawns a read-only verifier before each top-level turn closes and steers non-pass gaps back into the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 独立只读验收层：顶层 turn 收尾前 spawn 只读 verifier，未通过时把缺口注回主 agent。

plugins.name: dsh-provenance
plugins.author: Darren-Tang
plugins.description: Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做安装前供应链校验：在代码运行前核对即将安装的包是否与你读到的源码一致。

plugins.name: dsh-python-env
plugins.author: AngelosZou
plugins.description: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.
plugins.description_zh: 封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。

plugins.name: dsh-query-jump
plugins.author: SocFeng
plugins.description: DSH WebUI session query navigation with a faint conversation-edge rail, a hover list of real user queries, and click-to-jump back to the matching bubble.
plugins.description_zh: DSH WebUI 会话提问导航：对话区右缘淡色短横线，悬停列出真实用户提问，点击跳回对应气泡。

plugins.name: dsh-rate-limiter
plugins.author: Xidong-AI
plugins.description: Proactive per-provider token-bucket rate limiting that queues over-limit requests before they are sent, preventing upstream 429 errors.
plugins.description_zh: 按 provider 令牌桶主动限速，超限请求在发出前延迟排队而非失败，避免触发上游 429。

plugins.name: dsh-recall
plugins.author: Relistencode
plugins.description: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.
plugins.description_zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

plugins.name: dsh-recall-unread
plugins.author: hg1048596-pixel
plugins.description: Adds a strip above the composer to recall sent-but-unread (steering) text messages before the model reads them.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框上方提供「未读消息」条带，可在模型读取前撤回已发送但尚未被读取的文字消息。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-ssh-ops
plugins.author: weisiren000
plugins.description: SSH remote ops for DSH: pair servers over SSH or a one-time-code remote-hostd, then run commands, manage background jobs, and read or write remote files with reviewable changes (host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes).
plugins.description_zh: DSH SSH 远程运维：通过 SSH 或一次性配对码的 remote-hostd 连接服务器，执行命令、管理后台任务、读写远程文件并审阅变更（host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes）。

plugins.name: dsh-repo-setup
plugins.author: gongyijie85
plugins.description: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db hints and recommends skill plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files (claude-code-setup counterpart).
plugins.description_zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出技能插件、MCP 服务器与卫生文件的安装建议（claude-code-setup 的 DSH 对应）。

plugins.name: dsh-report-studio
plugins.author: ciceroyang
plugins.description: Turn a DSH session into daily/weekly/handoff/article reports with verifiable receipts.
plugins.description_zh: 把 DSH 会话一键变成日报/周报/交接文档/文章，附可验证凭据。

plugins.name: dsh-repro
plugins.author: EvilIrving
plugins.description: /repro exports a minimal, secret-scrubbed, replayable problem bundle: the session log, failed commands, and Git diff.
plugins.description_zh: /repro 导出最小可复现问题包：去 secret 的会话日志、失败命令与 git diff。

plugins.name: dsh-research
plugins.author: dsh-research
plugins.description: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and workbenches — one-click install, update and remove pinned to the reviewed version, restart from the panel, and exactly one network request (its own catalog).
plugins.description_zh: 精选科研插件市场：在设置里加一页「科研插件」，收录逐个读过代码的文献检索、文献管理、写作与科研工作台插件——一键安装、更新、卸载并钉住审读过的版本，面板内重启，只发一个网络请求（拉取自家目录）。

plugins.name: dsh-restart-button
plugins.author: keyiadiannao
plugins.description: A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
plugins.description_zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

plugins.name: dsh-restart-fab
plugins.author: miisaka19800
plugins.description: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

plugins.name: dsh-result-only-view
plugins.author: YEYEYEYESHIFU
plugins.description: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized.
plugins.description_zh: Web 对话「只看结果」开关：隐藏思考与工具调用过程，运行中仅保留一条实时状态行，reduced-motion 环境下恢复活动光影，中英双语。

plugins.name: dsh-routines
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Scheduled agents on a cron: run a prompt on a schedule and get the digest where you already are, with overlap/missed-run/timeout safety defaults.
plugins.description_zh: 定时 Agent：按 cron 计划运行 prompt，把摘要送到你已有的地方，内置重叠/漏跑/超时安全策略。

plugins.name: dsh-rule-engine
plugins.author: jilian-dsh
plugins.description: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
plugins.description_zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

plugins.name: dsh-rules
plugins.author: rj-jiangyichen
plugins.description: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
plugins.description_zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

plugins.name: dsh-sampling-sliders
plugins.author: Semidia
plugins.description: Model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) in the composer: override every model request for all providers via the agent/request hook, with hot/persist modes.
plugins.description_zh: 对话输入区的模型采样滑杆（temperature / maxTokens）：通过 agent/request 钩子对所有供应商的每次请求生效，支持热调/持久化两种模式。

plugins.name: dsh-scheduler
plugins.author: yangyongzhen
plugins.description: Cron/one-shot scheduled tasks: run shell commands or fire webhooks on a schedule, with optional ServerChan/DingTalk/Feishu/webhook delivery of results.
plugins.description_zh: cron / 一次性定时任务：按调度执行 shell 命令或投递 webhook，结果可推送到 ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

plugins.name: dsh-screenshot
plugins.author: paicat1
plugins.description: Standalone screen capture for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Browser hotkeys for instant capture plus an agent-facing capture and read tool that lets the agent see and analyze any screen region.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的独立截图工具。浏览器快捷键一键截图，并提供面向智能体的截图加读取能力，让智能体能看到并分析任意屏幕区域。

plugins.name: dsh-security-guard
plugins.author: bigclawd
plugins.description: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

plugins.name: dsh-session-manager
plugins.author: hkkz9522
plugins.description: Delete conversations with a confirmation dialog and manage archived sessions (archive/unarchive) in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中删除对话（二次确认），并管理归档会话（移入/移出归档）。

plugins.name: dsh-session-recovery
plugins.author: Coprexist
plugins.description: Recover deleted or corrupted dsh sessions (session.jsonl.zstd) and memory (memory.db) from the raw disk, and repair rebuilt sessions that fail to resume via the /session-repair command in the web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 从原始磁盘恢复被删除或损坏的 dsh 会话（session.jsonl.zstd）与记忆库（memory.db），并通过 web 界面中的 /session-repair 命令修复重建后无法续接的会话。

plugins.name: dsh-session-search-pro
plugins.author: LeslieWylie
plugins.description: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

plugins.name: dsh-session-sync
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Cross-device session sync: a dedicated git mirror with append-only three-way merging (keep-both + fork conflict resolution), a /sync command, and automatic push/pull.
plugins.description_zh: 会话跨设备同步：专用 git 镜像 + append-only 三方合并（keep-both + fork 冲突解决），/sync 命令与自动推拉。

plugins.name: DSH-Session-Sync
plugins.author: hajimimaodie8
