plugins.description: Bidirectionally synchronize sessions, workspaces, settings and plugins between the DSH web instance and the DSH Desktop instance.
plugins.description_zh: 双向同步网页版与 DSH Desktop 桌面版之间的会话、工作区、设置与插件。

plugins.name: dsh-session-tags
plugins.author: tuogusa
plugins.description: Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 为会话添加标签，并在 Web 设置面板中按标签搜索会话。

plugins.name: dsh-settings-nav-organizer
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups and a fold toggle in General settings.
plugins.description_zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组与「通用设置」折叠开关。

plugins.name: dsh-shorts-wall
plugins.author: imkingjh999
plugins.description: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

plugins.name: dsh-shutdown-after-task
plugins.author: virggle
plugins.description: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-side-monitor
plugins.author: pc439527
plugins.description: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏系统监控：实时查看宿主机概览（CPU/内存/网络/磁盘）、进程列表与 Docker 容器状态，全程只读。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-7d-git-commit
plugins.author: 7dgroup-ai
plugins.description: Checks git commit messages against the 7DGroup convention (Chinese type tags, length and punctuation rules) before committing, as a client-side guard before GitLab pre-receive hooks.
plugins.description_zh: 提交前按 7DGroup 规范校验 git commit message（中文类型标签、长度与标点规则），作为 GitLab pre-receive 钩子的客户端前置校验。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-curator
plugins.author: gwrsfsfeefdsfs
plugins.description: Meta-skill for DSH skill experience feedback and knowledge accumulation: feeds fixes back into skills and records a searchable knowledge base (keyword + local bge semantic retrieval, 7-point write-back checklist, anti-bloat archiving), with self-validation and event-hook tools.
plugins.description_zh: DSH skill 经验回流与知识积累元技能：其他 skill 出问题解决后自动回流解决方案并登记知识库（关键词 + 本地 bge 语义双通道检索、7 项写回判断清单、防臃肿归档），附自校验与事件钩子工具。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-manager
plugins.author: LIU20030725
plugins.description: Manage and organize your agent skills by category, tags and collections in DeepSeek Harness, with a settings panel and a slash-command folder picker.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按分类、标签和集合文件夹管理你的 agent 技能，自带设置面板与输入框文件夹技能挑选器。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-mcp-center
plugins.author: Max-Null
plugins.description: Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live per-session status in the sidebar.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

plugins.name: dsh-skin-manager
plugins.author: xiaoyangcheng84-svg
plugins.description: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

plugins.name: dsh-sleep-send
plugins.author: Awu12277
plugins.description: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-sound
plugins.author: AI-Galaxy-GPU
plugins.description: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).
plugins.description_zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

plugins.name: dsh-stage-gate
plugins.author: changingwang
plugins.description: Stage-gate governance tools: model-callable gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close for in-memory, per-session acceptance checks with PASS/BLOCK conclusions.
plugins.description_zh: 阶段门治理工具：模型可直接调用的 gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close，为多阶段工作提供内存态、按会话隔离的验收核对与通过/阻塞结论。

plugins.name: dsh-startup-guard
plugins.author: aokamoaki
plugins.description: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
plugins.description_zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

plugins.name: dsh-stats-panel
plugins.author: zhang-jiazhi
plugins.description: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. Per-channel usage with balances and plan quotas for mainstream providers, CNY cost estimates, and daily charts — a settings-sidebar section.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计。按渠道区分统计，官方渠道自动显示余额，套餐渠道显示 5 小时/7 天/30 天用量余量，人民币计费估算，含每日图表与模型分布，集成在设置页侧边菜单。

plugins.name: dsh-sticker-board
plugins.author: sanqiPanax
plugins.description: Fridge-magnet quick-task stickers docked above the composer: one-click sends a preloaded prompt into the current session, grouped long-term/short-term.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框上方的冰箱贴纸栏：把常用任务（科技新闻、GitHub 推荐等）做成贴纸，点击即向当前会话发送预置 prompt 并执行，按长期/短期分组。

plugins.name: dsh-stock-terminal
plugins.author: linhut
plugins.description: Stock market skin + real-time ticker plugin for DSH Web GUI: candlestick (K-line) popup with day/week/month periods, watchlist with pinyin fuzzy search, portfolio P&L tracker, trading session indicators, support for A-share/HK/US/crypto/forex.
plugins.description_zh: 股市行情皮肤与功能插件：全局交易终端皮肤 + 跑马灯 + 个股 K 线弹窗（日K/周K/月K 切换）、自选拼音首字母模糊搜索、持仓盈亏管理、交易时段指示，支持 A股 / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币 / 外汇。

plugins.name: dsh-stock-watch
plugins.author: Bob-Bo1
plugins.description: Local-first A-share portfolio and watchlist monitor for DSH: sidebar quotes, holdings P&L, browser add/edit/delete, and JSON persistence.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 本地优先的 A 股持仓与自选监控：侧栏行情、持仓盈亏，以及网页添加、修改、删除和 JSON 保存。

plugins.name: dsh-sub2api
plugins.author: GodD6366
plugins.description: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
plugins.description_zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-agy
plugins.author: ZEM17
plugins.description: Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DSH product subagent: delegate tasks to a Gemini coding agent with your Antigravity login (no API key), with conversation follow-ups, background streaming progress, image analysis by path, and a pop-up login window.
plugins.description_zh: 把 Google Antigravity CLI（agy）接入 DSH 作为产品子代理：用 Antigravity 登录态（无需 API key）委托 Gemini 编程智能体干活，支持对话续聊、后台流式进度、按路径识图与自动弹出登录窗口。

plugins.name: dsh-subscribe
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Steam-style plugin marketplace: 539-plugin registry, one-command sync, in-harness market tools.
plugins.description_zh: Steam 式插件市场：539+ 插件注册表、一条命令同步、对话内市场工具。

plugins.name: dsh-subscribe#plugin
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Steam-style plugin storefront: a plugin registry browsable inside DSH with one-click install, uninstall and update, plus a zero-dependency CLI and agent-callable market tools.
plugins.description_zh: Steam 风格的插件商店：在 DSH 里浏览插件注册表，一键安装、卸载与更新，另有零依赖 CLI 与可供 agent 调用的市场工具。

plugins.name: dsh-swarm-router
plugins.author: r600a-code
plugins.description: Sub-agent matrix swarm that routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus cfgpu.com/llm/square, dispatches each via in-process subagents or direct LLM calls, and tracks per-model token consumption with a feedback-driven ranking.
plugins.description_zh: 子智能体矩阵蜂群：把异质任务路由到最合适的模型（OpenRouter 类网关 + cfgpu.com/llm/square），通过进程内子智能体或直接 LLM 调用下放，并按模型统计 token 消耗、用真实反馈驱动排名。

plugins.name: dsh-sxs-anti-bot-http
plugins.author: yangyunsong023
plugins.description: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`.
plugins.description_zh: 反爬 HTTP 工具：UA 池轮换、指数退避重试、反爬墙检测（验证码/安全验证）与自适应限流，提炼自 SXS 生产采集体系（每日数百万请求）——工具：`sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`。

plugins.name: dsh-sxs-news-collector
plugins.author: yangyunsong023
plugins.description: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.
plugins.description_zh: 时事热点采集：一次调用聚合百度热搜 / 头条热榜 / 抖音热点 / 微博热搜（微博可选 cookie），返回标题+热度值，供内容创作借势——工具：`sxs_news_hot`。

plugins.name: dsh-system-monitor
plugins.author: jackma5477001

plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 界面右上角实时显示运行 DSH 服务端机器的 CPU 与内存使用情况。

plugins.name: dsh-taskswarm
plugins.author: february2015
plugins.description: DSH port of TaskPlane: dependency-ordered waves run in parallel git-worktree lanes, with task packets, cross-model review, and crash recovery.
plugins.description_zh: TaskPlane 的 DSH 移植版：按依赖分波、多 lane 并行执行（git worktree 隔离），任务包 + 跨模型评审 + 崩溃可恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-team
plugins.author: huxint
plugins.description: Agent teams: spawn named long-lived teammates, coordinate them with a shared task list, member mailbox, and virtual workspaces, and watch the team live in a team-room tab.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 团队：派生具名常驻队友，用共享任务列表、成员邮箱与虚拟工作区协作，并在协作室页签里实时观察团队。

plugins.name: dsh-testkit
plugins.author: iiwish
plugins.description: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured evidence.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Docker 隔离的真实宿主中测试 DSH 插件的安装、启动、工具注册、更新、卸载、重装与恢复生命周期，并输出结构化证据。

plugins.name: dsh-theme
plugins.author: mux9056-bot
plugins.description: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.

plugins.name: dsh-theme-kit
plugins.author: ink5897
plugins.description: 32 preset themes across three palettes (Morandi, Macaron, Chinese traditional), animated and static wallpapers, paper textures, per-zone opacity and text depth, plus a keyboard desktop pet.
plugins.description_zh: 32 款预设主题（莫兰迪 / 马卡龙 / 中国传统色）、动态与静态壁纸、纸纹纹理、分区透明度与文字深浅，附按键桌宠。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-switch
plugins.author: kinmat-A
plugins.description: One-click skin switching for DSH Web settings: auto-detects installed themes, keeps exactly one active at a time, and falls back to the official look when all are off. Changes apply instantly and survive restarts.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 主题切换：自动检测已安装的皮肤/主题，在设置页一键互斥切换，全部停用时回退官方默认外观，切换即时生效并跨重启保留。

plugins.name: dsh-themes
plugins.author: MangMax
plugins.description: Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 外观与主题插件：内置调色板、明 / 暗 / 跟随系统外观模式、Open VSX 主题搜索导入与 VS Code 主题导入，主题库持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-ths-holdings

plugins.description: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.

plugins.name: dsh-tick-rail

plugins.name: dsh-timeline
plugins.author: houyanchao
plugins.description: DSH productivity plugin: timeline navigation, prompt library, conversation export, quick notes, and more.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 效率插件：时间轴、提示词库、导出对话、闪记等提效功能。

plugins.author: KIDLi1412
plugins.description: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month / all-time totals.
plugins.description_zh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage
plugins.author: kelearns
plugins.description: Token usage heatmap for the Web UI: daily/weekly/cumulative views over a 12-month window with light/dark themes.

plugins.description: Manual approval mode ("Manual Mode" / "Ask Mode").
plugins.description_zh: 手动审批模式（Manual/Ask Mode）。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-vision

Bring your own DASHSCOPE_API_KEY; endpoint/model/budgets configurable, redirect-proof HTTP client, works in every agent preset.

plugins.name: dsh-tool-vision

plugins.description_zh: TPS 指标插件。

plugins.name: dsh-tui-pro

plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端工作台，提供独立持久助手、按工作区分组的项目会话、仅聊天区滚动，以及结构化思考、工具、diff、计划和子代理视图。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-index
plugins.author: Simon314620
plugins.description: Turn-index sidebar with scroll-spy highlighting.
plugins.description_zh: 轮次索引侧边栏，滚动时自动高亮当前轮次。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-marks
plugins.author: magicOF2
plugins.description: Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.
plugins.description_zh: 会话左侧消息标记条：每发一条消息多一根条条，点击跳转到该消息、悬停预览内容，当前消息对应的条条变白。

plugins.name: dsh-UEAssetsOperator
plugins.author: QSWWLTN
plugins.description: Unreal Engine .uasset inspection (resolve/registry/load) and restricted Blueprint node editing through built-in UE Python.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 Unreal 内置 Python 提供 .uasset 检查与受限蓝图节点编辑。

plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 界面系统通知：回合结束或 agent 等待授权/回答/计划审核时，页面在后台也弹出系统级提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-unarchive

plugins.name: dsh-update-checker
plugins.author: YZz-S

plugins.description_zh: 会话顶栏徽章：显示 DeepSeek Harness 当前版本，自动检查 npm 最新版本，有新版时提示升级。

plugins.author: 1HelloMan1
plugins.description: Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations across replay, compaction, and restarts.
plugins.description_zh: 将聊天图片交给固定的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，把事实性观察交给当前主模型，并在事件回放、上下文压缩和重启时复用会话内观察。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-plugin
plugins.author: nexsjournal
plugins.description: Installs an image-input checkbox into the Models catalog so a custom model can declare image input and receive images directly; includes an optional BYO vision relay.
plugins.description_zh: 给模型目录装上「图片输入」勾选框，自定义模型声明后可直接收图；附带可选的 BYO 视觉中继。

plugins.name: dsh-voice
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.
plugins.description_zh: 语音输入、语音输出：把口述音频转写为用户消息（transcribe），让 agent 朗读回复（speak），本地优先，音频存于 ~/.dsh/voice。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-call
plugins.author: PandaPolo
plugins.description: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.
plugins.description_zh: agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

plugins.name: dsh-vscode-theme
plugins.author: Sim-xia
plugins.description: Imports .vsix theme files made for Visual Studio Code and applies them to the DSH Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 导入为 Visual Studio Code 设计的 .vsix 主题文件并应用到 DSH Web UI。

plugins.name: dsh-wallpaper
plugins.author: code-newbie-1
plugins.description: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a wallpaper-design panel (opacity, scope, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
plugins.description_zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-wallpaper
plugins.author: keke050
plugins.description: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: presets, image URL or upload, and an opacity slider that fades the interface to reveal the wallpaper.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：预设 / 图片 URL / 本地上传，透明度滑块让整面界面透出壁纸。

plugins.name: dsh-wallpaper-engine
plugins.author: sakuraaa667
plugins.description: Use wallpapers downloaded in Wallpaper Engine as the DeepSeek Harness web background: video wallpapers play in place, image wallpapers use the highest-resolution standalone artwork, with cover/contain fit modes and a 0-100 panel dimmer.
plugins.description_zh: 将 Wallpaper Engine 中已下载的壁纸用作 DeepSeek Harness 的背景：视频壁纸原位播放，图片壁纸优先使用最高分辨率原图，支持铺满/完整显示适配与 0–100 面板暗化。

plugins.name: dsh-wallpaper-engine
plugins.author: ruijiaang-lab
plugins.description: Wallpaper backgrounds for the DSH web GUI. Windows: reads your Wallpaper Engine (Steam) library and plays video/web wallpapers behind the chat. macOS: scans the WaifuX download folder and loose media folders automatically — anything saved in WaifuX becomes a DSH background with zero setup. Liquid-glass blur, dim and border sliders.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 聊天背景壁纸。Windows：直接读取你的 Wallpaper Engine（Steam）库，把视频/网页壁纸渲染到聊天界面背后。macOS：自动扫描 WaifuX 下载目录和媒体文件夹——在 WaifuX 里保存的壁纸零配置即可成为 DSH 背景，支持视频与图片。带毛玻璃模糊、压暗、边框调节滑块。

plugins.name: dsh-web-auth
plugins.author: SummerSec
plugins.description: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的传输层认证门禁，提供服务端会话、HttpOnly Cookie、基于 IP 的登录限流及 scrypt 口令 CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-web-launcher
plugins.author: hanwuji1
plugins.description: One-click launcher for the Web UI: a double-click Start-DSH-Web.cmd on the Windows desktop that boots dsh web and auto-opens the browser (polling until ready), plus a web_launcher model tool (install / open / status).
plugins.description_zh: Web 界面一键启动器：在 Windows 桌面创建双击即用的 Start-DSH-Web.cmd（自动启动 dsh web，轮询就绪后自动打开浏览器），并提供 web_launcher 模型工具（install / open / status）。

plugins.name: dsh-web-launcher
plugins.author: ayingQAQ
plugins.description: Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 的 Windows 桌面启动器插件，创建受管理的快捷方式，后续启动会在后台重启 DSH 并刷新已有浏览器页面。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-firecrawl
plugins.author: elves-ai
plugins.description: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 Firecrawl 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量等字段的设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-web-shell
plugins.author: JesmonX
plugins.description: Collapsible right-docked web terminal (xterm.js) bridged to a host PTY over WebSocket: bash/zsh switching, resizable panel, and fold/unfold that keeps the session alive.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧停靠的可折叠 Web 终端（xterm.js），经 WebSocket 桥接宿主 PTY：支持 bash/zsh 切换、拖拽调宽，折叠时保留会话。

plugins.name: dsh-wechat-mp-studio
plugins.author: FuncWei
plugins.description: WeChat Official Account content studio: anti-homogenization rotation writing, low-creativity remediation playbook, blessing-image visual baseline, gpt-image pipeline with OCR acceptance, and the measured xiaolvshu draft web API.
plugins.description_zh: 微信公众号内容生产工作台：防低创作度结构轮换写作法、低创作度整改实战、祝福图视觉基线、gpt-image 配图管线与 OCR 验收、小绿书草稿网页接口实测参数。

plugins.name: dsh-weixin
plugins.author: xmanrui
plugins.description: Connect a Weixin bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
plugins.description_zh: 通过微信扫码把微信机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-background
plugins.author: tuogusa
plugins.description: Whale-girl wallpaper background with a frosted semi-transparent app surface; customize image, opacity, and contain/cover from the Web settings, with remote image preflight and no-referrer loading.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 鲸鱼娘壁纸背景，应用表面半透明磨砂；支持在设置页自定义图片、透明度与 contain/cover 铺放方式，远程图片自动预检并 no-referrer 加载。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-pet
plugins.author: miku00039-01
plugins.description: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

plugins.name: dsh-wildmon
plugins.author: swaylq
plugins.description: Pokemon-style catch-em-all: your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Zero tokens, invisible to the model.
plugins.description_zh: 宝可梦式捕捉收集：真实工作就是草丛 —— 回合、工具调用、报错刷出野外遭遇；投球捕捉、集 28 格图鉴、带 6 只队伍。零 token，模型完全看不见。

plugins.name: dsh-with-pencil
plugins.author: IWAIBAOLI
plugins.description: Bring the official pen.dev Pencil into DeepSeek Harness via the official CLI: in-conversation .pen editing tools, optimized specifically for DeepSeek's text-only model.
plugins.description_zh: 将官方 pen.dev Pencil 设计能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：桥接官方 CLI，Agent 可在会话中编辑 .pen 文件，并针对 DeepSeek 纯文本模型做了专门优化。

plugins.name: dsh-workbench
plugins.author: Dely0
plugins.description: Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus reminders and per-task AI session workspaces.
plugins.description_zh: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-files-explorer
plugins.author: YZz-S
plugins.description: Floating workspace file-tree browser for the Web GUI with line-numbered syntax highlighting and Markdown preview.
plugins.description_zh: 悬浮工作区文件树浏览器：带行号的代码语法高亮与 Markdown 富文本预览。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-scope
plugins.author: Ri0n72Y
plugins.description: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
plugins.description_zh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-snapshot
plugins.author: txy-ucas
plugins.description: Reports bounded, repository-relative Git status as structured data without staging, committing, or changing branches.
plugins.description_zh: 以结构化数据返回有界、相对仓库根的 Git 状态，不暂存、不提交，也不切换分支。

plugins.name: dsh-xiangqi
plugins.author: ovdoesw
plugins.description: A draggable mascot invites you to play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) while the AI thinks, with a built-in engine, move-record export, and optional multi-model commentary.
plugins.description_zh: 卡通小宠物邀请你在 AI 思考间隙下中国象棋：内置引擎、走子记谱导出、可选多模型局势点评。

plugins.name: dsh-youreyes
plugins.author: 54xkeee
plugins.description: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
plugins.description_zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图工具包：模型可主动调用的 `vision` 工具、deepseek/opencode-go 包装适配器（v4 flash/pro）、反重力额度（默认，flash/pro）/ 任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM / Gemini / 本地 Ollama 通道、证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

plugins.name: dsh-zhihu-dashboard
plugins.author: kexuejin
plugins.description: Zhihu (知乎) dashboard: hot list with trend arrows, follow feed (favorites/creations/followees), post tracking (question/keyword/person) with auto-briefs, and five agent tools (zhihu_search/hot/answer/global_search/followees).
plugins.description_zh: 知乎面板：热榜（带趋势标记）、关注动态（收藏/创作/关注的人）、帖子追踪（问题/关键词/关注的人，支持自动创意简报），并提供 5 个对话工具（zhihu_search / hot / answer / global_search / followees）。

plugins.name: dshp
plugins.author: asdf17128
plugins.description: Registers `list_profiles` and `export_profile`, so the agent can show what setups exist and hand back a whole profile — bundle order, plugin versions and patch — as one portable file to share. Read-only.
plugins.description_zh: 注册 `list_profiles` 与 `export_profile`：让 agent 列出本机有哪些配置，并把整套 profile（bundle 顺序、插件版本、patch）导出成一个可直接分享的文件。只读。

plugins.name: dynamic-schulte-dsh
plugins.author: marvin9551
plugins.description: Dynamic Schulte grid waiting-time mini-game: click 1..N in order on a static grid or a spinning roulette wheel while the model thinks.
plugins.description_zh: 动态舒尔特方格等待小游戏：模型思考时，在静态网格或旋转轮盘上按顺序点击 1..N，边玩边等。

plugins.name: harmonyos-dev-mcp-for-dsh
plugins.author: NormanFxxkingRockwell
plugins.description: Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screenshot), E2E UI-tree inspection, and log/crash analysis as 18 mcp__harmonyos__* tools.
plugins.description_zh: 把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。

plugins.name: inspiration-deck-workshop
plugins.author: zjsthmjialin
plugins.description: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: inspiration-deck-workshop#dsh-inspiration-deck-workshop
plugins.author: zjsthmjialin
plugins.description: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: iterate-plugin
plugins.author: jingzhao-l
plugins.description: Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.
plugins.description_zh: 把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。

plugins.name: keyringseam
plugins.author: fieldnote-ops
plugins.description: macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.
plugins.description_zh: macOS Keychain 凭据提供器：替换本地文件提供器，并使用已签名、公证的通用二进制辅助程序。

plugins.name: lazeword
plugins.author: xczhanjun
plugins.description: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.
plugins.description_zh: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

plugins.name: LiuHe
plugins.author: wulun811
plugins.description: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
plugins.description_zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

plugins.name: LiuHe#bundle
plugins.author: wulun811
plugins.description: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
plugins.description_zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills-dsh
plugins.author: gongyijie85
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md files: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code-review, wayfinder, ask-matt router and more) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin, adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).
plugins.description_zh: Matt Pocock 完整发布技能集（25 个 SKILL.md：grilling、writing-for-agents、wait-what、TDD、code-review、wayfinder、ask-matt 路由等）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：改编自 mattpocock/skills（MIT）。

plugins.name: mimo-vision
plugins.author: wulusai2333
plugins.description: `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.
plugins.description_zh: `describe_image` 视觉桥：经 opencode Zen API（凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，免费线路优先、付费兜底）把图片发给 mimo-v2.5、返回文字描述给纯文本模型，原生格式直发，SVG/TIFF/HEIC 等格式经 ImageMagick 自动转码。

plugins.name: muretai-dsh-skill
plugins.author: muretai
plugins.description: Puts the agent on the Muretai network: its own identity, invite-based introductions, signed end-to-end encrypted messaging with agents owned by other people, and an inbound-mail wake that lets it reply on its own.
plugins.description_zh: 让智能体加入 Muretai 网络：拥有自己的身份，通过邀请相识，与属于其他人的智能体进行签名、端到端加密的通信；来信唤醒后可自行回复。

plugins.name: noatmark-dsh-plugin
plugins.author: ylwl1997
plugins.description: Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.
plugins.description_zh: 文本卫生 dsh 插件：净化不可信文本、扫描隐形字符、清洗 LLM 格式、转义 CSV 公式注入。

plugins.name: pbr-render
plugins.author: dhb861832993-star
plugins.description: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.
plugins.description_zh: 游戏美术 PBR 3D 模型预览：GLB/GLTF 带贴图纹理、IBL 环境光照、轨道控制，以及材质通道检查器（基础色/法线/粗糙度/金属度/AO/自发光/线框），标量通道按 PBR 规范以灰度显示，通过 pbr3d 围栏与 pbr_render 工具使用。

plugins.name: pdf-background-gray-codex-skill
plugins.author: zjsthmjialin
plugins.description: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
plugins.description_zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

plugins.name: pdf-background-gray-codex-skill#dsh-pdf-background-gray
plugins.author: zjsthmjialin
plugins.description: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
plugins.description_zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

plugins.name: qcc-mcp-oauth
plugins.author: duhu2000
plugins.description: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
plugins.description_zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查 MCP 服务：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖全部企查查数据服务。

plugins.name: review-quote-sh
plugins.author: Nothree-code
plugins.description: Message review and quote chips for conversations: multi-model cross review (code/reply) with severity grading and summaries, review history, and host-persisted preferences.
plugins.description_zh: 对话消息审查与引用：多模型并行互审（代码/回复审查、严重度分级、综合汇总）、引用问答胶囊、评审历史与偏好记忆。

plugins.name: review-workflow
plugins.author: LeslieWylie
plugins.description: A structured multi-panelist review workflow for the DeepSeek Harness: N panelists score in isolated subagents, blind to each other; a chair reconciles disagreement by anchor match then Δ-level adjudication; an independent critic audits the process. Works for design, code, paper or project review.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化多评审人评审工作流：N 个评审人在相互隔离、彼此不可见的 subagent 中独立打分；一名 chair 先按锚点匹配、再按 Δ 级别裁决来调和分歧；一名独立的 critic 负责审计整个评审过程。适用于设计、代码、论文或项目评审。

plugins.name: skill-bartender
plugins.author: akqwpeter-prog
plugins.description: Task-to-skill pairing meta-skill with a laziness ladder for minimal loading, a user-editable routing table, and a quarantine, SkillSpector scan, human-approval install flow.
plugins.description_zh: 任务到技能配对元技能：懒人阶梯最小化加载、可编辑路由表、隔离-SkillSpector 扫描-人工确认的安装流程。

plugins.name: spec-driven
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Spec-driven development discipline for dsh: five keel skills (anchor/spec/probe/build/audit), three review tools and six spec templates enforce specs-before-code, assumption verification and scope control.
plugins.description_zh: 规格驱动开发纪律技能包（keel）：五个技能（锚定/立规/探针/建造/审计）、三个审查工具与六个规格模板，强制先规格后代码、假设先行验证并约束范围蔓延。

plugins.name: StrataGate-AgentMemory#deepseek-harness
plugins.author: diqierjia
plugins.description: Automatic, local-first cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: remembers user preferences, project decisions, conversations, and tool results; verifies recalled information against original messages before answering.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自动本地跨会话记忆：记住用户偏好、项目决策、历史对话与工具结果；回答前检查证据，并可追溯到原始消息。

plugins.name: stylotrace#dsh-plugin-stylotrace
plugins.author: zhangyoufu-123
plugins.description: Deep-collaboration writing agent for DSH: per-user writing-style learning from edit pairs, clarify→outline→section-writing→red-team→reader-gallery flow, project-to-report synthesis (lab report / product intro / survey / README), 41 MCP tools, and web selection-improve UI with in-app file preview.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 的深度协作写作 Agent：从用户的编辑对学习个人写作风格，完整 澄清→大纲→逐节写作→红队审计→读者群像 流程，项目自动提炼成实验报告/产品介绍/综述/README，41 个 MCP 工具，Web 端选中改进与文件内嵌预览。

plugins.name: token-usage-counter
plugins.author: Mu-scorpio
plugins.description: Persistent provider-reported token usage totals with per-session, per-model, and daily activity statistics.
plugins.description_zh: 持久化 provider 上报的 Token 用量统计，支持按会话、按模型和按日活跃度查看。

plugins.name: want-a-init
plugins.author: mexiaosqwq
plugins.description: Model-driven /init command: the agent analyzes the current repo and generates/updates a high-signal AGENTS.md, with a persistent system-prompt reminder to keep it maintained.
plugins.description_zh: 模型驱动 /init 命令：让 agent 分析当前仓库并生成/更新高信号 AGENTS.md，并通过常驻 system prompt 提醒持续维护。

plugins.name: whale-on-desk
plugins.author: cookiesheep
plugins.description: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.
plugins.description_zh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠,29 个逐帧验收状态:等批准时贴屏敲玻璃并让标签页标题闪烁,任务完成开口汇报,并为 web 端提供斜杠命令面板。

plugins.name: worktree-mgr
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Per-task isolated git worktrees with a full create/sync/finish lifecycle: task names auto-derive branches, merge targets are double-checked, and batch cleanup is built in — zero manual git operations.
plugins.description_zh: 按任务隔离的 git worktree 工作区，覆盖创建/同步/收尾全生命周期：任务名自动派生分支、合并目标双重校验、内置批量清理——全程零手工 git 操作。

plugins.name: zzy-dsh-prompt-optimizer
plugins.author: zhengzeyong9527-droid
plugins.description: Adds prompt optimization, cancellation, and undo controls to the DeepSeek Harness composer.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话输入框提供提示词优化：优化过程中可取消，完成后可一键撤回。

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Adversarial multi-lens code review: parallel correctness/security/maintainability lenses attack a diff, with deterministic severity grading, suppression rules and incremental review history.
plugins.description_zh: 对抗式多视角代码审查：正确性/安全性/可维护性透镜并行攻击 diff，确定性严重度定级、抑制规则与增量审查历史。

plugins.name: arch-doc
plugins.author: duyanta123
plugins.description: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.
plugins.description_zh: 分析代码库并生成架构文档：模块职责、依赖关系、入口点与运行方式。

plugins.name: bash-on-windows
plugins.author: bainianlaoyao
plugins.description: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
plugins.description_zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

plugins.name: better-reasoning-slider
plugins.author: vvvspec
plugins.description: Official-style composer model trigger with a floating reasoning-effort slider popup.
plugins.description_zh: 官方风格输入框 + 浮动推理能力滑块弹窗，节点与滑块对齐，弹窗跟随 Harness 主题自适应。

plugins.name: browser-automation
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 的真实浏览器自动化:基于 Playwright 的 MCP 服务,提供导航、点击、填写、输入、截图与带编号引用的无障碍快照操作,22 个 web_* 工具经 stdio 接入 Agent。

plugins.name: clippy-harness#plugin
plugins.author: sjh9714
plugins.description: Clippy is back and this time he can actually help. An office assistant pet that reacts to real agent state, jumps when the turn completes, and opens a classic "illegal operation" dialog when a turn fails.
plugins.description_zh: 回形针助手回来了，这次它真的会干活：会对真实 agent 状态做出反应的办公助手宠物，任务完成时跳起来庆祝，回合失败时弹出经典的 "illegal operation" 对话框。

plugins.name: CN Boot
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: China-network bootstrap for DeepSeek Harness: probes npm/npmmirror/GitHub/HuggingFace/Gitee and local proxies, reads registry config, recommends mirrors/proxy, generates a PowerShell + bash bootstrap. Read-only by default; apply is explicit.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 国内网络引导：探测 npm/npmmirror/GitHub/HuggingFace/Gitee 与本地代理，读取注册表配置，推荐镜像/代理并生成 PowerShell + bash 引导脚本。默认只读，apply 需显式开启。

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Code knowledge graph: indexes symbols, call sites and imports into SQLite, answers call/dependency questions.
plugins.description_zh: 代码知识图谱：把符号、调用点与导入索引进 SQLite，回答调用/依赖问题。

plugins.name: command-scout
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Scans a project's declared build commands — Makefile targets, package.json scripts, just recipes, deno tasks — and exposes them as ready-to-run agent tools.
plugins.description_zh: 扫描项目已声明的构建命令——Makefile 目标、package.json 脚本、just 配方、deno 任务——并作为可直接调用的 agent 工具暴露给智能体。

plugins.name: computer-control
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Desktop (native) control for dsh as a stdio JSON-RPC bridge over a Python core: capture the screen, inject pointer/keyboard input, drive accessibility-tree actions, and gate high-risk operations behind required confirmations.
plugins.description_zh: 桌面(native)控制:dsh 经 stdio JSON-RPC 桥接 Python 核心;支持截屏、指针/键盘注入、无障碍树语义操作,并以强制确认为高风险操作把关。

plugins.name: context-pruner
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Session context triage for long DeepSeek Harness sessions: deterministic screeners trim stale, duplicate, failed, and oversized content through the official ctx.compaction seam.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 长会话的上下文分诊插件：通过官方 ctx.compaction 接缝，用确定性规则筛查并裁剪过期、重复、失败与超大的上下文内容。

plugins.name: cot-lint
plugins.author: YuanyuanMa03
plugins.description: Chain-of-thought leakage linter: zero-dependency CLI that finds AI-session residue in docs and comments (dead design citations, PR vantage, change narration, review choreography), shipping the cot-trim fixing skill as the installable bundle.
plugins.description_zh: 思维链泄漏检测：零依赖 CLI 扫描 AI 留在文档与注释里的会话残留（死设计引用、PR 视角、变更叙述、评审编排），内置 cot-trim 语义修复技能包。

plugins.name: dashr#dashr
plugins.author: fgm-builds
plugins.description: RLM mode for dsh: recursive sub-agents via a unified rlm() function — spawn, await, and chain child agents as first-class Python calls. Adds a persistent IPython kernel with tools.* bindings and context-as-variable.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 的 RLM 模式：通过统一的 rlm() 函数实现递归子代理——以一等 Python 函数调用生成、等待、链式传递子代理。附带常驻 IPython 内核、tools.* 绑定与上下文即变量。

plugins.name: DeepSeek-Harness-Hanako-Memory
plugins.author: moononnn
plugins.description: Hana-style assistant manager for DSH: visual preset management (cards, yuan personalities, avatar cropping) plus a full Hana memory stack (rolling summaries, layered compilation, SQLite fact store, deep memory).
plugins.description_zh: Hana 式助手管理：可视化配置助手预设（卡片、四性格「元」、头像裁剪），并完整复刻 Hana 记忆系统（滚动摘要、分层编译、SQLite 事实库、深度记忆）。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-orchestrate
plugins.author: apheli0os
plugins.description: Declarative task-DAG orchestration for DSH: validates dependency graphs, runs topological task layers in parallel through workflow-backed subagents, and propagates failures deterministically.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 声明式任务 DAG 编排：校验依赖图，通过工作流子智能体并行执行拓扑任务层，并确定性传播失败。

plugins.name: Dep Audit
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Dependency supply-chain hygiene audit for DeepSeek Harness: peer-range resolvability, broken dist-tag detection (#2763 class), stale/missing-license/non-registry deps, and installed-vs-declared drift. CLI + agent-callable dep_audit tool with dsh-dep-audit/v1 reports.
plugins.description_zh: 依赖供应链卫生审计：peer 范围可解析性、坏 dist-tag 检测（#2763 类）、过期/缺许可证/非注册表来源依赖，以及安装版本与声明的漂移。CLI + agent 可调用 dep_audit 工具，输出 dsh-dep-audit/v1 报告。

plugins.name: Discussions Radar
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Official GitHub Discussions radar for DeepSeek Harness: list/filter/search the official boards (Ideas / Q&A / Show Your Plugins! / General / Announcements / Polls). CLI + agent-callable discussions_radar tool, dsh-discussions-radar/v1 reports.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方 Discussions 雷达：列出/筛选/搜索官方讨论区（Ideas / Q&A / Show Your Plugins! / General / Announcements / Polls）。CLI + agent 可调用 discussions_radar 工具，输出 dsh-discussions-radar/v1 报告。

plugins.name: Disk Audit
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Disk-usage audit for dsh data directories: total size, per-directory breakdown, largest files, oversized-file warnings (session logs can hit hundreds of MB) and cleanup suggestions. CLI + agent-callable disk_audit tool with dsh-disk-audit/v1 reports.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 数据目录磁盘占用审计：总大小、按目录拆分、最大文件、超大文件告警（会话日志可达数百 MB）与清理建议。CLI + agent 可调用 disk_audit 工具，输出 dsh-disk-audit/v1 报告。

plugins.name: dknowc-dsh
plugins.author: dylanzhangzx
plugins.description: Trusted office suite for government/enterprise work by Beijing Caizhi Technology (深知可信智能): three skills — trusted consulting (policy/regulation Q&A with citation markers + provenance HTML), trusted search (authoritative policy/standard retrieval with traceable HTML + clean Markdown), and official-document writing (draft/rewrite/Word/red-head delivery); all interfaces go through the dknowc trusted workbench MCP (Bearer auth), products land in the session workspace, one-time key setup persists for later sessions; ships on npm as dknowc-dsh.
plugins.description_zh: 彩智科技深知可信智能出品的可信办公全家桶 dsh 插件：包含深知可信咨询（政策/法规/办事问答，带真实来源角标 + 可点击溯源 HTML）、深知可信搜索（权威政策/标准检索与深度研究，溯源 HTML + 干净 Markdown）、深知公文写作（正式公文起草/改写/Word/红头交付）三个 Skill；接口统一经深知可信工作台 MCP 转接（Bearer 认证），产物写入会话工作区，API Key 一次配置长期免注册；已发布 npm 包 dknowc-dsh。

plugins.name: docgen
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Document workshop skill pack: four pure-prompt Agent Skills that turn a codebase into READMEs, PR descriptions, changelogs and code reviews, installed into dsh via a dsh.bundle plugin row.
plugins.description_zh: 文档工坊技能包：四个纯提示词 Agent Skills，从代码库生成 README、PR 描述、changelog 与代码审查意见，以 dsh.bundle 插件行接入 dsh，也可文件式发现免拷贝使用。

plugins.name: docs-retriever
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Doctrove: versioned library documentation retrieval MCP server for coding agents — catalog lookup, version selection and focus-ranked doc extraction, with zero runtime dependencies and a dsh bundle.
plugins.description_zh: doctrove：面向编码 agent 的版本化库文档检索 MCP server——目录检索、版本选择与按主题提取带相关度排序的文档片段，零运行时依赖，dsh bundle 接入。

plugins.name: dph-taskboard
plugins.author: 1070296335-create
plugins.description: Session-based task board in the sidebar: drag sessions into todo/doing/review/done columns, create sessions with model and reasoning-effort selection, trash with restore, notes, export/import.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏会话化任务看板：拖拽会话到待办/进行中/评审中/已完成四列，新建会话可选模型与推理强度，回收站可恢复，支持备注与导出导入。

plugins.name: DSH MCP Client
plugins.author: deepseek-harness
plugins.description: Official MCP client so your agent can call external MCP tools.
plugins.description_zh: Official MCP client so your agent can call external MCP tools.

plugins.name: DSH Memory Evolve
plugins.author: csyangwen
plugins.description: Memory evolution with git and webhooks.
plugins.description_zh: Memory evolution with git and webhooks.

plugins.name: DSH Vision Toolkit
plugins.author: Anionex
plugins.description: Native OCR / UI / vision toolkit for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: Native OCR / UI / vision toolkit for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-agent-canvas
plugins.author: Lhy723
plugins.description: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-conductor
plugins.author: akqwpeter-prog
plugins.description: Dispatch self-contained tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok): a host-only bundle registering the conductor_dispatch tool plus an auto-triggered conductor skill.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 里派活给 11 种外部 agent CLI（Codex、Claude Code、TraeCode、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Kimi、Qwen、Copilot、WorkBuddy、Grok）：host-only bundle 注册 conductor_dispatch 工具，附自动触发的指挥家技能。

plugins.name: dsh-agentframe-suite
plugins.author: ljsysfurryACE
plugins.description: One-command bundle of the three AgentFrame plugins: memory-director, compaction, and aura-scheduler together.
plugins.description_zh: AgentFrame 三件套整合包：一条命令装齐记忆、压缩与主动调度。

plugins.name: dsh-agentmail
plugins.author: agentmail-to
plugins.description: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
plugins.description_zh: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

plugins.name: dsh-agentmemory
plugins.author: Yiipu
plugins.description: DSH ↔ agentmemory session-memory bridge: mirrors session lifecycle into a local agentmemory daemon (REST), exposes memory_recall / memory_remember tools, and injects a per-session memory context window via agent/pre-step.
plugins.description_zh: DSH ↔ agentmemory 会话记忆桥：把会话生命周期镜像到本地 agentmemory 守护进程（REST），提供 memory_recall / memory_remember 工具，并通过 agent/pre-step 按会话注入记忆上下文窗口。

plugins.name: dsh-aicc-zhunao
plugins.author: Cola1018
plugins.description: Main-brain orchestration preset: delegation-first persona, root-session execution gate, and portable AI-LAW rule skill.
plugins.description_zh: 主脑编排 preset：委派优先的 persona、根会话执行门禁，以及可移植的 AI-LAW 规则技能。

plugins.name: dsh-airdrop
plugins.author: demacia1314
plugins.description: Codex-app-style attachments for DSH: drop any file or folder anywhere in the window — bytes upload straight into the session workspace on the server, so remote servers and SSH tunnels work exactly like localhost.
plugins.description_zh: 像在 Codex app 里一样给 DSH 加附件：任意文件、任意文件夹，拖到窗口任意位置即可——字节直接上传到服务器的会话工作区，远程服务器和 SSH 隧道下与本地体验一致。

plugins.name: dsh-anthropic-fonts
plugins.author: Isilsolme
plugins.description: Anthropic Sans, Serif, and Mono fonts for the DSH Web UI, with Source Han fallback for CJK.
plugins.description_zh: Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono 字体：界面 Sans、对话 Serif、代码 Mono，中文回退思源字体。

plugins.name: dsh-api-key-pool
plugins.author: xiaozhe7772222
plugins.description: API key rotation pool for your LLM providers: auto-discovers providers from settings, per-provider multi-key round-robin, failover on 401/403/429, and cooldown recovery.
plugins.description_zh: 对话模型 API Key 轮换池：自动检测 settings 中的厂商，每个厂商下多 Key 轮询，401/403/429 自动切换，冷却恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-translator
plugins.author: xiyuepcl
plugins.description: DSH审批汉化 — approval dialogs translated to Chinese before they render: DeepSeek-powered, host-side, nothing for React to revert.
plugins.description_zh: DSH审批汉化 — 审批弹窗在渲染前自动翻译成中文：DeepSeek 驱动、宿主侧完成，React 重渲染也无法还原。

plugins.name: dsh-archive-manager#plugin
plugins.author: Neumannzc
plugins.description: Beautified archive-manager settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, with a hover unarchive action and relative timestamps.
plugins.description_zh: 美化版归档管理设置页：按工作区分组展示归档会话，悬停即可取消归档，附相对时间显示。

plugins.name: dsh-archived-conversations
plugins.author: AKS1st
plugins.description: Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and unreopenable.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏底部的已归档对话列表，可只读预览最近消息；针对产品刻意隐藏且无法重新打开的归档会话。

plugins.name: dsh-artifacts
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Render Markdown + JSON into self-contained HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries (CLI + artifact_render tool).
plugins.description_zh: 把 Markdown + JSON 渲染成自包含 HTML 文档/卡片/仪表盘/画廊（CLI + 内置 artifact_render 工具）。

plugins.name: dsh-asimovbox
plugins.author: cerebrixos-org
plugins.description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AsimovBox for creating, updating, rendering, and finishing videos through API-key-authenticated tools.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 API 密钥认证的工具将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 AsimovBox，用于创建、更新、渲染和完成视频。

plugins.name: dsh-assistant-message-forge
plugins.author: anweat
plugins.description: Create/modify/inject test assistant messages and import/repair session.jsonl(.zstd) session logs into new sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 消息锻造台：创建/修改/注入测试用 assistant 消息，导入识别并安全修复 session.jsonl(.zstd) 会话日志为新会话。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-classifier
plugins.author: PAKIKNOWLEDGE
plugins.description: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
plugins.description_zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-open-web
plugins.author: jinsiyu
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
plugins.description_zh: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-paste
plugins.author: sakuraqqq
plugins.description: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-reviewer
plugins.author: AntaresCorn
plugins.description: Codex-style auto-review permission mode: adds an auto-review preset that auto-approves safe sandbox escalations, asks on risky or ambiguous ones, and rejects critical unconfirmed operations.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格自动审查权限模式：新增 auto-review 权限档，自动放行安全沙箱提权，危险或模糊操作转人工确认，未确认的致命操作直接拒绝。

plugins.name: dsh-autoresume
plugins.author: shengyvself
plugins.description: Auto-continue an interrupted dsh session after a web restart by injecting a "continue" follow-up; one-shot per process, no duplicate-injection loops.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web 重启后自动向被打断的会话注入「继续」，让 agent 自动接续干活；每进程只注入一次，不重复触发。

plugins.name: dsh-balance
plugins.author: GeekRicardo
plugins.description: Composer-dock balance/usage readout for DeepSeek, Kimi Coding, OpenCode Go, Zhipu, MiniMax, OpenRouter and OpenAI Codex — provider-based, 2s polling, 5min cache.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方按 provider 展示 DeepSeek、Kimi Coding、OpenCode Go、智谱、MiniMax、OpenRouter、OpenAI Codex 的余额/用量，2 秒轮询、5 分钟缓存。

plugins.name: dsh-branch-review
plugins.author: chouyong
plugins.description: Track human decisions for related DSH session branches: keep, discard, or follow up with reasons, labels, and external links.
plugins.description_zh: 为相关 DSH 会话分支记录人工决策：保留、淘汰或待跟进，并保存理由、标签与外部链接。

plugins.name: dsh-bull-bear
plugins.author: potoior
plugins.description: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的实时行情牛熊桌宠：由自选组合平均涨跌驱动，收益越接近 20% 跑得越猛；带自选面板可搜索添加股票，还有展示每只标的涨跌的实时赛跑。

plugins.name: dsh-butler-memory
plugins.author: AndyYang12345
plugins.description: PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.
plugins.description_zh: PostgreSQL 持久个人记忆：MCP 记忆工具 + 可查看记忆与候选的 Web 面板。

plugins.name: dsh-capability-optimizer
plugins.author: hezhongtang
plugins.description: Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.
plugins.description_zh: 以 advisor / reviewer / designer 角色无头调用 Claude Code，回复作为参考答案。

plugins.name: dsh-cdp-browser
plugins.author: zaiwenJ
plugins.description: CDP bridge to an already-running Chrome/Edge for DSH: screenshots, pixel assertions, DOM/CSS checks, and page JS evaluation over HTTP + WebSocket, with zero child processes, zero npm dependencies, and zero per-use approval.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 CDP 连接已运行的 Chrome/Edge：为 DSH 提供截图、像素断言、DOM/CSS 检查与页面 JS 执行，全程 HTTP + WebSocket、零子进程、零 npm 依赖、无需逐次授权。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-history
plugins.author: Stylelinzzz
plugins.description: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.
plugins.description_zh: 在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-index-rail
plugins.author: Mobai-read
plugins.description: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.
plugins.description_zh: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-tidy
plugins.author: ChuanTianML
plugins.description: Refines DSH chat typography, content width, spacing, user bubbles, and the composer with Balanced, Compact, and Original modes.
plugins.description_zh: 调整 DSH 对话页的字号层级、内容宽度、间距、用户气泡与输入框，提供平衡、紧凑和原始三种模式。

plugins.name: dsh-check-update
plugins.author: HuiHuitie-zhu
plugins.description: Update checker (npm edition): a settings page comparing local and latest versions of @deepseek-ai/dsh and every installed plugin, with a red-dot nav reminder and ready-made update commands.
plugins.description_zh: 更新检查器（npm 版）：设置页对比 @deepseek-ai/dsh 与已装插件的本地/最新版本，有更新时导航红点提醒，并直接给出更新命令。

plugins.name: dsh-chrome
plugins.author: stuarthu
plugins.description: Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.
plugins.description_zh: Chrome 侧边栏内嵌 dsh 网页界面，让 agent 读取当前页面、捕获 HTTP 流量并操作浏览器。

plugins.name: dsh-ci-context
plugins.author: lucas-ward
plugins.description: Injects allowlisted GitHub Actions and GitLab CI run metadata into agent context without reading logs, credentials, or provider APIs.
plugins.description_zh: 将白名单内的 GitHub Actions 与 GitLab CI 运行元数据注入 Agent 上下文，不读取日志、凭据或服务商 API。

plugins.name: DSH-Claude-Style-Reasoning-Slider
plugins.author: MEMZ-JZY
plugins.description: Animated Claude-style reasoning-effort slider and model picker that replaces the native DSH model selector.
plugins.description_zh: Claude 风格动画推理等级滑块与模型选择器，替换原生模型选择器。

plugins.name: dsh-click
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Cross-platform native desktop control (Windows-first): screenshots, screen reading, click, input, scroll, keys, and app launching — every mutating action goes through an approval gate.
plugins.description_zh: 跨平台原生桌面控制（Windows 优先）：截图/读屏/点击/输入/滚轮/按键/应用启动，变更动作全过审批门。

plugins.name: dsh-code-intel
plugins.author: lonelymoon87
plugins.description: Indexes workspace symbols with Tree-sitter and provides lexical or optional embedding-assisted code search.
plugins.description_zh: 用 Tree-sitter 建立工作区符号索引，提供词法或可选 embedding 辅助的代码检索。

plugins.name: dsh-code-runtime-container
plugins.author: tancheng33
plugins.description: Container-isolated backend for the `ctx.codeRuntime` seam: each Code Mode program runs in a fresh container with no network, a read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, and kernel-enforced memory, CPU and pid ceilings.
plugins.description_zh: `ctx.codeRuntime` seam 的容器隔离后端：每个 Code Mode 程序跑在全新容器里，无网络、根文件系统只读、丢弃全部 capability，内存/CPU/进程数上限由内核强制。

plugins.name: dsh-codebase-memory
plugins.author: jiayan-xu
plugins.description: Code knowledge graph bridge for codebase-memory-mcp: semantic symbol search (BM25), source snippets, architecture overview with Leiden communities, call/data-flow/cross-service traces, graph-augmented grep.
plugins.description_zh: codebase-memory-mcp 的代码知识图谱桥：语义符号搜索（BM25）、源码片段、Leiden 社区架构总览、调用/数据流/跨服务追踪、图增强 grep。

plugins.name: dsh-cognition
plugins.author: scd13150
plugins.description: Project memory for coding agents on DeepSeek Harness: similar past edits surface as precedents, out-of-scope edits are blocked, and cognition persists across sessions (47 upstream-verified fixes, gold-free 20-task run).
plugins.description_zh: 给 DSH agent 的项目记忆:历史相似编辑作为先例出现、越界修改被 scope 锁拦下、认知跨会话持续积累(47 次上游验收修复、去 gold 化 20/20)。

plugins.name: dsh-compaction
plugins.author: ljsysfurryACE
plugins.description: Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.
plugins.description_zh: 压缩后端：用确定性语义提取器替换 LLM 摘要（保留代码/路径/命令，剔除闲聊），附带 28.4x KV 压缩记账。

plugins.name: dsh-complete-notify
plugins.author: kaixinbaba
plugins.description: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成时播放提示音并弹出小通知：Web Audio 合成音效、页面内 toast、页面在后台时系统通知，纯浏览器方案、零系统依赖、跨平台。

plugins.name: dsh-compressor
plugins.author: lifeodyssey
plugins.description: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.
plugins.description_zh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-console
plugins.author: Isanti2016
plugins.description: Slash-command console for dsh: /web start|stop|restart|status, /tunnel SSH forward management, one-shot /ask, and a console TUI launcher.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 控制台命令：/web 启动/停止/重启/状态、/tunnel SSH 隧道管理、/ask 一次性问答、/console 启动控制台 TUI。

plugins.name: dsh-content-lab
plugins.author: hanyi7867069-create
plugins.description: Content workshop tools for DSH — topic, title, post and content-calendar generation through the built-in LLM.
plugins.description_zh: 内容工坊——选题、标题、文案与排期生成工具，直接调用内置 LLM。

plugins.name: dsh-context-proxy
plugins.author: EvilIrving
plugins.description: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.
plugins.description_zh: 按需取回薄层：context_query / context_slice / context_grep 三个工具读取已持久化的历史，引用可回放。

plugins.name: dsh-conversation-rail
plugins.author: dingyi580
plugins.description: Left-edge conversation rail for the Web UI: one bar per turn, length scaled to the turn text, hover for a question and answer preview, click to jump; bars come from a host-side outline of the whole session log, so turns outside the loaded window are drawn too and history is paged in on click.
plugins.description_zh: 对话左缘的导航轨：一根杠一轮对话，杠长按该轮文字体量，悬停出提问与回答预览，点击跳转；杠来自 host 侧读整份会话日志折出的大纲，未加载进窗口的轮次也画得出来，点击时再翻页补历史。

plugins.name: dsh-convo-cost
plugins.author: ljr282341583
plugins.description: Real-time cost tracking for the current DSH conversation: a composer-dock line showing the running token usage and DeepSeek official price estimate (base and peak/valley pricing).
plugins.description_zh: 当前对话实时费用统计：输入框下方一行显示运行中的 token 用量与 DeepSeek 官方价格估算（基础价与峰谷价）。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-crystal
plugins.author: xxvk
plugins.description: Floating cost crystal for the Web UI: balance card, real-time tok/s, peak/off-peak billing countdown, last-24h spend, and a 🔮 next-message cost forecast, all timezone-aware.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 成本水晶球:余额卡片、实时 tok/s 速率、波峰/低峰计费倒计时、近 24h 消耗,以及 🔮 下一条消息消耗预测,全部时区感知。

plugins.name: dsh-credentials-vault
plugins.author: tancheng33
plugins.description: HashiCorp Vault backend for the credential seam: KV v2/v1, AppRole machine auth, per-operation reads so rotation needs no restart, and compare-and-swap writes.
plugins.description_zh: 凭证 seam 的 HashiCorp Vault 后端：支持 KV v2/v1、AppRole 机器认证、逐次操作读取（轮换无需重启）与 compare-and-swap 写入。

plugins.name: dsh-crew
plugins.author: stuarthu
plugins.description: Runs work as a crew of role agents: a product manager writes the PRD or DoD, waits for your confirmation, then starts architect, engineer, QA and reviewers whose tool sets are locked per role, and shares work through files on disk.
plugins.description_zh: 以角色团队的方式干活：产品经理先写 PRD 或 DoD 并等你确认，再启动架构师、工程师、QA 与各类评审；每个角色的工具集按角色锁定，彼此通过磁盘文件协作。

plugins.name: dsh-cue-bank
plugins.author: itr-del
plugins.description: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（关键词或向量匹配）。

plugins.name: dsh-custom-ui
plugins.author: nailing10086-zx
plugins.description: Right-side file-tree sidebar that opens workspace files, plus a DeepSeek account balance meter in the composer stats line.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧文件树侧栏，可打开工作区文件；并在输入框状态行显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

plugins.name: dsh-daemon
plugins.author: chenkai2
plugins.description: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).
plugins.description_zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-quota-left
plugins.author: dk33333333
plugins.description: DeepSeek API quota panel collapsed into a left-edge handle for the Web UI: click to expand balance, official today's consumption (with platform token) and live conversation cost; fork of dsh-deepseek-quota.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek API 额度面板折叠为左侧边框把手：点击展开查看余额、官方精确今日已消费（配置平台 token 后）与实时对话费用；dsh-deepseek-quota 的修改版。

plugins.name: dsh-defend
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak detection: an Aho-Corasick engine interposes allow/ask/block at three seams — user messages, tool arguments, and tool results.
plugins.description_zh: 提示注入/越狱/密钥泄露检测：Aho-Corasick 引擎在用户消息、工具参数、工具结果三道缝上 allow/ask/block 拦截。

plugins.name: dsh-design
plugins.author: Viger1
plugins.description: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
plugins.description_zh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop
plugins.author: s3yf1337
plugins.description: Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 桌面配置：原生 Tauri 窗口承载 harness Web 界面，支持托盘、原生通知、文件管理器面板与一键更新。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop#bundle
plugins.author: s3yf1337
plugins.description: Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 桌面配置：原生 Tauri 窗口承载 harness Web 界面，支持托盘、原生通知、文件管理器面板与一键更新。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop#plugin
plugins.author: ReachGa0
plugins.description: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 插件（dsh-desktop-launcher）：在对话中一键启动 dsh-desktop Windows Electron 桌面壳——双击即用、无需终端；支持选区截图提问（GPU 实时框选、自动粘贴到聊天框、配合识图插件 AI 直接看图回答）、系统托盘、会话管理、环境自动引导、可换端口、单实例锁。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop#plugin
plugins.author: ReachGa0
plugins.description: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 插件（dsh-desktop-launcher）：在对话中一键启动 dsh-desktop Windows Electron 桌面壳——双击即用、无需终端；支持选区截图提问（GPU 实时框选、自动粘贴到聊天框、配合识图插件 AI 直接看图回答）、系统托盘、会话管理、环境自动引导、可换端口、单实例锁。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-app
plugins.author: happpsee
plugins.description: Skill for packaging DeepSeek Harness into a Tauri 2 desktop app (macOS + Windows): dual-platform install playbook, China mirror bootstrap with a subagent timeout sentinel, admin-free Windows toolchain recipe (no VS Build Tools), and three-path acceptance checklists.
plugins.description_zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows）的技能包：双平台安装、国内镜像加速（含 subagent 超时哨兵）、无管理员 Windows 工具链方案、三路径验收清单。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-lifecycle
plugins.author: luumod
plugins.description: Close and restart controls for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web on Windows, in Settings → General.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Windows 上为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 与 Web 提供「关闭程序」和「重启程序」控制，位于「设置 → 通用设置」。

plugins.name: dsh-dingo
plugins.author: february2015
plugins.description: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.
plugins.description_zh: 多对话并行的声音提醒 + 对话直达：当前对话当/当当（crisp 清脆档），其他对话叮/叮叮（soft 柔和档）+ 右上角小卡片，点一下直达对应对话。

plugins.name: dsh-dingtalk-channel
plugins.author: ttmouse
plugins.description: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.
plugins.description_zh: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

plugins.name: dsh-diorama
plugins.author: ZaVang
plugins.description: Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled).
plugins.description_zh: 角色皮肤舞台：雪乃·暖阳日常与隐秘年代志双主题，各带双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可视化装饰看板支持拖动/缩放/旋转/坐标精调/锚定切换/上传素材，装饰包（素材+布局）可导出分享、导入后自动打开看板继续调整。

plugins.name: dsh-dracula-theme
plugins.author: ossFrankFrank
plugins.description: Dracula theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: the classic dark palette and the Soft variant registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的德古拉主题插件：经典暗色配色与 Soft 变体接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择。

plugins.name: dsh-draw
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Unified static-image generation routing: one image_generate tool over OpenAI-compatible engines (OpenAI Images, Zhipu CogView, etc.) with health-aware fallback and per-session quotas.
plugins.description_zh: 统一静态图像生成路由：一个 image_generate 工具接 OpenAI 兼容引擎（OpenAI Images、智谱 CogView 等），健康感知回退 + 会话配额。

plugins.name: dsh-dual-agent-presets
plugins.author: QlzqQlzq
plugins.description: Installs two selectable Agent Presets: a shell-restricted general-purpose agent and a repository-focused coding agent.
plugins.description_zh: 安装两个可选 Agent Preset：默认不暴露 Shell 的通用 Agent，以及面向真实代码仓库的 Coding Pro。

plugins.name: dsh-dynamic-wallpaper
plugins.author: Willmylife
plugins.description: Animated wallpaper plugin with 8 canvas backgrounds (particles, meteors, starfield, waves, rain, bubbles, matrix, aurora) plus custom video import, and speed/density/opacity/blur sliders with localStorage persistence.
plugins.description_zh: 动态壁纸插件：8 种内置 Canvas 壁纸（粒子、流星雨、星际穿梭、波光、雨幕、气泡、字符雨、极光）加自定义视频背景，支持速度/密度/遮罩/模糊调节，配置持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-easyvision
plugins.author: s3yf1337
plugins.description: Give text-only models vision: a describe_image tool that delegates images to a vision model from your dsh model list over the harness's own LLM runtime.
plugins.description_zh: 让纯文本模型拥有视觉：describe_image 工具调用 dsh 模型列表中的视觉模型描述图片，走 harness 自身的 LLM 运行时。

plugins.name: dsh-effect-doctor
plugins.author: chouyong
plugins.description: Verifies that Cordis-managed runtime resources return to baseline after isolated plugin teardown, with deterministic cleanup receipts.
plugins.description_zh: 隔离插件卸载后验证 Cordis 管理的运行时资源是否回到基线，并生成确定性清理回执。

plugins.name: dsh-email-push-master
plugins.author: JamesYasR
plugins.description: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you are away, with stable SMTP (no 535 retry loop), connect and idle timeouts, and a --check self-test.
plugins.description_zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：稳定 SMTP（不重试 535）、连接与空闲超时，并带 --check 自检。

plugins.name: dsh-evolution-lab
plugins.author: JayDong9130
plugins.description: Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.
plugins.description_zh: 带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-fast
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Read-only performance diagnostics: session load time, spill hits, compaction stats, context injection volume, and LLM cache hit rate via /fast and fast_report.
plugins.description_zh: 只读性能诊断：会话加载耗时、spill 命中、压缩统计、上下文注入量、LLM 缓存命中率，/fast + fast_report。

plugins.name: dsh-feed
plugins.description: Cross-ecosystem aggregation data layer: syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic and the npm registry into one open JSON index, queried by model tools, a CLI, and a minimal stdio MCP server.
plugins.description_zh: 跨生态聚合数据层（"聚合的聚合"）：把 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题与 npm registry 归一化为开放 JSON 索引，供模型工具、CLI 与轻量 stdio MCP 服务查询。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu-chat
plugins.author: Qing45
plugins.description: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu-chat
plugins.author: Qing45
plugins.description: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu-notify
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Feishu notifications on session end / input needed.
plugins.description_zh: 飞书通知（会话结束/等待输入）。

plugins.name: dsh-file-memory
plugins.author: ICCuse
plugins.description: File-backed working memory: memorize/recall key premises verbatim in a session notes file so they survive context compaction losslessly.
plugins.description_zh: 文件型工作记忆：memorize/recall 把关键前提逐字保存在会话笔记文件，无损挺过上下文压缩。

plugins.name: dsh-file-mention
plugins.author: sunshaobei
plugins.description: Codex-style @file/@folder mentions for the DSH web composer: workspace file/folder picker menu, plain-text colored mention tokens via the platform lexicon scan, and a nested-git-aware file index.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 式 @文件/@文件夹提及插件：输入框弹出工作区文件与文件夹选择菜单，通过平台词法扫描插入纯文本着色提及 token，内置嵌套 git 感知的文件索引。

plugins.name: dsh-file-preview#dsh-file-preview
plugins.author: UndeadSheep
plugins.description: Floating workspace file-preview window for the Web client: lazy file tree, CodeMirror preview and in-window edit with save, Markdown and image preview, Quick Open search, and opening paths clicked in the conversation.
plugins.description_zh: Web 客户端悬浮文件预览窗：懒加载文件树、CodeMirror 预览与窗内编辑保存、Markdown 与图片预览、Quick Open 搜索，以及点击会话中的路径直接打开。

plugins.name: dsh-filetree
plugins.author: lak321
plugins.description: Project file browser: per-session file tabs, a directory tree, and a VSCode-style editor (C syntax highlighting, line numbers, auto-indent, status bar) that follows the current workspace.
plugins.description_zh: 工程文件浏览器：会话视图文件页签，目录树 + VSCode 风格编辑器（C 语法高亮/行号/自动缩进/状态栏），跟随当前工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-fish-tts
plugins.author: MaRi23333
plugins.description: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.
plugins.description_zh: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

plugins.name: dsh-flomo
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
plugins.description_zh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

plugins.name: dsh-flomo
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
plugins.description_zh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

plugins.name: dsh-Fonts
plugins.author: zhijun-dai
plugins.description: Font system plugin: OFL webfont presets served offline from the plugin, user-imported custom woff2 fonts, and a ctx.fonts registry other plugins can extend.
plugins.description_zh: 字体系统插件：随插件离线分发的 OFL 开源字体预设、自定义 woff2 字体导入，以及供其他插件扩展的 ctx.fonts 注册表。

plugins.name: dsh-fork-graph
plugins.author: chouyong
plugins.description: Git-style conversation fork graph in the session header: colored lanes and fork curves show which session branched from which, with click-to-jump navigation.
plugins.description_zh: 会话标题栏内联的 Git 风格 fork 血缘图：用彩色轨道与分叉曲线显示会话从何处分支，并可点击跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-funnel
plugins.author: YuanyuanMa03
plugins.description: Ingestion-time tool-output curation: keeps error and warning lines plus head and tail, spills the full text to disk with a pointer the model can read back; covers every text tool, small results pass through untouched.
plugins.description_zh: 摄入时点的工具输出治理：保留 error/warning 行与头尾，全文落盘留指针供模型按需读回；覆盖所有返回文本的工具，小结果原样通过。

plugins.name: dsh-git-nexus
plugins.author: JFWaskin
plugins.description: Git and GitHub panel for the DSH web profile: stage/unstage/discard/diff, branches, commit, push/pull/sync, log, file browser, workflow board, and GitHub OAuth with PR creation.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 的 Git 与 GitHub 面板：暂存/撤销/丢弃/差异、分支、提交、推送/拉取/同步、日志、文件浏览、工作流看板，以及带 PR 创建的 GitHub OAuth。

plugins.name: dsh-git-proxy
plugins.author: wjt0321
plugins.description: On-demand GitHub proxy for the Web UI: one-click git/SSH proxy toggle with connectivity tests.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 按需 GitHub 代理：一键开关 git/SSH 代理并测试连通性。

plugins.name: dsh-github-picker
plugins.author: bitxeno
plugins.description: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

plugins.name: dsh-gov
plugins.description: Agent governance suite: policy-based tool gating (allow/deny/ask with wildcards and priorities), a structured JSONL audit trail, and per-agent token quotas against the host token meter, with state under $DSH_HOME/gov.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 治理套件：基于策略的工具门禁（allow/deny/ask，支持通配符与优先级）、结构化 JSONL 审计日志、基于宿主 token 计量的按 agent 配额，状态存于 $DSH_HOME/gov。

plugins.name: dsh-guard
plugins.author: x2802490130-prog
plugins.description: A development safety kit: rolling config snapshots, automatic rollback on plugin failures, boot-failure rescue, and an in-settings management panel.
plugins.description_zh: 开发配套守护：滚动快照、插件失败自动回退、启动失败救援、设置页管理面板。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-zh
plugins.author: zjl1989-li
plugins.description: Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 中文汉化插件：通过 system-prompt/assemble 瀑布钩子在运行时把全部系统提示词、工具描述与运行时上下文翻译成中文（1788 条译文，零源码修改，卸载即还原英文）。

plugins.name: dsh-headroom
plugins.author: giter00
plugins.description: Automatic context compression for DeepSeek Harness: compresses tool outputs before they reach the model and keeps every lossy compression reversible via CCR retrieval tools.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自动上下文压缩插件：在工具输出进入模型前压缩，并通过 CCR 检索工具保持所有有损压缩可逆。

plugins.name: dsh-hot-reload
plugins.author: stuarthu
plugins.description: Reloads an upgraded plugin inside the running dsh process instead of restarting it, and rolls back to the old version when a reload fails.
plugins.description_zh: 插件升级后在运行中的 dsh 内直接重载，无需重启；重载失败时回滚到旧版本并提示手动重启。

plugins.name: dsh-http-tools
plugins.author: lussey820
plugins.description: HTTP/API debugging toolset: full-control HTTP requests (method/headers/body/auth), curl command parsing and one-step execution, in-session request history with side-by-side response comparison, pagination-aware Link headers, and DeepSeek-branded UI cards (optional dsh-http-tools-ui).
plugins.description_zh: HTTP/API 调试工具集：全参数 HTTP 请求（method/headers/body/auth）、curl 命令解析与一步执行、会话内请求历史与响应并排对比、分页 Link 头透出；配合可选 dsh-http-tools-ui 提供 DeepSeek 风格工具卡片。
