plugins.name: dsh-human-task
plugins.author: ywgATustcbbs
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog.
plugins.description_zh: 人工协作工具（`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`）：让 Agent 暂停等待用户完成现实操作或返回观察结果（GUI 操作、游戏测试、视觉验证、硬件检查等），内置会话同意与 AFK 在场两级门控，通过 Web 任务窗返回结构化 JSON 结果。

plugins.name: dsh-human-task#dsh-human-task
plugins.author: ywgATustcbbs
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog.
plugins.description_zh: 人工协作工具（`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`）：让 Agent 暂停等待用户完成现实操作或返回观察结果（GUI 操作、游戏测试、视觉验证、硬件检查等），内置会话同意与 AFK 在场两级门控，通过 Web 任务窗返回结构化 JSON 结果。

plugins.name: dsh-humanized-deepseek-maid
plugins.author: loonai321
plugins.description: Adds a configurable humanized whale-girl maid persona with immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and a lightweight layered memory with query-triggered recall.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 添加可配置的女仆鲸鱼娘人格：沉浸式扮演（称呼/自称/说话方式）、防出戏规则，以及借鉴 ALTM 的轻量分层记忆与按需召回。

plugins.name: dsh-icon-theme
plugins.author: yzke
plugins.description: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。

plugins.name: dsh-idle-deepcompute
plugins.author: cipher2026
plugins.description: Terminal-style AI-lab idle game where you hoard compute, train and upgrade models, publish papers, and prestige from neural nets to ASI.
plugins.description_zh: 终端风 AI 实验室挂机游戏：攒算力、训练升级模型、发论文，一路转生到 AGI/ASI。

plugins.name: dsh-image-search
plugins.author: zimai233
plugins.description: Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.
plugins.description_zh: 多引擎反向识图聚合：Google Lens、百度、Yandex、TinEye、SauceNAO、IQDB、Ascii2d。

plugins.name: dsh-input-history
plugins.author: sunshaobei
plugins.description: Standalone arrow-key input history for the DSH web composer: ↑/↓ recalls sent prompts from one global ring shared across all sessions and workspaces, persisted to localStorage with an overridable cap.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页版输入框独立输入历史插件：↑/↓ 上下键即时召回已发送的提示词，所有会话与工作区共享一个全局历史环，localStorage 持久化、容量可配。

plugins.name: dsh-insight
plugins.description: Plugin insight center: one answer to "哪些值得装" — plugin_guide matches needs to plugins, recipe installs whole environments, plugin_rank scores health (0-100), plugin_audit static-scans a local checkout for security, and plugin_verdict outputs install / caution / research / avoid.
plugins.description_zh: 插件评测中心：一个答案回答"哪些值得装"——plugin_guide 按需求推荐插件、recipe 安装整套环境、plugin_rank 健康评分（0-100）、plugin_audit 静态安全扫描本地目录、plugin_verdict 给出 install / caution / research / avoid 结论。

plugins.name: dsh-interrupt-button
plugins.author: guo-ziao
plugins.description: A green interrupt button beside the send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements, with a customizable interrupt prompt.
plugins.description_zh: 发送按钮旁的绿色打断按钮：运行时一键静默中断 AI，AI 停止后总结进展并向你征求新要求，支持自定义打断提示词。

plugins.name: dsh-jenkins
plugins.author: jsoncode
plugins.description: Manages multiple Jenkins servers and triggers jobs from a Settings page, model tools, or a per-workspace "Run Jenkins Job" entry, with a bilingual host + browser UI.
plugins.description_zh: 管理多台 Jenkins 服务器，支持从设置页、模型工具或工作区级「执行 Jenkins Job」入口触发构建，宿主 + 浏览器双端、界面中英双语。

plugins.name: dsh-jiey-browser
plugins.author: jiewaigongxing
plugins.description: Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Jiey 浏览器：导航、快照、操作、读取、截图与标签页管理，使用真实 Chromium 环境。

plugins.name: dsh-kimicode-swarm
plugins.author: hongyue0721
plugins.description: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
plugins.description_zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

plugins.name: dsh-lan-pass
plugins.author: x2802490130-prog
plugins.description: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

plugins.name: dsh-linked-folders
plugins.author: Sttrevens
plugins.description: Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with a native folder picker.
plugins.description_zh: 多文件夹工作区：全局链接文件夹列表 + 会话内临时挂载（link_folder/unlink_folder），侧边栏管理并支持系统选目录。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-cost
plugins.author: chenyinrusi
plugins.description: Per-turn and session-wide LLM cost metering: a dollar cost line under each message, a session cumulative total with hover breakdown, and an LLM+web price auto-refresh tool.
plugins.description_zh: 按轮次与会话统计 LLM 成本：每条消息下方显示美元成本、会话累计总额（悬停看分项），以及 LLM+联网的价格自动刷新工具。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-cursor
plugins.author: NOirBRight
plugins.description: Unofficial Cursor subscription chat: Host-owned CLI session login, a displayed model catalog, and subscription usage rails. Cursor staff treat this class of private-client usage as against ToS.
plugins.description_zh: 非官方 Cursor 订阅聊天：Host 持有 CLI 会话登录，可编辑展示用模型目录，并显示订阅额度。Cursor 员工认定此类私有客户端用法违反 ToS。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-failover
plugins.author: HB00
plugins.description: Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.
plugins.description_zh: 限流或配额耗尽时自动切换模型提供方：可按提供方配置模型，带冷却机制与永久最终兜底。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-grok
plugins.author: NOirBRight
plugins.description: xAI Grok subscription chat: SuperGrok or X Premium+ OAuth, a displayed model subset, Responses through the Grok CLI proxy, and always-on server-side web_search and x_search.
plugins.description_zh: xAI Grok 订阅聊天：用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium+ 的 OAuth 登录，选择要显示的模型子集，经 Grok CLI 代理走 Responses，并始终开启服务端 web_search 与 x_search。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-local-token
plugins.author: tianxia--
plugins.description: Reuses local Codex CLI and Claude Code OAuth credentials as OpenAI Codex and Anthropic model routes, with subscription usage shown in Web.
plugins.description_zh: 复用本机 Codex CLI 与 Claude Code 的 OAuth 凭据注册 OpenAI Codex 和 Anthropic 模型路由，并在 Web 中显示订阅用量。

plugins.name: dsh-local-share
plugins.author: ChuanTianML
plugins.description: Export complete Web Sessions to local Markdown or self-contained HTML, with stable rendered previews, default redaction, and opt-in bounded tool-call details.
plugins.description_zh: 把完整 Web Session 导出为本地 Markdown 或自包含 HTML，提供稳定的 Markdown 渲染预览、默认脱敏和可选的有界工具调用详情。

plugins.name: dsh-logtimeline
plugins.author: anyuer678
plugins.description: Query local log files with Chinese natural-language time expressions (e.g. "yesterday afternoon", "3 hours ago") — precise time range, matched lines, ERROR/WARN/INFO level stats, fully offline.
plugins.description_zh: 用中文自然语言时间描述查询本地日志（如「昨天下午」「3小时前」）——精确时间范围、匹配行、级别统计，完全离线。

plugins.name: dsh-mask
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: PII redaction middleware: names, phone numbers, ID cards, and bank cards are anonymized to placeholders before reaching the model and restored at the display layer; plaintext is never logged.
plugins.description_zh: PII 脱敏中间件：姓名/电话/身份证/银行卡等在到达模型前匿名化为占位符，展示层还原，绝不记录明文。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-lazy
plugins.author: leaforbook
plugins.description: Loads MCP tools on demand and unloads idle tool schemas at turn end, reducing the tool catalog and context tokens sent to the model while keeping connections warm for fast reuse.
plugins.description_zh: 按需加载 MCP 工具，并在轮次结束时卸载闲置工具 Schema，减少发送给模型的工具目录及上下文 Token；同时保温连接以便快速复用。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-view
plugins.author: stopchewing
plugins.description: MCP servers & tools inventory panel: one-click floating panel from the sidebar that lists every MCP server and tool (transport, endpoint, JSON schema, last-used time), grouped by server, collapsed by default, with live search and refresh; last-used times come from real session logs.
plugins.description_zh: MCP 服务器与工具清单面板：侧边栏一键悬浮面板，按服务器分组展示全部 MCP 工具（传输方式、端点、JSON Schema、最近使用时间），默认折叠、支持搜索与实时刷新；最近使用时间来自真实会话日志。

plugins.name: dsh-memoria-extra
plugins.author: jiayan-xu
plugins.description: Advanced memoria tools: session context injection (profile + recall), recent decisions, health report, namespace allowlist, memory relation graph, and entity search; companion to dsh-memoria.
plugins.description_zh: memoria 进阶工具：会话上下文注入（画像+召回）、近期决策、健康报告、命名空间白名单、记忆关系图与实体搜索；dsh-memoria 的伴生插件。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-director
plugins.author: ljsysfurryACE
plugins.description: LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.
plugins.description_zh: LLM 驱动的记忆记/忘插件：每轮对话后由模型决定记住什么/忘记什么（MemoryDirector），请求前注入相关记忆，自动去重，跨会话持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-protocol
plugins.author: baaai123
plugins.description: Memory protocol enforcement plugin: bridges the opencode-memory MCP server, forces memory_weave before tool calls, auto-ingests turns, and injects memory context into agent steps.
plugins.description_zh: 记忆强制协议插件：桥接 opencode-memory MCP 服务器，工具调用前强制 memory_weave、每轮自动存档、自动注入记忆上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-memoryleak
plugins.author: warmwine
plugins.description: Notes and todos as plain Markdown files in your workspace: type /ml plus a sentence to jot into today's journal; todos come in three flavors — deadline, sleep-until-a-date (auto-wakes when due), and anytime; /ml view fuzzy-opens any file with a few keystrokes. Zero tokens throughout — nothing goes through the model, and your notes stay ordinary local files that git and any editor can read.
plugins.description_zh: 把随手记和待办写进工作区的 Markdown 文件里：/ml 加一句话就记进当天日志；待办分三种——截止日、睡到某天自动唤醒、随时；/ml view 打几个字母就能模糊打开任意文件。全程零 token，不经过大模型；笔记就是普通的本地文件，git 和任何编辑器都能直接用。

plugins.name: dsh-minimax-usage
plugins.author: Floating-Dreaming
plugins.description: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile
plugins.author: TecFancy
plugins.description: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 移动端适配插件：侧边栏/详情抽屉浮层化、输入栏与设置页响应式适配，桌面零回归。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-glass
plugins.author: YiRan0
plugins.description: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 移动端适配：窄屏下聊天页在上/侧栏在下的 reveal 抽屉、拖动手势、设置面板底部卡片上滑、composer 与头部修复，桌面端零影响。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-pwa
plugins.author: zylzyqzz
plugins.description: Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-remote
plugins.author: good-boy4069
plugins.description: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion notifications, multi-session switching, and a health panel with file logging.
plugins.description_zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

plugins.name: dsh-modal-enhancer
plugins.author: lisniuse
plugins.description: Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.
plugins.description_zh: 为所有 Web UI 弹窗添加窗口化操作：标题栏拖动、八向缩放、钉住防误触关闭、全屏最大化、移除背景模糊，以及按弹窗持久化的状态。

plugins.name: dsh-model-reasoning
plugins.author: TikaFlow
plugins.description: Automatically fills in reasoning-effort levels for models from unofficial (custom) providers, with data sourced from models.dev.
plugins.description_zh: 为所有非官方（自定义）提供商的模型自动填充推理级别，数据来自 models.dev。

plugins.name: dsh-moonrise
plugins.author: hanyi7867069-create
plugins.description: Moonrise dark theme for the DSH Web UI, with deep indigo surfaces and warm amber accents.
plugins.description_zh: 月升暗色主题——深蓝夜色打底、琥珀月光点缀。

plugins.name: dsh-msgrail
plugins.author: futongxu9-maker
plugins.description: Message-index rail at the conversation's right edge: one brand-colored dot per user message, hover to preview, click to jump, auto-loads older history; pure plugin with no host patching.
plugins.description_zh: 对话右缘消息轨道：每条用户消息一个品牌色圆点，悬停预览、点击跳转、自动加载未加载历史，纯插件零宿主侵入。

plugins.name: dsh-multi-lang-ui
plugins.author: asd13006
plugins.description: Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins.
plugins.description_zh: 為 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 語言選單新增六種語言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français、Deutsch、Español）：各語言逐條精譯，缺字串自動兜底（繁中即時簡轉繁、其他語言回退英文），官方更新與第三方插件都能覆蓋。

plugins.name: dsh-multi-workspace
plugins.author: somnusovis
plugins.description: Multi-workspace sandbox: grants file-write access to every registered workspace automatically — add a workspace, write to it immediately, no config or escalation needed.
plugins.description_zh: 多工作区沙箱：自动赋予所有已注册工作区的文件写入权限——添加工作区后即可直接写入，无需配置或提权。

plugins.name: dsh-music-player
plugins.author: kendu76
plugins.description: Play your own local music in the DSH web UI: the host scans a local folder (default ~/Music) and streams it over HTTP, with a now-playing bar (prev/play/stop, loop modes, volume, live spectrum) and a draggable playlist panel, plus a model-invokable `music_play` tool.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 界面播放本地音乐：Host 扫描本地音乐目录（默认 ~/Music）并以 HTTP 流式播放，提供正在播放条（上一首/播放/停止、循环模式、音量、实时频谱）与可拖动的播放列表面板，并注册 `music_play` 模型工具让 agent 直接播放。

plugins.name: dsh-native-memory
plugins.author: highland0971
plugins.description: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

plugins.name: dsh-need-finder
plugins.description: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.
plugins.description_zh: 需求型插件导购与环境配方：plugin_guide 按自然语言需求语义匹配精选插件并给出理由与安装命令；recipe 一键安装整套社区配方（通知全家桶、安全审计套装等），带有序安装计划。

plugins.name: dsh-no-setup-mode
plugins.author: johnnycls
plugins.description: No-setup mode for the DSH web UI: hides advanced surfaces, auto-applies best defaults (chat mode, full access, account balance), and one-click role-play personas (maid/butler).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页免设置模式：隐藏复杂界面、自动套用最佳设置（聊天模式、Full Access、账户余额），并提供一键人设角色扮演（女僕/管家）。

plugins.name: dsh-notify
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: System-level desktop notifications: turn-completion and workflow-end banners, plus a modal alert when an approval is needed (macOS osascript / Linux notify-send).
plugins.description_zh: 系统级桌面通知：回合完成 / 工作流完成横幅，需要审批时弹出模态提醒（macOS osascript / Linux notify-send）。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-skill
plugins.author: PAKIKNOWLEDGE
plugins.description: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.
plugins.description_zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

plugins.name: dsh-notion-connector
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.
plugins.description_zh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

plugins.name: dsh-nuphus-mcp
plugins.author: jiayan-xu
plugins.description: Desktop and browser automation bridge (36 tools): window/screen/mouse/keyboard control with PaddleOCR element perception, Chrome CDP browsing with accessibility snapshots.
plugins.description_zh: 桌面 + 浏览器自动化桥（36 个工具）：窗口/屏幕/鼠标/键盘控制配 PaddleOCR 元素感知，Chrome CDP 浏览配无障碍快照。

plugins.name: dsh-observe
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: OpenTelemetry and Langfuse observability export: turn/step/tool/LLM spans plus token and cost metrics, with sanitized collection and offline buffering with retry.
plugins.description_zh: OpenTelemetry 与 Langfuse 可观测性导出：turn/step/tool/LLM span 与 token/成本指标，脱敏采集 + 离线缓冲重试。

plugins.name: dsh-obsidian
plugins.author: mingzeng21
plugins.description: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through `obsidian_*` tools.
plugins.description_zh: 把 dsh 连接到本地 Obsidian vault：通过 `obsidian_*` 工具搜索、读取、写入、移动与回收笔记。

plugins.name: dsh-obvious-grid
plugins.author: ray062
plugins.description: Ambient fullscreen status grid for DeepSeek Harness sessions with token/rate graphs, plus ntfy push and alarm notifications when a turn ends, errors, or waits for approval.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏状态看板：会话状态网格与 token/速率图表一览无余，回合结束、出错或等待审批时通过 ntfy 推送与铃声提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-ocr-review
plugins.author: jiayan-xu
plugins.description: Local AI code-review gate: review a workspace/branch/commit diff via the managed ocr.js, returning structured findings with token stats; gate mode fails on findings.
plugins.description_zh: 本地 AI 代码评审门禁：对工作区/分支/commit diff 跑评审（托管 ocr.js），返回结构化 findings 与 token 统计；门禁模式发现问题即失败。

plugins.name: dsh-odette-skin
plugins.author: lkdx0220
plugins.description: A Genshin Impact "Odette" themed DSH UI skin: dark/light dual-mode background images, frosted-glass overrides for 13 theme tokens, and a chibi mascot sidebar toggle; install via npm.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 原神「奥黛塔」主题 UI 皮肤：深/浅双模式背景图 + 13 个主题 token 毛玻璃覆盖 + 侧栏 Q 版小兽皮肤开关，npm 即装即用。

plugins.name: dsh-omi-voice
plugins.author: PolinniZhong
plugins.description: In-conversation read-aloud with Doubao-quality voices: every AI reply gets a 🔊 tap-to-read / auto-read toggle (off by default, state persisted), with voices synthesized by the local Omi engine (Doubao seed-tts); BYOK — keys stay in your local Keychain, the plugin stores none.
plugins.description_zh: 豆包音质对话内朗读：每条 AI 回复 🔊 点读/自动朗读（默认关、状态持久化），音色由本地 Omi 引擎合成（豆包 seed-tts），BYOK（Key 只留在本机 Keychain，插件零 Key）。

plugins.name: dsh-omicos
plugins.author: omicverse
plugins.description: Runs OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in a persistent Python kernel, with capability-catalog search, kernel inspection and an account tab.
plugins.description_zh: 在持久 Python 内核里跑 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生信分析，附能力目录检索、内核变量查看与账号订阅页签。

plugins.name: dsh-open-with
plugins.author: ChuanTianML
plugins.description: Open registered workspaces from the Web UI in a detected or configured local editor, terminal, or file manager, with a remembered per-browser preference.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web UI 使用检测到或配置的本机编辑器、终端或文件管理器打开已登记 Workspace，并在浏览器中记住首选项。

plugins.name: dsh-open-with
plugins.author: ChuanTianML
plugins.description: Open registered workspaces from the Web UI in a detected or configured local editor, terminal, or file manager, with a remembered per-browser preference.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web UI 使用检测到或配置的本机编辑器、终端或文件管理器打开已登记 Workspace，并在浏览器中记住首选项。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-quota
plugins.author: zer0zio-stack
plugins.description: Bottom-right 余额 badge for the DSH Web UI: on expand it fetches the currently-selected provider's OpenCode Go plan limits or DeepSeek prepaid balance, plus local token usage and pricing-based spend estimates.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 右下角「余额」徽标：展开时读取当前所选提供方，显示 OpenCode Go 计划限额或 DeepSeek 预充值余额，并附本机 token 用量与按定价表估算的消费金额。

plugins.name: dsh-orcana#dsh-bundle
plugins.author: Leo-Ayh-Oday
plugins.description: Runtime governor for DeepSeek Harness: zero-progress steering, generation-bound verification evidence, evidence-aware completion guarding, and task-profile tool restriction.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 运行时治理器：零进展回合引导、按代际绑定的验证证据、基于证据的完成守卫，以及按任务配置限制工具集。

plugins.name: dsh-peak-cost-mode
plugins.author: moon09300731
plugins.description: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-peak-indicator
plugins.author: future007s
plugins.description: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
plugins.description_zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

plugins.name: dsh-period-report
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
plugins.description_zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

plugins.name: dsh-period-report
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
plugins.description_zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

plugins.name: dsh-permissions
plugins.description: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.
plugins.description_zh: Claude Code 风格权限规则引擎：hard/deny/ask/allow 四级规则（hard 高于全访问、不可豁免）、workspace 作用域、通配符路径保护、可视化草稿式编辑器，规则持久化于 settings.yaml。

plugins.name: dsh-pet-evolve
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: The pet that grows with your agent: 5 evolution stages earned from real signals (verified rules, completed sessions, tool calls, compactions), agent-state mirroring, and one-click growth share cards. Zero dependencies, 100% local.
plugins.description_zh: 会随 agent 成长的宠物：真实信号（已验证规则/会话/工具调用/压缩）驱动 5 阶段进化、镜像 agent 状态、一键导出成长分享卡。零依赖、全本地。

plugins.name: dsh-pilot
plugins.author: Viger1
plugins.description: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.
plugins.description_zh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

plugins.name: dsh-pixel-studio#dsh-cli-anything-aseprite
plugins.author: KongChengZhi
plugins.description: Aseprite-style pixel art studio: the AI draws sprites stroke by stroke with selections, layers, animation frames, gradients, symmetry and reference layers, each step rendered live as ANSI terminal frames.
plugins.description_zh: Aseprite 风格像素画工作室：AI 像人类一样分步绘制精灵，支持选区、图层、动画帧、渐变、对称、参考层与 rgb16 4096 色，每一步实时渲染为 ANSI 终端帧。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin
plugins.author: plur-ai
plugins.description: PLUR memory rendered into the system prompt on each assembly rather than exposed as a tool call, so the block is replaced instead of appended and context stays flat across a session. Fully local hybrid search (BM25 + BGE fused with RRF), plain YAML storage you can edit, per-workspace scoping, and a /plur-memory browser.
plugins.description_zh: PLUR 记忆在每次组装时渲染进系统提示词，而非以工具调用形式暴露，因此记忆块是被替换而不是追加，整段会话的上下文长度保持不变。全本地混合检索（BM25 + BGE，RRF 融合）、可直接编辑的纯 YAML 存储、按工作区划分 scope，并提供 /plur-memory 浏览器界面。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-academic-writing
plugins.description: Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-aflare
plugins.author: alib8b8
plugins.description: Workflow tools for the local aflare binary: generate, validate and run local-first deterministic YAML workflow DAGs (WAL crash recovery, Saga compensation) through the local aflare binary, with 300+ templates built in.
plugins.description_zh: aflare 工作流工具：通过本地 aflare 二进制生成、校验并执行本地优先的确定性 YAML 工作流 DAG（WAL 崩溃恢复、Saga 补偿），内置 300+ 模板。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-appshot
plugins.author: TaurusWood
plugins.description: Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-asmemory
plugins.author: Xplore-LAB
plugins.description: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.
plugins.description_zh: 动作-状态时序记忆：记录类型化的状态与动作，做趋势、异常与因果关联分析。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-autoevo
plugins.author: klarkxy
plugins.description: Reuse-first capability evolution for agents: resolve existing tools and skills, discover and review exact-commit DSH plugins, install with one-time approval, verify real tool round trips, and minimally adapt partial matches instead of rebuilding from scratch.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 Agent 的“复用优先”能力演进层：先解析已有工具与 Skills，再发现并审查锁定 commit 的 DSH 插件，经一次性批准安装并验证真实工具往返；部分匹配则最小改进，而非从零重造。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-call-trace
plugins.author: Huang-zhishi
plugins.description: Persistent model tool-call trace recorder: every tool call is durably written to a JSONL file that survives restarts, queryable via a structured call_trace tool and a callTraceHistory service, with size rotation and an optional floating canvas UI add-on.
plugins.description_zh: 持久化模型工具调用轨迹记录器：每次工具调用落盘为 JSONL（重启不丢），提供结构化 call_trace 查询工具与 callTraceHistory 服务，支持文件大小轮转，附可选浮层画布 UI。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-collapsible-steps
plugins.author: mervyn-teo
plugins.description: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.
plugins.description_zh: 把消息之间连续的工具调用与思考步骤折叠成单个可展开的括号条目。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-console
plugins.author: AlexYin-Tongji
plugins.description: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置一级页面中浏览和管理社区插件目录，支持验证后安装与更新、删除、暂停与恢复、已安装状态查看及安全 README 预览。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-deepseek-balance
plugins.author: fishxcode
plugins.description: DeepSeek API balance, balance trend, and daily usage charts in DSH Web settings.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中展示 DeepSeek API 余额、余额趋势与每日用量图表。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-education
plugins.description: Education toolkit for DSH agents: lesson-plan skeletons by grade band, quiz scaffolding and answer-key validation, analytic rubrics, Anki/markdown flashcards, and readability levels.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供教育工具包：按学段的教案骨架、测验题与答案校验、分析式评分量规、Anki/markdown 闪卡与可读性分级。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-focus
plugins.description: Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供持久化专注板：在会话工作区维护目标、约束与决策笔记，跨压缩与会话存活，支持自动注入上下文、清空归档与可选 Web 面板。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-gate
plugins.description: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件的安装安全闸门：在 "dsh plugin add" 前对本地目录或 npm 包做"杀毒"式扫描（安装脚本、权限、密钥、网络回连），给出 BLOCK/WARN/PASS 判定。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hooks
plugins.author: truelove-dreamer
plugins.description: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
plugins.description_zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-image-input
plugins.author: Elohia
plugins.description: Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).
plugins.description_zh: 图片转文字输入插件：粘贴/拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述发送，给纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-judge
plugins.author: pengxuding
plugins.description: Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.
plugins.description_zh: 插件价值裁判：装前审核（源码静态扫描 + LLM 裁判）与装后审计已装插件，模型切换时弹窗提醒复核；判断插件对当前模型是增强还是压制。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-local-life
plugins.description: Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip checklists.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供本地生活工具包：预算规划、账单分摊、单价与折扣计算、常用单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏、升/加仑）与出行清单。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-nexterm
plugins.author: Samge0
plugins.description: Nexterm fleet maintenance in a DSH session: 6 agent tools (auth with password/TOTP/device-code login, fleet listing, single-host exec, parallel batch exec, preset health checks, CPU/memory/disk monitoring) over the Nexterm REST API, plus a minimal settings page; no SSH private keys needed on the DSH machine.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 会话中运维 Nexterm 托管的 SSH 机群：6 个 agent 工具（密码/TOTP/设备授权码登录认证、机群清单、单机执行、批量并行执行、预设健康检查、CPU/内存/磁盘监控），全走 Nexterm REST API，附极简设置页；DSH 机器上无需任何 SSH 私钥。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-recall
plugins.author: truelove-dreamer
plugins.description: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-recommend
plugins.description: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-remote
plugins.author: siberiah2o
plugins.description: Remote access gateway for the DSH Web GUI: login auth plus an HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy to the loopback server, no --trusted-host needed.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 远程访问网关：登录鉴权 + 到本机服务的 HTTP/WebSocket 反向代理，无需 --trusted-host。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-scout
plugins.author: icefall7
plugins.description: Scouts the deepseek-harness repo and every dsh-plugin-tagged repository to discover harnesses related to your goal, then judges each as worth trying, watching, or skipping.
plugins.description_zh: 侦察 deepseek-harness 官方仓库与所有 dsh-plugin topic 仓库，发现与目标相关的 harness，并判断每个值得试用、观望还是跳过。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-search
plugins.author: shinjiyu
plugins.description: Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.
plugins.description_zh: 不用官方 DeepSeek API 也能用内置 web_search：关掉 web-search-deepseek，默认走 Tavily keyless。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-sentinel
plugins.author: BotonJ
plugins.description: Static pre-install security auditor for plugin bundles: lifecycle scripts, dynamic execution, credential-exfiltration combos, and patch-layer hazards, with zero dependencies and in-memory tar parsing.
plugins.description_zh: 插件安装前静态安全审计：生命周期脚本、动态执行、凭据外传组合特征与 patch 层风险；零依赖，tar 包全程内存解析不落盘。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-sodamem
plugins.author: SodaMem
plugins.description: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-task-panel
plugins.author: xiaogu619520
plugins.description: Task & Context Summary Floating Panel (todo tracking, file/system token breakdown, 8-way resize, shortcut).
plugins.description_zh: 任务摘要与上下文用量监控浮动面板（待办事项跟踪、文件与系统 Token 占用统计、8向缩放与快捷键）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-translation
plugins.description: Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-verify
plugins.description: Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 核验工具箱：在工作区文件中核查声明并返回带行号引用的证据，校验配置文件（JSON/YAML），以及只读的 URL / npm / GitHub 提交就绪度探测。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-weaknet-adaptor
plugins.author: jiay98528-dev
plugins.description: Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 弱网适配器：模型流式请求的长退避透明重试（上限 10 分钟）、本地响应重放缓存、心跳自动重连、降级模式 token 节流，并提供中英双语设置页。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-approve-for-me
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Automated approval review: auto-approve read-only tools, auto-deny dangerous commands, fail-closed policy engine.
plugins.description_zh: 自动化审批审核：只读工具自动放行、危险命令自动拒绝，策略引擎 fail-closed。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-client-v2
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Enhanced MCP client: paginated tool discovery, non-blocking startup, mcp_tool_search, hand-rolled stdio/streamable-http transports.
plugins.description_zh: MCP 客户端增强：分页工具发现、非阻塞启动、mcp_tool_search 搜索，自研 stdio/streamable-http 传输。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-memories
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Project-scoped persistent key-value memories with set/get/list/delete/search model tools and JSON-file storage.
plugins.description_zh: 项目作用域持久化键值记忆：set/get/list/delete/search 模型工具，JSON 文件存储。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-secret-redactor
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Automatic secret redaction in tool results: masks API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and configured secrets before the model sees them.
plugins.description_zh: 工具结果敏感信息自动脱敏：模型看到前掩码 API key / token / JWT / 私钥与配置密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-system-proxy
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: System proxy detection (scutil/env/PAC) with a status tool and a proxy_export bash snippet tool.
plugins.description_zh: 系统代理检测（scutil/env/PAC）：状态工具 + proxy_export 导出 bash 代理片段。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-usage-cost
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Token usage and cost tracking with daily/session budget alerts and a usage_report tool.
plugins.description_zh: Token 用量与成本统计：日/会话预算告警 + usage_report 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-postman
plugins.author: zhousun55-byte
plugins.description: Upload files and folders straight into the conversation — images attach as real message blocks, text content is written into the composer draft, folders land by directory structure.
plugins.description_zh: 把文件与文件夹直接传进对话——图片以真实图片块加入消息，文本内容写入输入框草稿，文件夹按目录结构落盘。

plugins.name: dsh-premise-guard
plugins.author: ICCuse
plugins.description: Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.
plugins.description_zh: 压缩后前提漂移守卫：摘要丢失关键字面锚点时注入一次性提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-premium-themes
plugins.author: xiaoyanzi191
plugins.description: 8 curated color schemes plus custom palette import (name + scheme + seed colors derive a full token map), a Palette row in General settings, hot-plug install.
plugins.description_zh: 8 套精选配色方案与自定义调色板导入（名称+方案+种子色推导完整 token 映射），设置页「调色板」行，热插拔安装。

plugins.name: dsh-preset-anchored-standard
plugins.author: ruby1304
plugins.description: Minimal-anchored agent preset: request #1 keeps the real bash + str_replace_editor pair with auto-injected context stripped, then promotion unlocks the full Standard catalog and posts a one-shot background-jobs notice against sleep-polling habits.
plugins.description_zh: Minimal 锚定的 agent preset：request #1 仅保留真实 bash + str_replace_editor 工具对并剥离自动注入上下文，晋升后开放完整 Standard 工具目录，并注入一次性后台 job 提示纠正 sleep 前台轮询惯性。

plugins.name: dsh-preset-scaffold
plugins.author: duyanta123
plugins.description: DSH project scaffold preset: strict 5-phase init runbook, engineering standards and six runnable starter templates (node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 项目初始化脚手架预设：严格 5 阶段初始化流程 + 工程规范 + 六套可运行模板（node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo）。

plugins.name: dsh-preview
plugins.author: Viger1
plugins.description: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.
plugins.description_zh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。

plugins.name: dsh-project
plugins.author: lanyun077
plugins.description: Organize folders and sessions into projects with shared PROJECT.md memory and AGENTS.md instructions injected into every session, plus a project tree sidebar.
plugins.description_zh: 把多个文件夹与会话收纳为「项目」，共享 PROJECT.md 记忆与 AGENTS.md 指令并注入每个会话，附带项目树侧边栏。

plugins.name: dsh-project-manager
plugins.author: br1nosense
plugins.description: Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 界面以悬浮窗口管理开发项目：添加/删除、一键启动/停止/重启、文件变更热重载自动重启、实时日志查看与持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-projection-guard
plugins.author: DamonKoy
plugins.description: Guards the persisted session-projection cache: per-row JSON degradation so one misbehaving projection unit (e.g. a third-party plugin storing a Map) can never stall session titles or the whole cache again, plus a startup self-heal that backfills missing titles.
plugins.description_zh: 会话投影缓存守卫：逐行 JSON 降级，单个违规投影单元（如第三方插件存储 Map）不再拖垮会话标题与整个缓存；启动自愈自动补全缺失标题。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
plugins.author: SongMiao-tech
plugins.description: Optimize Prompt button under the composer: one click rewrites your draft into a clearer, more executable prompt, with a before-and-after dialog and one-click replacement.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方「优化提示词」按钮：一键把草稿重写为更清晰、更可执行的提示词，弹出前后对比，支持一键替换回输入框。

plugins.name: dsh-pubmed
plugins.author: wade20250715
plugins.description: PubMed deep-research toolset: literature search, author investigation, same-name disambiguation, institution statistics and mentor-student matching.
plugins.description_zh: PubMed 深度科研工具集：文献检索、作者调查、同名消歧、机构统计与师承匹配。

plugins.name: dsh-quick-toc
plugins.author: LyaxZ
plugins.description: Conversation TOC for DeepSeek Harness: markdown heading outline grouped by turn, with auto-follow highlight and smooth jump navigation.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲插件：按回合分组的 Markdown 标题目录，自动跟随高亮，平滑跳转导航。

plugins.name: dsh-quicksight
plugins.author: Isanti2016
plugins.description: Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
plugins.description_zh: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

plugins.name: dsh-recipe
plugins.description: Scenario bundles of dsh plugins (插件界的 dotfiles): a recipe tool that lists, searches, applies and composes ready-made plugin environments with ordered install sequences.
plugins.description_zh: 把 dsh 插件打包成场景配方（"插件界的 dotfiles"）：recipe 工具可列出、搜索、应用并组合现成插件环境，带有序安装序列。

plugins.name: dsh-review
plugins.author: Viger1
plugins.description: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
plugins.description_zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

plugins.name: dsh-risk-guard
plugins.author: shuxue6662-a11y
plugins.description: Zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking for DeepSeek Harness: silently records every tool call with deterministic risk scoring, cumulative-risk bonuses, risk-level breakdowns and retention-based cleanup; blocks irreversible catastrophes (protected-path deletion, disk wipe, force-push to protected branches/refs, credential exfiltration), and renders a redacted /risk-guard operation bill with --since filtering.
plugins.description_zh: 零打扰审计与保险丝拦截：静默记录每次工具调用并做纯规则风险评分（含累积加分、风险等级分布、归档保留期清理），只拦不可逆灾难（受保护路径删除、磁盘擦除、force push 到受保护分支/引用、凭据外发），/risk-guard 输出脱敏操作账单并支持 --since 时间过滤。

plugins.name: dsh-rolehub-bridge
plugins.author: ishuowang
plugins.description: Discover and verify portable RoleHub roles, pin each exact bundle, then launch its prompt and bundled skills in an isolated, continuable DSH Session with Host-approved tool bindings and optional Agent Team Room attachment.
plugins.description_zh: 发现并校验可移植的 RoleHub 角色，固定其精确 bundle，再将提示词和随角色打包的 Skills 加载到独立、可续聊的 DSH Session，以 Host 批准的工具绑定限制能力，并可选接入 Agent Team Room。

plugins.name: dsh-roleplay
plugins.author: chinosk6
plugins.description: Role-play conversations with character cards, in-chat character-card authoring and editing, and image generation through configurable backends.
plugins.description_zh: 角色扮演插件：支持角色卡对话、在对话中创作与编辑角色卡，可接入生图后端生成插图。

plugins.name: dsh-rollback
plugins.author: Taler97
plugins.description: Observational file-mutation rollback for the fs tools: write/edit pre-images are checkpointed as git blobs or snapshots and restored through a model-facing rollback_files tool or a /rollback command.
plugins.description_zh: 文件变更回滚：捕获 write/edit 工具调用的改前映像（git blob 或快照），通过面向模型的 rollback_files 工具或 /rollback 命令还原。

plugins.name: dsh-rule-evolve
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Verification-driven self-evolution loop: failure logs become verified AGENTS.md rules; in-session plugin (evolve_learn / evolve_apply / evolve_touch / evolve_recall), tool-verify gate, rule lifecycle, local recall.
plugins.description_zh: 验证驱动的自我进化循环：失败日志自动变成经过验证的 AGENTS.md 规则；会话内插件（evolve_learn/evolve_apply/evolve_touch/evolve_recall）、工具体检、规则生命周期、本地召回。

plugins.name: dsh-rule-manager
plugins.author: wzz3034026545
plugins.description: Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置面板统一管理 DSH 规则：编辑全局/项目 AGENTS.md，或由 LLM 自动拆分粘贴的规则为分层 AGENTS.md 与技能。

plugins.name: dsh-score
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Multi-dimensional plugin quality scoring across five axes (install success, maintenance, docs, security, protocol compliance) with real CLI evidence, audit timestamps, and JSON/Markdown leaderboards.
plugins.description_zh: 插件多维质量评分：安装成功/维护/文档/安全/协议合规五维，真实 CLI 证据 + 审计时间戳，产出 JSON/Markdown 榜单。

plugins.name: dsh-screen-agent
plugins.author: lak321
plugins.description: Desktop and web automation: 📸 multi-screen screenshots, 🔍 Windows OCR (text + pixel coordinates), 🖱️ mouse click/drag, ⌨️ Chinese typing/keys, and 🪟 window activation, with battle-tested drawing in Paint (mouse acceleration compensation, canvas positioning, Bézier curves).
plugins.description_zh: 桌面与网页自动化：📸 多屏截图 + 🔍 Windows OCR（文字+像素坐标）+ 🖱️ 鼠标点击/拖拽 + ⌨️ 中文打字/按键 + 🪟 窗口激活，含实战打磨的画图能力（鼠标加速度补偿、画布定位、贝塞尔曲线，可在画图中绘制图形）。

plugins.name: dsh-search-failover
plugins.author: Walvez
plugins.description: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.
plugins.description_zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

plugins.name: dsh-searxng
plugins.author: rogerdigital
plugins.description: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 SearXNG 的 web_search provider：通过自建实例的 JSON API 实现免费、免密钥的元搜索，附仅绑定回环地址的 docker-compose 示例。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cost
plugins.author: Lzh3070
plugins.description: Composer cost chip: prices the current session DeepSeek API spend message-by-message with the official pricing table (incl. the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak policy); hover for the breakdown, today (DSH) total and account balance. DeepSeek models only.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cost
plugins.author: KIDLi1412
plugins.description: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official balance API.
plugins.description_zh: 对话底部的会话费用状态栏：按模型逐条计价估算 Token 费用（CNY），并实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（官方余额接口）。

plugins.name: dsh-session-manager
plugins.author: wuxiangru915
plugins.description: Session manager for the DSH Web UI: browse all and archived sessions, restore/unarchive, delete with two-step confirmation, and preview conversation content from the Settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 会话管理插件：在设置页查看全部与已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）、二次确认删除与对话内容预览。

plugins.name: dsh-session-move
plugins.author: reinocheong
plugins.description: Move a session to another folder from the Web UI via drag & drop or a menu picker, permanently delete a session with a risk-consent dialog, and AI-rename a session by summarizing the whole conversation (typo-aware). Each action also ships as an agent tool.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web 侧边栏把会话移动到别的文件夹（拖拽或菜单选择），带风险确认地永久删除会话，以及 AI 重命名会话（总结整个对话并自动纠正错别字）；每个操作都提供 agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-session-nav
plugins.author: tuogusa
plugins.description: A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps.
plugins.description_zh: 对话旁的悬浮按钮，打开当前会话全部提问的可搜索列表并快速跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-session-review
plugins.author: sunshaobei
plugins.description: A strip above the composer listing files modified in the current session (collapsed by default), with a Review button opening a per-session change panel showing before/after hunks from the session's own edit/write tool results, no git required.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框上方的条带列出当前会话修改过的文件（默认折叠），Review 按钮打开会话变更面板，基于会话自身的 edit/write 工具结果展示前后差异块，无需 git。

plugins.name: dsh-session-unarchive
plugins.author: dylan121322
plugins.description: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web GUI 侧栏查看已归档会话，并一键恢复到原工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-settings-nav-fold
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: Fold plugin/extension settings entries in the DSH settings panel into one collapsible "Plugin entries" group row — one click to expand or collapse, auto-updating as plugins come and go.
plugins.description_zh: 设置面板导航折叠：把插件/扩展的设置入口折叠为一个可展开的「插件入口」分组行，点击展开/收起，随插件增删自动更新。

plugins.name: dsh-shared-memory
plugins.author: futongxu9-maker
plugins.description: Cross-conversation shared memory: MEMORY.md + USER.md injected into every session's system prompt, with a memory tool and a GUI panel (Hermes-style).
plugins.description_zh: 跨对话共享记忆：MEMORY.md + USER.md 注入每个会话系统提示词，memory 工具 + 可视化记忆面板，Hermes 式实现。

plugins.name: dsh-shelf
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Session lifecycle CLI: export (md/json/jsonl), archive/restore, trash, search, and stats. Read-only by default; nothing is ever deleted by the engine.
plugins.description_zh: 会话生命周期 CLI：导出（md/json/jsonl）、归档/恢复、回收站、搜索与统计。默认只读；引擎从不删除任何东西。

plugins.name: dsh-shield
plugins.author: x2802490130-prog
plugins.description: A hands-off safety net: directories the agent deletes go to a trash folder first and symlinks are never followed, with zero approvals.
plugins.description_zh: 脱手模式安全网：agent 删除的目录先进回收站、链接绝不跟随，零审批。

plugins.name: dsh-shop-assistant
plugins.author: pengzhou267-ai
plugins.description: Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
plugins.description_zh: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-width
plugins.author: garrisonz
plugins.description: Control the Web UI left sidebar width: lower the 264px drag minimum and optionally tune the drag maximum and the expanded default width, applied by a startup patch of the ui-layout bundle.
plugins.description_zh: 调整 Web UI 左侧会话列表栏宽度：调低 264px 拖动下限，可选调整拖动上限与展开默认宽度，启动时自动修补 ui-layout bundle。

plugins.name: dsh-single-instance-guard
plugins.author: Tang-mm95
plugins.description: Aborts startup when another live dsh instance holds the same DSH_HOME data directory, preventing the concurrent session-log writes that corrupt transcripts.
plugins.description_zh: 检测到其他存活的 dsh 实例占用同一 DSH_HOME 数据目录时中止启动，防止并发写会话日志导致的历史损坏。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-manager
plugins.author: yanglaofish
plugins.description: Skill lifecycle manager for DSH: list / edit / import / enable / disable skills under a global-workspace-session three-layer model, with unified settings & conversation UI, cross-layer search and pagination.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 技能生命周期管理插件：全局 / 工作区 / 会话三层模型下查看、编辑、导入、启用/停用技能，设置页与对话页统一管理界面，支持跨层全文搜索与分页。

plugins.name: dsh-skin-digital-arcade
plugins.author: RizenHNT
plugins.description: Digital arcade HUD skin: neon cyan/violet/magenta palette, Fusion Pixel fonts, animated sprites (city backdrop, data core, mascot), custom crosshair cursor; light and dark themes follow the system.
plugins.description_zh: 数码电玩风 HUD 皮肤：霓虹青/紫/品红配色、Fusion Pixel 像素字体、动画精灵（背景城市/数据核心/吉祥物）、自定义十字准星光标，浅深双主题跟随系统。

plugins.name: dsh-skin-nebula
plugins.author: lyq3
plugins.description: Anime skin pack for the DSH Web UI: five AI-generated HD themes (Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, Ryujin) with per-theme accent palettes, a top-right shirt-icon switcher, and an adjustable transparency slider.
plugins.description_zh: 动漫皮肤包：忍者、樱花、竹林、落日、苍龙五套 AI 生成高清主题，各配专属点缀色，右上角衣服图标一键切换，透明度可调。

plugins.name: dsh-sound-cue
plugins.author: Nixz0824
plugins.description: Short Web Audio cues when a session needs your attention (approval, question, or plan review) and when a task finishes. No popups or OS notifications.
plugins.description_zh: 会话需要你操作（审批、提问或计划确认）以及任务完成时播放不同的短提示音。Web Audio 现场合成，无弹窗、无系统通知。

plugins.name: dsh-sound-lab
plugins.author: miiaowuwu
plugins.description: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。

plugins.name: dsh-spill-s3
plugins.author: tancheng33
plugins.description: S3-compatible backend for the spill seam: oversized tool output goes to object storage (S3, MinIO, R2) with hashed session prefixes and unguessable keys, instead of the agent's local disk.
plugins.description_zh: spill seam 的 S3 兼容后端：超长工具输出写入对象存储（S3、MinIO、R2），会话前缀经哈希、键不可猜测，而不是落在 agent 的本地磁盘上。

plugins.name: dsh-start
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
plugins.description_zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

plugins.name: dsh-starter-zh
plugins.description: Beginner starter pack for DeepSeek Harness: welcome flow, 0→1 learning path, scenario-based plugin recommendations and a self-check checklist, paired with the dsh-handbook-zh Chinese tutorial repo.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 新手入门包：欢迎语、从 0 到 1 学习路径、按场景推荐插件与新手自查清单，联动 dsh-handbook-zh 中文教程仓库。

plugins.name: dsh-sticky-notes
plugins.author: flyhigao
plugins.description: Workspace sticky notes for DSH, saved as multiple Markdown files under the current workspace.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 工作区便签：在当前工作区保存多张 Markdown 便签。

plugins.name: dsh-stylevault
plugins.author: GptsApp
plugins.description: 30 classic open-source theme palettes (Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Solarized, etc.) mapped to official ThemeService tokens for DeepSeek Harness, with a Style Settings panel for live color/font/radius tweaks and JSON export/import for sharing config packs.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 30 套经典开源主题配色（Catppuccin、Nord、Tokyo Night、Gruvbox、Solarized 等），映射官方 ThemeService token；带 Style Settings 面板，可实时调整颜色/字体/圆角，并支持 JSON 导出/导入分享配置。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-default-model#plugin
plugins.author: dingminhua
plugins.description: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 settings.yaml 为子代理派发配置默认模型，支持单模型与多模型轮换/随机分配策略。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-model-picker
plugins.author: ringoage
plugins.description: A GUI subagent-model selector beside the main model seat: pick a model and reasoning effort per session, applied to every in-process subagent.
plugins.description_zh: 主模型选择器旁的子代理模型选择器：按会话选择模型与思考程度，应用到所有进程内子代理。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-vision
plugins.author: niuniuaba
plugins.description: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
plugins.description_zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-vision
plugins.author: niuniuaba
plugins.description: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
plugins.description_zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

plugins.name: dsh-svg-motion
plugins.author: weike-zhang
plugins.description: Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 里把任意 SVG logo 变成动效视频：`animate_svg` 工具渲染透明背景 30fps 组装动画（零件飞入或整体落位），并用 ffmpeg 合成 MP4。

plugins.name: dsh-sync
plugins.author: ZhenHuangLab
plugins.description: Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 设置与 Profile 配置的策略化 Git 同步，支持敏感信息隔离、冲突审阅与按行选择应用。

plugins.name: dsh-taintguard
plugins.author: sashankh
plugins.description: Taints the agent when tool results carry untrusted content, gates the privileged calls that follow, and refuses credentials passed to network-capable tools in every mode.
plugins.description_zh: 当工具结果包含不可信内容时将代理标记为已污染，对随后的高权限调用进行拦截，并在所有模式下拒绝将凭据传递给可联网的工具。

plugins.name: dsh-talk
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Voice-first conversation loop: a composer microphone (browser/local speech recognition), a speak tool for spoken replies, event announcements, and barge-in.
plugins.description_zh: 语音优先会话回路：输入区麦克风（浏览器/本地语音识别），speak 工具语音播报，事件播报与说话打断。

plugins.name: dsh-task-notify
plugins.author: YuMo226
plugins.description: Native Windows system notification (Notification Center toast) when a task completes: goal completion or agent turn end.
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成时弹出 Windows 原生系统通知（通知中心横幅）：目标完成或 Agent 结束一轮。

plugins.name: dsh-task-worktree
plugins.author: Letter2025
plugins.description: Complete task-scoped git worktrees: per-repo manifest for durable state, worktree-<name> branches, bring-back to main or direct commit, optional carry-over of uncommitted main changes (modeled on Qoder / Codex / Claude Code).
plugins.description_zh: 完整的任务级 git worktree：per-repo manifest 永久保存、worktree-<name> 分支、主目录带回（bring-back）与直接提交两种收尾、可携带主工作区未提交改动（参考 Qoder / Codex / Claude Code）。

plugins.name: dsh-taskswarm
plugins.author: february2015
plugins.description: DSH port of TaskPlane: dependency-ordered waves run in parallel git-worktree lanes, with task packets, cross-model review, and crash recovery.
plugins.description_zh: TaskPlane 的 DSH 移植版：按依赖分波、多 lane 并行执行（git worktree 隔离），任务包 + 跨模型评审 + 崩溃可恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-test-drive
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Isolated install-and-smoke-test for plugins: install, validate, and boot inside a throwaway DSH_HOME profile, producing a structured pass/fail matrix.
plugins.description_zh: 插件隔离安装冒烟试驾：一次性 DSH_HOME profile 内安装+校验+启动，产出结构化通过/失败矩阵。

plugins.name: dsh-ticktick
plugins.author: zhengjy01
plugins.description: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

plugins.name: dsh-tmuxctl
plugins.author: Jesse-njx
plugins.description: Take control of your tmux panes: list/send-keys/capture, run long jobs in a pane with watch mode, and approval-gated destructive commands.
plugins.description_zh: 掌控你的 tmux 面板：list/send-keys/capture、在面板中运行长任务并 watch，破坏性命令需审批。

plugins.name: dsh-token-anxiety
plugins.author: mov-eax-eax
plugins.description: Live per-task token cost widget: peak/valley pricing windows, projected post-hike costs, sortable per-task cost table, multi-currency (COP/USD/CNY + ~40 more) with FX rates, and one-click streamed LLM explain of expensive tasks.
plugins.description_zh: 实时按任务追踪 token 成本的小部件：高峰/低谷定价时段、涨价后预测成本、可排序的每任务成本表、多币种（默认 COP/USD/CNY，另有 40 余种）与汇率，以及一键流式解释高成本任务。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-call-stats
plugins.author: disyli
plugins.description: Per-process tool-call statistics: a `tool_stats` tool reporting per-tool call counts, error counts, and average durations.
plugins.description_zh: 进程内工具调用统计：提供 `tool_stats` 工具，按工具汇报调用次数、失败次数与平均耗时。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-github
plugins.author: NEAZ71eve
plugins.description: GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding (credential-store), and one-click clone-as-workspace.
plugins.description_zh: GitHub REST API 工具 + 浏览器侧边栏面板：仓库/搜索/Issue/PR/评论、账号绑定（凭据库）与一键克隆为工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-imagegen
plugins.author: Github-CJX
plugins.description: OpenAI-compatible image generation for DSH Desktop: the model calls generate_image in chat and the images render inline in the conversation.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Desktop 对话内联生图插件：模型在对话中调用 generate_image，图片直接显示在对话框内。

plugins.name: dsh-toolbox-web
plugins.author: AbcdefgXW
plugins.description: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.
plugins.description_zh: Web 界面工具箱：会话/回收站/子目录/搜索/预设/配置管理、标签分组、长消息折叠，以及支持 IM 渠道推送的定时心跳。

plugins.name: dsh-tools
plugins.author: qq1376868542-lang
plugins.description: Personal toolbox for the dsh web profile with per-feature toggles: task-done desktop notifications, one-click restart, session deletion, plugin enable/disable, update checks, and UI utilities.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 dsh web profile 的个人工具箱，各功能可单独开关：任务完成桌面通知、一键重启、会话删除、插件启停、更新检查，以及若干界面小工具。

plugins.name: dsh-translate
plugins.author: PerryLink
plugins.description: Parameter translation across 11 providers (temperature, top_p, etc.) plus deterministic JSON repair; never fabricates data.
plugins.description_zh: 跨 11 家厂商的参数翻译（temperature/top_p 等）+ 确定性 JSON 修复，绝不编造数据。

plugins.name: dsh-trend-radar
plugins.description: Ecosystem trend dashboard (行情面板): snapshot the dsh-plugin topic and the awesome list into local history, then report weekly trends — new plugins, star gainers, category heat, awesome coverage — plus a keyword radar for new plugins and star surges.
plugins.description_zh: 生态行情面板：把 dsh-plugin topic 与 awesome 收录列表快照成本地历史，产出周报（新增插件、star 增速、类别热度、收录覆盖率），并支持关键词雷达监控新品与 star 突增。

plugins.name: dsh-trilium
plugins.author: MineRPi
plugins.description: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-cost
plugins.author: WFMinerva
plugins.description: Per-turn real cost under every assistant reply: CNY at official peak/off-peak rates with cache-hit ratio; reads local session logs only, zero telemetry, zero keys.
plugins.description_zh: 每条 AI 回复下方显示该轮真实花费：人民币、官方峰谷价、缓存读占比；纯本地读会话日志，零上报零密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-agents-pixe
plugins.author: EternalNight996
plugins.description: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 主窗口添加「工作角色」页签 + 像素办公室浮层：内置 508 张角色卡（The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253），支持搜索 / 中英切换 / 分部分类；Canvas 2D 像素小人可站立、打字、踱步，闲聊台词可接 AI。一条命令安装，不改 dsh 源码。

plugins.name: dsh-unsloth-hands
plugins.author: MicroHEROX
plugins.description: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a locally running Unsloth Desktop (Unsloth Studio) server through unsloth_run and unsloth_vision tools; pure HTTP client, never spawns or owns processes.
plugins.description_zh: 把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地运行的 Unsloth Desktop（Unsloth Studio）服务器：unsloth_run 与 unsloth_vision 两个工具，纯 HTTP 客户端，不拉起也不持有任何进程。

plugins.name: dsh-update-copilot
plugins.author: hezhongtang
plugins.description: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: one scan covers the dsh core, official bundles, and every profile plugin; explains what changed and how risky each update is, then updates only what you confirm.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的更新助手：一次扫描覆盖 dsh 本体、官方 bundle 和每个 profile 的插件，说清改了什么、风险多大，只更新你确认过的那些。

plugins.name: dsh-update-notifier
plugins.author: stuarthu
plugins.description: Checks npm hourly for newer versions of the installed plugins and asks which ones to upgrade.
plugins.description_zh: 每小时检查 npm 上已安装插件的新版本，并询问升级其中哪些。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-meter
plugins.author: V-dev-388
plugins.description: Settings-page usage dashboard: per-provider/model token summary across all sessions, with today/7-day/30-day CSS-bar trends and a cache-hit rate.
plugins.description_zh: 设置页用量仪表盘：按服务商/模型汇总全部会话 token 用量，含今日/近 7 天/近 30 天趋势柱状图与缓存命中率。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-vendor-stats
plugins.author: kirigayakazima
plugins.description: Vendor-based usage dashboard: per-provider token/cache/output KPI, a 53-week heatmap, trend chart with hourly "today" view, model drilldown, cost estimation, CSV export, and health cards (TTFT, generation speed, peak context, error rate).
plugins.description_zh: 按厂商（订阅/官方API）统计用量看板：按供应商/模型拆分 Token、缓存、输出等 KPI，53 周热力图，趋势折线图（今天按小时），模型钻取，费用估算，CSV 导出，以及健康度卡片（TTFT、生成速度、峰值 Context、错误率）。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-vendor-stats
plugins.author: kirigayakazima
plugins.description: Vendor-based usage dashboard: per-provider token/cache/output KPI, a 53-week heatmap, trend chart with hourly "today" view, model drilldown, cost estimation, CSV export, and health cards (TTFT, generation speed, peak context, error rate).
plugins.description_zh: 按厂商（订阅/官方API）统计用量看板：按供应商/模型拆分 Token、缓存、输出等 KPI，53 周热力图，趋势折线图（今天按小时），模型钻取，费用估算，CSV 导出，以及健康度卡片（TTFT、生成速度、峰值 Context、错误率）。

plugins.name: dsh-verification#dsh-verification
plugins.author: bpc-oss
plugins.description: Verification gate for DSH agents: every acceptance criterion must be backed by server-stamped real tool evidence before the completion gate lets a goal through (advisory audit, enforce gate, durable permits).
plugins.description_zh: DSH agent 完成验证闸门：每条验收标准必须有服务端标记的真实工具证据才能完成（advisory 审计 / enforce 拦截 / 持久 permit）。

plugins.name: dsh-verify
plugins.author: 263311487-ux
plugins.description: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec drives real headless Chromium, asserts computed styles and pixel diffs, returns an HTML report and 0/1 exit code; ships npm CLI, GitHub Action, and MCP server.
plugins.description_zh: 独立浏览器验收测试：JSON 清单驱动真实 Chromium，断言计算样式与像素差异，输出 HTML 报告 + 0/1 退出码；提供 npm CLI、GitHub Action 与 MCP Server。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-guard
plugins.author: good-boy4069
plugins.description: Transparent image guard for text-only routes: paste images without the 400 session deadlock, plus a vision_analyze tool for OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/video.
plugins.description_zh: 纯文本路由的透明图片护栏：贴图不再 400 卡死会话，附带 vision_analyze 工具（OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/视频）。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-plugin
plugins.author: ld-1101
plugins.description: Give your text-only model eyes - chat image attachments are auto-described via a vision model (default prompt), with iterative re-parsing through model-generated prompts when details are missing; system/custom model modes + GUI config panel, key-safe secret handling, and a small host patch for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 (see repo README).
plugins.description_zh: 让纯文本模型也能看图：发图自动用视觉模型描述（默认提示词），描述不足时对话模型自动生成更具体的提示词重新解析；系统模型/自定义双模式 + GUI 可视化配置、Key 脱敏安全、针对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 的宿主小补丁（见仓库 README）。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-recognizer
plugins.author: kaixinbaba
plugins.description: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
plugins.description_zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-solution
plugins.author: br1nosense
plugins.description: Give DSH text-only models vision: an image/OCR/document recognition skill (race pool → custom channels → local) plus an idempotent host patch so image messages reach the model.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 纯文本模型补充视觉能力：识图技能（图片理解/OCR/文档解析，竞速池→自定义通道→本地）+ 幂等宿主补丁，让图片消息能送达模型侧。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-subagent
plugins.author: ruby1304
plugins.description: Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.
plugins.description_zh: 为任意 DSH 路由装上眼睛：Web 输入框贴图按意图自动聚焦分析，视觉子代理代读工作区图片，原图可随时物化编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-subagent
plugins.author: ruby1304
plugins.description: Vision for text-only agents: a vision_agent tool that delegates image reading to a one-shot subagent on a configurable vision route (MiniMax/Kimi), plus a Codex-style paste bridge — images are analyzed on an isolated context and only text reaches the main session.
plugins.description_zh: 纯文本模型的视觉补全：vision_agent 工具把读图委托给可配 MiniMax/Kimi 路由的一次性子代理，另有 Codex 式输入框粘贴桥——图片在隔离上下文分析，只有文本进入主会话。

plugins.name: dsh-voice
plugins.author: haoku123
plugins.description: Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: a composer mic (RMS endpoint detection) transcribes speech with whisper running locally in the browser, assistant replies stream back as spoken audio sentence-by-sentence, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 全双工语音对话：输入框麦克风（RMS 端点检测）配合浏览器本地 whisper 转写，回复按句流式朗读，开口说话即打断播放与正在运行的回合（真 barge-in），无需 API key。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-ai-girlfriend-plugin
plugins.author: beiyege-01
plugins.description: Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 语音 AI 女友：FunASR 麦克风语音输入、Qwen3-TTS 语音回复、数字人动画窗、QQ 双向聊天（文本/语音/图片推送，经 NapCat）。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-chat
plugins.author: lak321
plugins.description: Voice chat: 🎤 speech input (Web Speech, live editable interim results) plus 🔊 automatic/manual read-aloud replies (TTS), with voice, speed, pitch and recognition-language settings (Mandarin/Cantonese, etc.); fully client-side with zero keys, and Markdown is stripped before reading.
plugins.description_zh: 语音对话：🎤 语音输入（Web Speech，实时中间结果可编辑）+ 🔊 自动/手动朗读回复（TTS），支持人声/语速/语调设置与识别语言（普通话/粤语等），纯客户端零密钥，朗读前自动清理 Markdown 标记。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-input
plugins.author: NewDaNew
plugins.description: Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 语音输入：输入框一键麦克风按钮，基于 Web Speech API 语音转文字填入草稿，可选识别后自动发送。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-live
plugins.author: tangzheng202202
plugins.description: Real-time duplex voice over Volcengine streaming ASR/TTS: agent reply narration, barge-in, wake word, live captions, 30 Chinese voices and a reply-first acknowledgment; builds in the DSH monorepo.
plugins.description_zh: 基于火山流式 ASR/TTS 的实时双工语音：回复朗读、打断、唤醒词、实时字幕、30 个中文音色与先响应后思考；在 DSH monorepo 内构建。

plugins.name: dsh-wash-calendar
plugins.author: zimai233
plugins.description: Recurring-habit scheduling from pure date math: next occurrence, range schedules, and overdue advice.
plugins.description_zh: 基于纯日期数学的周期习惯排程：下次发生日、区间排程与逾期提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-web-artifact-designer
plugins.author: xulelenlp
plugins.description: Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters, infographics, landing pages, charts, component mockups) with a pre-delivery quality checklist and an anti-AI-look pattern list.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 的设计稿生成 skill（改编自 Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder）：把设计需求做成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿（海报、信息图、落地页、图表、组件稿），内置交付前质量清单与「去 AI 味」反模式清单。

plugins.name: dsh-wechat-mp
plugins.author: coolbreezecoin
plugins.description: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.
plugins.description_zh: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

plugins.name: dsh-wecom
plugins.author: michaelcode-wang
plugins.description: WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) Smart Robot bridge: two-way chat over the aibot WebSocket gateway, no public endpoint needed.
plugins.description_zh: 企业微信智能机器人桥接：aibot WebSocket 双向对话（bot_id + secret），无需公网回调。

plugins.name: dsh-weixin
plugins.author: wendayuan
plugins.description: WeChat (iLink) channel: chat with your DSH agent from the WeChat app, one persistent session per conversation, reusing DSH credentials.
plugins.description_zh: 微信（iLink）通道：用手机微信直接对话 DSH agent，每个对话一个持久会话，复用 DSH 凭据。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-companion
plugins.author: xianshu-virtuous
plugins.description: Automatically starts a fresh Web session near the context limit with the last complete turn, and adds an editable additive whale-maid persona with on-demand reload.
plugins.description_zh: 接近上下文上限时自动创建新 Web 会话并只转移最后一个完整回合，同时提供可编辑的追加式鲸鱼娘人格与按需重读工具。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-dir
plugins.author: DDSG-X
plugins.description: Shows the current conversation's working directory in a draggable directory panel with adjustable opacity.
plugins.description_zh: 在可拖动、透明度可调的目录面板中显示当前对话的工作目录与文件列表。

plugins.name: dsh-worlds
plugins.author: frozo-ai
plugins.description: Runs the agent's filesystem, bash and PTY terminals inside a Docker container by providing the `ctx.fs` and `ctx.subprocess` seams, so cwd, environment and background processes survive a harness restart.
plugins.description_zh: 通过提供 `ctx.fs` 与 `ctx.subprocess` 接缝，把 agent 的文件系统、bash 与 PTY 终端跑在 Docker 容器里；工作目录、环境变量与后台进程可在 harness 重启后存活。

plugins.name: dsh-wsl-workspace-picker
plugins.author: WilliamShi666
plugins.description: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

plugins.name: dsh-yogacara
plugins.author: tancheng33
plugins.description: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
plugins.description_zh: 以唯识心所与种子藏记录 agent 的状态，并以第一人称倾向写回提示词。

plugins.name: dsh-zen-remote
plugins.author: KyoMio
plugins.description: Phone-first mobile UI rework plus a pairing-code gateway: use DSH from anywhere as an installable PWA with Web Push, behind your own reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel.
plugins.description_zh: 手机优先的移动端界面重排 + 配对码网关：经自建反代或 Cloudflare Tunnel 把 DSH 变成可安装、带推送的 PWA。

plugins.name: dshmobile#dshmobile-plugin

plugins.description: Phone access to DSH over a self-hosted relay (WSS via your own TLS-terminating proxy): bundle plugin with bridge supervisor and QR login, a native Android app, and server-side device revocation.
plugins.description_zh: 通过自建中继从手机访问 DSH（WSS 由你自己的 TLS 终止代理提供）：含桥接守护与扫码登录的 bundle 插件、原生 Android 应用，并支持服务端设备吊销。

plugins.name: easy-archive

plugins.description: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
plugins.description_zh: 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档项不再出现在 ⋮ 菜单里。

plugins.name: eco-dsh-plugins
plugins.author: xiejianjun000
plugins.description: A scored memory-tree plugin (eco-memory-tree): structured long-term memory with BM25/Chinese retrieval and two-way Obsidian sync.
plugins.description_zh: 评分制记忆树插件 eco-memory-tree：结构化长期记忆，BM25/中文检索，Obsidian 双向同步。

plugins.name: file-planning
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Disk-persisted execution planning for DSH: milestone/step state machines, dependency gating, an audit event stream, and a deterministic completion gate via dsh tools, CLI, or skill.
plugins.description_zh: 磁盘持久化的执行规划插件：以 .trail 目录承载里程碑/步骤状态机、依赖标注、审计事件与复盘纪要，提供 dsh 工具、CLI 与技能三种接口。

plugins.name: find-dsh-plugins
plugins.author: JazzuLu
plugins.description: Conversational DSH plugin finder: four-source unified index, BM25 pre-filter plus LLM semantic ranking, candidates carry evidence grades and local static security audit, safe install flow with post-install verification.
plugins.description_zh: 对话式查找 DSH 插件的增强版 skill：四源聚合统一索引，BM25 粗筛 + LLM 语义精排，候选表带证据分级与本地静态安全审计，安装走安全确认流程并自动验证。

plugins.name: Firstrun

plugins.description: First-run health check for DeepSeek Harness: verifies Node/pnpm/dsh toolchain, profile, API key (names only), workspace and registry, then prints actionable next steps. CLI + agent-callable quickstart tool with dsh-firstrun/v1 reports.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 首次运行体检：检查 Node/pnpm/dsh 工具链、profile、API Key（只显示名称）、工作区与注册表，并给出可执行下一步。CLI + agent 可调用 quickstart 工具，输出 dsh-firstrun/v1 报告。

plugins.name: fullstack-expert
plugins.author: adithya-hmt
plugins.description: Cordis-native, evidence-driven full-stack engineering workflow: inspect-first planning, explicit verification evidence, and approval-aware gating for sensitive operations.
plugins.description_zh: 以证据驱动的全栈工程工作流：先勘察后规划、要求显式验证证据、敏感操作走审批门控。

plugins.name: github-mcp
