plugins.description_zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、opencode 配置里声明的 hooks 原样复用到 dsh，执行 shell、webhook、oracle、proxy 四类 handler，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: huahua-dsh-plugin-orchestra
plugins.author: azure5100
plugins.description: A plugin management system for DeepSeek Harness: plugin inventory with L0/L1/L2 AI purpose summaries, changelog tracking, update alerts, one-click upgrade, and backup/rollback with crash recovery.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件管理系统：插件清单与 AI 用途解读、变更日志、更新提醒、一键升级、自动备份与回滚，附带崩溃恢复。

plugins.name: kongmu-im-bridge
plugins.author: caoxiaohu7745-bot
plugins.description: Feishu bridge for DeepSeek Harness (derived from dsh-im-bridge): WebSocket long connection, approval cards, group @-mention-only replies, streaming card updates, /stop command.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 飞书桥（衍生自 dsh-im-bridge）：长连接免公网、审批卡片、群聊仅 @ 回复、流式卡片打字机回显、/stop 中断任务。

plugins.name: lazeword
plugins.author: xczhanjun
plugins.description: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.
plugins.description_zh: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

plugins.name: LLMs Forge
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Generate llms.txt for dsh plugin repositories from package.json + README — AI-readable discovery files, zero runtime dependencies. CLI + agent-callable llms_forge tool; read-only by default.
plugins.description_zh: 为 dsh 插件仓库从 package.json + README 生成 llms.txt（AI 可读发现文件），零运行时依赖。CLI + agent 可调用 llms_forge 工具，默认只读。

plugins.name: lunheng-article-pipeline-dsh
plugins.author: zuoyunlai
plugins.description: Multi-agent deep long-form article pipeline skill for DeepSeek Harness, running 7 roles across 5 phases with parallel literature/data/case retrieval, an evidence base, independent audit and human verification gates.
plugins.description_zh: 多 Agent 深度长文流水线技能包：7 角色 + 5 阶段，文献/数据/案例三线并行检索，产出带证据底座、反方论证、独立审计与人工核验节点的深度文章/论文。

plugins.name: math-research-dsh
plugins.author: xsoc1

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills-dsh
plugins.author: JUNQINGV587
plugins.description: DSH bundle porting Matt Pocock's 25 promoted engineering and productivity agent skills (grilling, TDD, code review, domain modeling, etc.).
plugins.description_zh: 将 Matt Pocock 的 25 个精选工程与效率 Agent 技能（grilling、TDD、代码审查、领域建模等）移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件包。

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills-dsh-zh
plugins.author: gongyijie85
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's skills in Chinese for DSH: all 25 SKILL.md translated to natural Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses), adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).
plugins.description_zh: Matt Pocock 技能中文版的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：25 个 SKILL.md 正文全译中文（技术术语保留英文并附注释），改编自 mattpocock/skills（MIT）。

plugins.name: mmx-quota-tool

plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页 MiniMax 配额悬浮卡：会话输入区显示水滴形 5h 已用百分比，点击展开详情面板，列出每个模型的 5h/周用量与重置倒计时，当前默认模型非 MiniMax 时自动隐藏。

plugins.name: model-catalog
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Auto-discovers model listings, pricing and capabilities from OpenAI-compatible API hosts, normalizes them, and emits ready-to-use model configs for dsh.
plugins.description_zh: 从 OpenAI 兼容 API 主机自动发现模型列表、定价与能力，归一化后生成 dsh 可直接使用的模型配置。

plugins.name: ModLens
plugins.author: liustack
plugins.description: Vision plugin: the vision bridge for every text-only agent.
plugins.description_zh: Vision plugin: the vision bridge for every text-only agent.

plugins.name: ModSearch

plugins.description: Web search bridge for DSH.
plugins.description_zh: Web search bridge for DSH.

plugins.description_zh: 通过托管的 MSDS Chain MCP 端点接入化学品安全数据：23 个工具覆盖相容性与投料顺序、GHS 危害、PPE、储存、废弃处置、职业接触限值、运输分类、多法域合规、SDS 查询与版本比对、签名审计报告；每条回答都标注其依据的供应商 SDS 与版本日期。

plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分级模型路由：think/build 模型分级、视觉委派（视觉模型只负责描述图片，工作模型负责执行操作）、图片生成，以及高影响操作守卫。

plugins.description_zh: Minimal verified plugin template with a runtime peer guard.

plugins.name: qmd-autosearch
plugins.author: zhangzhenwen1
plugins.description: Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.
plugins.description_zh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

plugins.name: Quality Score
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Plugin quality scorecard for dsh: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions, batch leaderboard. CLI + agent-callable quality_score tool.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 插件质量评分卡：0-100 分 + 等级 + 六项分项 + 修复建议，支持批量榜单。CLI + agent 可调用 quality_score 工具。

plugins.name: README Forge
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Generate README.md for dsh plugin repositories from package.json + cordis.patch.yml + source layout: install/CLI/tools/dev/license sections, deterministic, read-only by default. CLI + agent-callable readme_forge tool.
plugins.description_zh: 为 dsh 插件仓库从 package.json + cordis.patch.yml + 源码布局生成 README.md：安装/CLI/工具/开发/许可证章节，确定性输出、默认只读。CLI + agent 可调用 readme_forge 工具。

plugins.name: redfox-community-dsh
plugins.author: redfox-data
plugins.description: 100+ multi platform social-media data skills, plus 40 native MCP tools covering data APIs, AI search and AI generation — all installable with one command.
plugins.description_zh: 100+ 多平台社媒数据技能 + 40 个原生 MCP 工具（数据 API、AI 搜索、AI 生成），一键安装。

plugins.name: safety-net
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Destructive-command interception gate for dsh: parses shell semantics, judges risk against 41 built-in rules, and holds irreversible rm -rf, git reset --hard, and git push --force style commands at a confirmation gate.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 破坏性命令拦截闸门：解析 shell 语义、依据 41 条内置规则判定风险，将 rm -rf、git reset --hard、git push --force 等不可逆命令挡在确认关卡之前。

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.
plugins.description_zh: 拦截 agent 对敏感文件（.env、凭据、密钥材料）的读写，对工具结果中泄露的机密形状内容做掩码兜底，记录审计日志，并提供永不输出原始值的 sg_* 安全检查工具。

plugins.name: sendpage-mcp
plugins.author: jcaiagent7143-ui
plugins.description: Publish an HTML document as a shareable link that opens in one tap and previews as a card in chat apps; publish, update, and export to PNG/PDF/Word.
plugins.description_zh: 把 HTML 文档变成一键打开、在聊天里显示预览卡的分享链接;支持发布、更新,以及导出 PNG/PDF/Word。

plugins.name: session-titler
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Two-phase session captioning: instant keyword titles while the conversation is busy, then cheapest-budget-model refinement plus a one-line summary once it goes idle.
plugins.description_zh: 两阶段会话题词：会话进行中即时关键词题名，空闲后再调用最经济的预算模型精修，并附带一句话摘要。

plugins.name: skill-framework
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Bundles an engineering-methodology skill library as one Cordis plugin: 14 Agent Skills (planning, testing, debugging, review, delivery) registered on ctx.skills for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: 以单个 Cordis 插件打包一整套工程方法论技能库：14 个 Agent Skills（规划、测试、排障、评审、交付）注册到 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.skills。

plugins.name: snippet-expander
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Expands #tag shorthand into snippet-library text before messages are sent; multi-library, aliases, variables and recursion guards.
plugins.description_zh: 发送前把消息中的 #tag 展开为片段库配置的正文；支持多片段库、别名、变量占位符与递归防护。

plugins.name: SpecWorkflow
plugins.author: MoonCoder-HAPPY
plugins.description: Registers a SpecWorkflow skill pack for requirement clarification, implementation specs, execution, delivery review, repair planning, bug diagnosis, and source-backed research.
plugins.description_zh: 注册 SpecWorkflow 技能包，覆盖需求澄清、实施规格、代码执行、交付检查、修复规划、bug 诊断和带来源调研。

plugins.name: Stata-AI-Skill
plugins.author: ZihaoVistonWang
plugins.description: Run Stata through DeepSeek Harness: the native Stata AI Skill service auto-starts with DSH (macOS/Windows binaries bundled), so you can run regressions, do-files and econometrics workflows with no manual setup.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 Stata：Stata AI Skill 原生服务随 DSH 自动启动（内置 macOS/Windows 多平台二进制），无需手动配置即可跑回归、do 文件与计量工作流。

plugins.name: terminal
plugins.author: giiiiiithub
plugins.description: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

plugins.name: Timesheet
plugins.author: zoahdev
plugins.description: Turn-based time tracking from dsh session logs: totals, per-day/project/provider/source rollups, tool-call counts, failure rates, and time-to-first-token. CLI + agent-callable timesheet tool with dsh-timesheet/v1 reports.
plugins.description_zh: 从 dsh 会话日志做基于 turn 的时间跟踪：总计、按天/项目/供应商/来源汇总、工具调用次数、失败率与首 token 延迟。CLI + agent 可调用 timesheet 工具，输出 dsh-timesheet/v1 报告。

plugins.name: uagent-sync#packages/dsh
plugins.author: severin-ye
plugins.description: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
plugins.description_zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

plugins.name: wechat-ocr
plugins.author: hawkhai
plugins.description: Local WeChat OCR tool for DSH: `wechat_ocr_recognize` returns recognized text and the engine structured result for a local image path.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的本地微信 OCR 工具：`wechat_ocr_recognize` 针对本地图片路径返回识别文本和引擎的结构化结果。

plugins.name: win11-oneocr
plugins.author: hawkhai
plugins.description: Local Windows 11 OneOCR tool for DSH: `oneocr_recognize` returns OCR text and structured line/word polygons, confidence, rotation, and handwriting style.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的本地 Windows 11 OneOCR 工具：`oneocr_recognize` 返回 OCR 文本，以及包含行/词多边形、置信度、旋转角度和手写体样式的结构化结果。

plugins.name: windows-bash
plugins.author: bainianlaoyao
plugins.description: Makes Git Bash the only terminal tool for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: enables the bash executor and tool, disables PowerShell everywhere, and ships standard/code/cordis bash-only agent presets with the full-access sandbox defaults Git Bash's cygwin runtime needs.
plugins.description_zh: 让 Windows 上 DeepSeek Harness 的终端工具只剩 Git Bash：启用 bash 执行器与工具、全局禁用 PowerShell，并附 standard/code/cordis 三个 bash-only agent 预设及配套的 full-access 沙箱默认值。

plugins.name: browser4-dsh
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Browser4 AI-native browser engine exposed as skills.
plugins.description_zh: Browser4 AI-native 浏览器引擎（skills）。

plugins.name: deeplugin market
plugins.author: Shiyao-Huang
plugins.description: Search the attributed DeepSeek Harness plugin Store by natural-language intent, inspect sources, and run approved install and management actions.
plugins.description_zh: 用自然语言搜索带来源归因的 DeepSeek Harness 插件 Store，核对来源，并在批准后完成安装与管理。

plugins.name: deepseek-heartflow
plugins.author: yun520-1
plugins.description: HeartFlow (心虫) AGI layer-1 discriminator gate as a DSH plugin: 47-dimension rule-based text checking (heartflow_check tool) plus automatic output supervision at tools/post-execute, fail-closed when engine missing.
plugins.description_zh: 心虫（AGI 第1层辨别门禁）作为 DSH 插件：47 维纯规则文本判别（heartflow_check 工具）+ 工具调用后自动输出监督（fail-closed，引擎缺失时拒绝放行）。

plugins.name: dsh-browser-panel
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Headed browser embedded in the WebUI, model-driven and zero vision deps.
plugins.description_zh: WebUI 内嵌有头浏览器，模型实时操控、0 视觉依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-office
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Model reads/edits Office files with docx/pdf preview in the web client.
plugins.description_zh: 模型读写 Office 文件，web 客户端 docx/pdf 预览。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-server
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Smooth TUI via opencode attach.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 opencode attach 获得丝滑 TUI。

plugins.name: dsh-paste-input
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Ctrl+V paste files / drag & drop / picker.
plugins.description_zh: Ctrl+V 粘贴文件 / 拖拽 / 选择。

plugins.name: dsh-plan-execute
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Dual-model plan/execute routing: a planner model thinks, an executor model acts.
plugins.description_zh: plan/execute 双模型路由：规划模型思考、执行模型干活。

plugins.name: dsh-session-search
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Index-free read-only search across dsh/Codex/Claude Code/pi/OpenCode sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 跨 dsh/Codex/Claude Code/pi/OpenCode 会话只读搜索，无索引。

plugins.name: dsh-skins
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Web UI skins.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 皮肤。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-whale
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Pixel whale companion that blinks, wags its tail and spouts hearts.
plugins.description_zh: 像素鲸鱼伙伴（眨眼/摆尾/喷水/爱心）。

plugins.name: dsh-web-panel
plugins.author: dsh-external
plugins.description: Embedded terminal dock + Git review + file view.
plugins.description_zh: 内嵌终端 dock + Git Review + 文件视图。

plugins.name: fs-mcp
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Paddock: constrained local filesystem MCP server for agents — text read/write, directory ops, filename and content search confined to configurable zones, with zero runtime dependencies and a dsh bundle.
plugins.description_zh: paddock：面向 agent 的本地文件系统 MCP server——读写、目录操作、文件名与正文检索全部约束在可配置「围场」目录内，零运行时依赖，dsh bundle 接入。

plugins.name: memory-vault
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Cross-session persistent memory for coding agents: SQLite local storage, hybrid keyword/semantic retrieval, Web and MCP interfaces.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话持久记忆插件：SQLite 本地存储 + 关键词/语义混合检索 + Web/MCP 界面，供编码代理存取经验与决策。

plugins.name: notifier
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Desktop notifications and tones when a task finishes, waits for approval, or errors — native on macOS, Windows and Linux with zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成、等待批准或运行出错时在桌面弹出通知并播放提示音，macOS、Windows、Linux 原生实现，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: pty-runner
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Long-lived background terminal jobs for dsh: launch processes in a PTY, write input (including control sequences like Ctrl+C), page through ring-buffered output, and stop jobs gracefully or forcefully.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 后台终端作业管理插件：在独立 PTY 会话中运行长时进程，写入普通文本与转义控制序列，分页读取环形缓冲输出，并支持优雅或强制终止作业。

plugins.name: skill-manager
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Multi-zone skill discovery, progressive disclosure, creation wizard, audit and statistics.
plugins.description_zh: 多区域技能发现、渐进式披露、创建向导、审计与统计。

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Real-time terminal statusline: model, context usage, sub-agents, rate limits and session time in one line.
plugins.description_zh: 实时终端状态行：一行展示模型、上下文占用、子代理、速率限制与会话时长。

plugins.name: task-board
plugins.author: JohnXu22786
plugins.description: Event-sourced cross-session work ledger: register, track and settle tasks with full audit history, kanban export, and a board digest injected into every model turn.
plugins.description_zh: 事件溯源跨会话工作台账：任务登记、跟踪与结算，完整审计历史、看板导出，并将石板摘要注入每一轮模型上下文。

packs.task_zh: 离开终端时仍能访问 DeepSeek Harness Profile，并在任务完成时收到通知。
